180001.description:
Due to her parents' work, Serina Aoyama is staying with her father's best friend, Dr. Yamada, a doctor of engineering. Her son, Susumu, is strong despite his cute face. After all, he's a cyborg!

(Source: Manga Library Z, translated)

180002.description:
After losing his mother, Rei is left all alone and taken in by the Glamis, his father's family. They are a prestigious British aristocratic family, and Rei is sent to a boarding school.

However, Rei's stepbrother, Edward, who is the head of the house and the prefect, reigns over the place! Ed doted on Rei when he was a child, but for some reason, he became cold towards Rei as soon as she enrolled. He tells Rei, "When I graduate, you'll have to go back to Japan"!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

The much-anticipated serialization of the popular SNS sensation "Rabbit × Miniature Garden × Dark Fantasy" begins!! With white ears, pale skin, and red eyes, Teddy the rabbit is shunned at the orphanage due to his unusual appearance. One day, he receives an invitation from someone claiming to be his father, leading him to a mysterious Western-style mansion. There, he meets Adele, someone who shares the same peculiar traits as him...

Heo Jeong-U, a high school student who is bullied by a girl in his class for his weakness. Han Bo-Ra, a transfer student, comes to Jeong-U's class, where he was spending his miserable days. Jeong-U feels a strong sense of déjà vu when he sees the child with straight black hair and stains on his legs. Sure enough, Han Bo-Ra, who has subdued the arguing classmates, asks them, "Have you ever seen a child similar to me?" Jeong-U decides to approach Bo-Ra, who might be able to correct what is wrong...

As far as Myojin is concerned, his relationship with Yijo is destiny. But if you asked Yijo, he’d tell you they were just hooking up. He might even tell you it’s out of spite. To Yijo, Myojin is just his ex’s latest lover and an easy route to take revenge. Because Yijo won’t fall in love again, and he doesn’t get happy endings—no matter how handsome, sweet, and adoring Myojin is. This time, Yijo will be the one breaking hearts.

(Source: Tapas)

180010.description:
After years of seclusion, Ye Shen has reached new heights in his cultivation, and he has achieved the immortal body. However! When he stepped out of his sanctum, he was dumbfounded by what he saw. His former top disciple is now an all-powerful empress of her own demonic sect, commanding scores of demonic cultivators who are about to hold a sacrificial ceremony. The second disciple is an infamously bloodthirsty assassin who will kill anyone for the right price… her hands stained with blood. The third disciple is a master of poisons, brewing up bugs and potions that can turn people into her puppets. Ye Shen, who had been sealed away for a hundred years, is most shocked to discover that… his name has been spread across the entire continent, known as the demonic master who inspires fear and loathing in all.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

180011.description:
One day, Sumire Yaotome, a student at the music conservatory in the city, decides to change schools to escape from her daily life.

She heads for Nagano Prefecture, to a town lined with villas and resorts, where she finds a place to stay at Cafe Primrose. A quiet space lined with once-shiny instruments and infused with the faint aroma of coffee. However, despite the relaxed atmosphere, the cafe is on the verge of bankruptcy.

"Sumire, is there anything you can do..."

The cry for help comes from from Momo Momose, the girl who runs the cafe all by herself. Inspired by the instrument left by her grandfather, the former owner of the cafe, the chill and sometimes whimsical Momo wants to rebuild the cafe with the help of her friends and fill it with music.

(Source: swing,sing project, translated)

180012.description:
In her first life, she was ruined by her then boyfriend and her best friend. Reborn into her second life, she gave everything she had to take revenge but lost the man she loved the most. But they say "the third time is the charm". This rebirth, not only will she get her revenge, she will also save the man she loves most and tie the knot with him.

A fanfic volume packed with special scenarios, like a Ferris wheel ride for two, an intimate conversation in a private room, conducting otaku training (?) of a non-otaku girl, and many more sweet (and maybe more) stories with all of the beautiful girls!

Kyoto University is a haven for mavericks and geniuses from all over the country. Now in his first year at Kyoto University, Kashio Yamakawa doesn't even own his one and only unique characteristic of "being a better student" anymore. So now he spends his days in a dazed depression as a zero person with zero personality.

That is when he runs into Yoko Sawakita, a fellow member of the Mandolin Club with Kashio back in high school. Yoko had been a humble student like Kashio in high school, but now she enters Kyoto University as a new student and a celebrity, having made a name for herself as a professional wrestler!

Kashio is overwhelmed by Yoko's sparkling new appearance, but Yoko has been waiting to reunite with Kashio at Kyoto University for a long time...! The bell rings on a hot and heavy love affair that will roil the Kamogawa River!

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

The two are like the light and dark sides of the moon, total opposites who don't get along. Until one day, when Tsukiyama discovers the hidden side of "Wolf Senpai" through his secret part-time job...?

Tsumugi is a hardworking human chef in the kitchen of the Demon King’s castle…and a transmigrator from another world! Freed from her previous life of homelessness and suffering, she’ll fight to the very last to keep this dream job where food, clothing, and shelter are guaranteed—even if it means dealing with her rough-and-tumble demon coworkers!

Sayaka Tsuneda, age 29, works at an advertising agency when one day a suit-wearing angel descends before her very own eyes?! Sayaka struggles to handle her own feelings as the two of them grow closer and closer. How will this awkward fan girl's love story end?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

180040.description:
Sena Satou, a medical researcher, finds herself lost in a different world - and she is not the only one! After managing to start a new life as the medicine-man "Sena," she encounters a mysterious man. He is the demon lord Delmatitidis, a man of immense beauty and strong magics, but physically sickly and weak. He recognizes Sena's knowledge and experience in herbal medicine, and she becomes his personal apothecary. As they share time together, they form an unforgettable bond and soon the two are drawn to each other. A doting romance that will change the destiny of a genius but nerdy apothecary and the handsome demon lord!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Shio-kun is the leader of an underground idol group.

While drunk at a bar he was coaxed into going to by a fellow seminar member, Nishina reunites with Hase Ryosuke, a tea ceremony practitioner who captivated him when he first saw him perform as a kid. When he drunkenly asks him for love advice, Hase almost kisses him and asks, "Well, why don't you try it with me?"

Edgar is one of the best snipers in the underworld. A man on the brink of old age lives his life as if searching for his final destination, chasing the shadow of his late lover. However, an encounter with Barba, a mysterious man who resembles his late lover, shakes Edgar's heart.

When the king offers Aerik Cladinae his own sister's hand in marriage for his meritorious deeds in battle, he didn't expect to get saddled with a limping, drooling woman like Miesa Esquillre. Driven insane by her brother's physical and psychological torture, Miesa rolls around on the ground, spills food all over herself, and screams unintelligibly as a way of communicating. But sometimes, Aerik catches a flash of shrewd understanding behind those vacant eyes. Is Miesa truly as mad as everyone thinks... or is she hiding something?

180056.description:
When young college grad Jung Seyi gets lost on the way to her grandma’s funeral, she seeks shelter at a botanical garden she stumbles across deep in the mountains. Before she knows it, she’s accepted a job as a member of the garden’s crew under the guidance of the mysterious but charming director. The whole situation seems like a dream come true, but as Seyi begins to have eerie visions and experience disturbing things, she quickly realizes that she may have been lured into a nightmare…

Running an odd job agency can be life-threatening at times, as Yisin learns after helping a mob boss's lover flee with his money. When the mob boss's subordinate, Director Yoon, threatens to string him up unless he finds the woman and brings her back, Yisin chooses to run away to Seoul instead. Though he expects the presence of Hyeonkyeong, a powerful rival mobster, to keep Director Yoon away from the city, Yisin couldn't be more wrong. As his past slowly comes back to haunt him, Yisin discovers that the director's vengeful obsession with him runs deeper than he realizes...

(Source: Tappytoon)

180059.description:
One of the most celebrated paintings in the world is believed to be the work of the master, Whip Valamer, the premier portraitist of 18th century Europe. The subject of the painting is Zabeth Clayton, the adored first-born daughter of a storied family who is said to have died of an illness at the flowering of youth. This often-told story hides a truth at once more beautiful and tragic.

(Source: Tapas)

180060.description:
The protagonist awakens to find herself reincarnated as Lunaria il von Solfege, her beloved villainess from her favorite game. However, along with this new identity come Lunaria’s tragic memories—public condemnation, complete abandonment, and ultimately, a desperate attempt to take her own life with a dagger. “You can leave everything to me, Lunaria. Now that I am you, I will never let them get away with this,” she vows. The remarkable revenge of a villainess fighting for the sake of love starts here.

Nashikawa, a high school student with this kind of troublesome disposition, enters a "Volunteering Club," in which he watches kids!? 180073.description:
In a world where humans and vampires coexist, a starving vampire Jess is trapped by humans and imprisoned beneath a slave camp. The warden tortures Jess, seeking a cure for his own disease, but Jess fails to heal like most vampires. Desperate, Philip locks Johan, a former doctor turned slave, underground with Jess to nurse him. As Johan works to gain Jess’s trust, he finds himself dangerously drawn to the enigmatic vampire. Sensing Johan’s feelings, Jess pretends to return them, planning his escape. But if they break free together, can they ever truly reclaim their old lives and escape this darkness?

Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez--until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what’s rightfully hers. When Ines is sent back in time, she vows revenge on the man who betrayed her. But just as she’s consumed by vengeance, she crosses paths with Carson — the man who once saved her life in her previous timeline. Drawn together, they find that saving each other may be the key to healing themselves.

180077.description: Shokudama is set in late Edo, the time when our contemporary food culture first began to develop. In the city full of lively merchants and townsmen, Himura Tamanosuke, a freelance guardian with a sharp sword skill, live frivolously with his two younger siblings. One night, he was visited by the “Souls of Food” demanding to help them return to Nirvana since his dead Father couldn’t. Tamanosuke couldn't just sleep on the "nightmare" since he was threatened by death curse... But how exactly should he help 108 food souls!

180080.description:
Kusunoki Minato is given the responsibility of taking care of a house in the countryside. It is supposed to be an extraordinary property infested with evil spirits…, but he unknowingly wipes out the evil spirits with his unique power!

Attracted by the coziness of the purified Kusunoki Residence, a variety of unique deities begin to gather there!

It's the start of a heartwarming country life with the neighboring mountain gods.

(Source: Dengeki Daioh G, translated)

180083.description: Asahi Kira is a young man who, one day, while wandering the Japanese district of Los Angeles, meets Masakiyo Koga, a failed karate fighter, who invites him to his dojo. At Koga's invitation, Kira becomes a bouncer at the dojo, where he teaches his signature fighting techniques to a beautiful female wrestler he meets, Diana Rosa.

180084.description:
The sparkle, pain and excitement of youth. I will surely reminisce about this first love story with "You".

Ogino Miho is a first-year who has always wanted to fall in love. Soon after starting high school, she gets placed behind the soccer club's Murata-kun, who she ends up talking with more and more each day... Her first feelings, her first conversation, her first lover––. A story that brings back memories of all your firsts, "your" love story.

180085.description:
The Occult Research Circle is located at the Kyoto Yagi Women's University of Arts. However, research is now just a fancy word for playing around with the occult because it sounds fun. This is a Reiwa tale of the strange, about a group of girls who play around with the occult just for fun.

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

Mizuki, an office lady, wakes up in an unfamiliar forest, in the form of a little girl somehow. She seems to have been reincarnated in a different world, and Mizuki is at a loss, but for some reason, she gets more and more strong allies -or rather, more followers- such as the legendary monster Fenrir, a talented A-rank adventurer, and the others.

“I just want to live a leisurely life, but why am I surrounded by overprotective adults!?”

(Source: Alpha Manga)

180088.description:
Model and singer Yuki finds himself in a tough situation, as he's caught the eye of both his handsome agent and a music producer in this romantic-comedy love-triangle! Sexy scenes abound!

Yuki Miyamura (age 30) normally hides behind his thick glasses, but in order to pay back the ten million dollar debt owed by his brother, his high school classmate, Akiharu Tsubaki, signs him to his family's talent agency. However, there is one condition... He has to pose as an 18-year-old heartthrob! While trying to dodge Akiharu's attempts to seduce him, Yuki does his best to find success in his new career. Then one day, he meets music producer Shogo Asano...

(Source: BookWalker, translated)

title.native: マニアック・ラヴァー

180089.description:
After becoming entranced by the beautiful suits abroad, Rui Hattori decided to become a tailor just like his father. One day, the tall and handsome Oda walks into the shop for his first bespoke suit. Once Rui begins to measure Oda's muscular body and he is instantly turned on by his body. Oda on the other hand has an unexpected awakening looking down at Rui's cute countenance. Their love is stifled as they are merely tailor and client. As Rui crafts Oda's suit, their relationship begins to deepen. Will they ever break out of their strictly business relationship or will they be stuck in this limbo forever?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Is It Okay to Fall in Love With My Customer?
title.native: お客様に恋してもいいですか？
title.romaji: Okyakusama ni Koishite mo Ii desu ka?

180090.description:
Nozaki and Nishida work together as boss and subordinate. They can do the jobs and look good... but they are totally unaware of how the other feels! "I can't get the wrong idea about what he's trying to tell me here..." "Ugh... I have no chance with him..." Oh, the clumsiness... Oh, the frustration!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by MUGENUP for serialization.

title.english: My Inner Voice is Loud Enough
title.native: 副音声はうるさい十分に

180091.description:
Harold is a descendant of the brave hero who vanquished the evil Demon Lord. In these peaceful times, Harold has become just a common handyman.

One day, the Book of God, which predicts the end of the world, is discovered. The condition to avoid destruction is... "The hero and the Demon Lord's daughter must complete the 'Marriage Quest'."

Now begins the newlywed life with Yona, the daughter of the Demon Lord. While Harold is wary about the sudden marriage, Yona does all the household chores perfectly and gently pampers Harold when he is tired. However, she has a secret agenda…

"So let's do it already ♡"

(Source: Comic Regulus, translated)

title.english: The Newlywed Quest- The Demon King's Daughter Wants to Bed the Diligent Hero

180092.description:
Ibuki Doi has never forgotten his first love from high school—Mikami Baba, the kind, handsome, and totally straight student council president. Though he was too shy to approach Mikami back then, Ibuki always held his idol near and dear to his heart, wishing him nothing but the best! However, when he learns Mikami is soon to be married to a man, he just can't help it—he's absolutely devastated. He drinks himself into a stupor to drown his sorrows but is surprised to wake up and find...he's back in high school?! Could this be Ibuki's second chance to make things go his way?

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

180093.description:
Ninko Shinobe, a descendant of the Kouga-school of ninjas, is a shy and kind-hearted high school girl. But what happens when she falls in love with a transfer student, Igasaki-kun, from the rival ninja village of Iga...? The start of an adolescent ninja romantic comedy!

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

180095.description:
Manga series focused on Shadow The Hedgehog in order to promote Sonic X Shadow Generations.

Shadow and Maria live on the Space Colony ARK, but one day they are suddenly attacked by the Earth Defense Forces who are “disposing of dangerous biological experiments”. Shadow and Maria try to protect each other, but Maria is hit by a merciless bullet…?

Masaichi Hizumi is a revenge agent, professionally dishing out just deserts to anyone who may have incurred the wrath of his clients. His latest target? Mikoto Kuga, an elite salaryman, narcissist, and way-more-than-two-timing cheater. Hizumi’s task is to teach this piece of trash a lesson—by thoroughly humiliating him, body and spirit! Whether he’s ready for it, Kuga is about to get his comeuppance, served with a smile by Hizumi!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Toshoshitsu no Yuurei-kun" and one extra chapter.

“If you’re the one to put inside... Then I’m okay with it.”

Sakai, a gay man who used to be a teacher, saves Ao, a handsome college student, from getting entangled with a stranger. Ao asks him to return the favor and they end up having a drink at a bar. While Ao shows his youthfulness, Sakai starts thinking about being in bed with him. And when he starts his imagination, Ao invites him out...! Sakai takes the lead by saying “Sorry it’s an old man’s asshole, but you can fuck it hard as hard as you want.” However, when they start having sex, Ao pounds Sakai’s prostate hard and takes control and...!?

A Japanese salary man was reincarnated in a different world with swords and magic. He reincarnated into the family of a powerful noble. One day when he became twelve years old, he was suddenly summoned by his father.

180100.description:
Burned out from a grueling end-of-the-year workload, middle school teacher Kurokawa transforms into the demanding Aggrokawa! This overtired alter ego craves nothing more than pampering. Meanwhile, his boyfriend Shiraki is torn. Knowing Kurokawa has a masochistic streak, Shiraki is tempted to push his buttons. 180101.description:
The Elven Queen Mist is held captive, bound and tortured, but protected by her elven magic, she smiles with ease. However, her magic is stripped away by the human king Rex's insane love and schemes! She is implanted with a raw sensation that an elf would never feel in her life, the "pleasure of a woman"... The unfazed and overwhelming Queen Mist's face distorts lasciviously at the unknown sensation, and the mad king Rex's true "education" begins...!!!

180104.description:
The warrior Erquanna wakes in a casket and hears people making light of her death. When she shocks them by opening her eyes, she realizes she’s now in the frail body of Erne de Medina, a well-known dimwit from the empire. Erne made a deal with a demon (and died in the process) that Erquanna must now fulfill. She must fall in love with one of the three strongest men in the empire—and have them fall in love with her—before her time is up and her soul is taken as payment.

(Source: Tapas)

180106.description: The time is Meiji era. A tomboyish aristocratic lady, Honoka Kiyohara, visits Hokkaido for the first time in many years and meets a beautiful young man named Ookami. Honoka is engaged to be married to Masaya, the heir of the Inoue clan, whom she has always loved like brother, but for some reason she feels a stronger attraction for Ookami...

180107.description:
A two-volume bunkoban reprint of Akira Toriyama's Manga Theater, retitled "An Emperor's Feast of Akira Toriyama".

This version, while omitting several one-shots from Manga Theater, includes the two-chapter Alien X-Peke (1996), published after the end of Dragon Ball, as well as the full-color seinen manga Lady Red (1987).

The second volume also includes "The Anime and Me" (1989), a full-color essay manga from the first Dragon Ball Z Anime Special magazine, as well as a new afterword by the mangaka.

Featured one-shots include:
Volume 1:
- Lady Red
- Go! Go! Ackman
- Dub & Peter 1

Determined to participate in the Gundam Fight, even if unofficially, John attempts to assassinate Rain, only to be confronted by Domon and Rain after it is revealed his target is a hologram.

180109.description:
One day, "I," an ordinary high school boy living in the present day, was hit by a truck and reincarnated in another world. But what a surprise it was to find out that I was reincarnated as Elena Evan, the "villainess" of an otome game!

If this continues, the future that awaits me will either be condemnation, execution, or exile... I want to avoid that at all costs. While I was worrying about this, I found a glimmer of hope. If Tiara, the main heroine, and I could get together and find a yuri route for us, maybe we could avoid a bad ending...?

However, I am now beset by a number of beautiful and handsome men?!

180110.description:
One day, a shy high school girl named "Tsubura Enjou" suddenly travels back in time to 50 years ago. For some reason, she ends up in the role of the hero "Justice Flare," here to fight off giant monsters! Back in the present day, 50 years later, Tsubura's childhood friend "Anna" and Tsubura's crush "Sho," both of whom are tokusatsu fans, are looking forward to seeing her "Fight on today! Fight on Tsubara Enjou!" This is crazy—! The start of a time-slip monster-extermination romantic-comedy that can't be explained by science alone.

With the daughter, they have a pure relationship only up to the point of kissing, but with the mother, he can get handjobs, titty fucks, and full penetration…

180112.description:
Was the way I felt about you back then love? Friendship? Or perhaps it was jealousy all along.

Baek Ho-Jin, a former national judo champion, has never experienced the feeling of falling in endlessly—until now. Choi Jeong-Won, a brash magazine editor on the verge of losing his job, stumbles across a fragment of his past: a memory of Baek Ho-Jin, his high school classmate and now one of the nation’s most celebrated heroes.

Tasked with securing an exclusive interview with Hojin to save his career, Jeong-Won must navigate old emotions and new challenges. But will he succeed before it’s too late?"

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ปล่อยไปตามหัวใจ

180113.description:
Kwon Yeong has been rejected by Yun Jeyeong six times, each dismissal wrapped in gibberish that he can't make out. But the real problem isn't just the heartbreak; it's that every time he's rejected, he's transported back to the first day of the new semester when he first met Jeyeong. Stuck in this endless cycle, Yeong's confessions always take him back to square one. Frustrated and fed up, Yeong declares, ""I'm not gonna like you anymore! Never again!"" Just when Yeong decides to give up, the loop restarts. But this time, something begins to change in their relationship.

Dive into the mysterious and heartwarming journey of ""Love on a Loop,"" where every reset brings new possibilities for love and self-discovery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prolouge and two side story chapters.

180114.description:
In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she’s the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity’s bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity?

(Source: Tapas)

Renato, a half-elf who in despair after the death of his beloved Almas, wakes up as Rei Nagawa inside a strange room in a strange world.
In opposition to his state, he finds Almas shaking hips on his belly. Apparently now he earns a living as a novelist, while Almas lives as Rui Aruma, they live together and appear to be lovers.
Despite his unresolved confusion, he feels the joy of spending time with Almas again, when he is suddenly killed by a stranger.
But next thing he knows, for some reason, he is back to the time just before his death...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Notes: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ハッピー・デスティネーション

180118.description:
Lewis has served Prince Edward since he was a child.
His loyalty and love for Edward have just grown since then, but he has never shared his feelings given their difference in status. No matter how much the heat of Edward's eyes burned him.
One day, however, he is summoned at night to the prince’s room and is told that he has to marry a princess from another country.
He gave his loyalty, love, and everything else to him, and all he wanted was to be by his side. But that's not what happened...

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

1. Rakuen no Tori (楽園の鳥)
2. Shibikyuu no Matsuei (紫微宮の末裔)
3. Tsuki ni Hoero (月に吠えろ)
4. Nemurenu Yoru no (眠れぬ夜の)

180120.description:
One day, the owner of the divine universe makes a wager with Mephistopheles, a being from “the other side.” Their wager was to see whether a special soul born on earth would grow up to become a servant that follows the divine path or the wicked one. In present time, mid-19th century Prussia, Martin, an aspiring novelist meets a mysterious Elysse Wagner at a countryside inn. Together, they end up embarking on a journey to find an ominous group that claims to know a way to bring the dead back to life. Only, there is more to Elysse than Martin could’ve ever imagined…

(Source: Tappytoon)

180121.description:
Hyeon-Do and Yu-Min, an ordinary man and woman in their 30s, break up with their respective partners for different reasons despite still being in love with them. Selfishly hoping to get their old flames back, the two form a plan. They pretend to date each other in hopes of provoking their former lovers. Will their selfish and foolish plan really work?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: รักหลอกหยอกแฟนเก่า

Manager Kyosuke Kozuka from the Fox race is hired as the exclusive manager of a popular model from the White Tiger race, Ojiro Mifuyu. Despite being quite renowned for his skills, Kyosuke worked hard to hide from others around him that he is an Omega to survive in a society with strong prejudice against his animalistic gender. But one day when Mifuyu touches him in the dressing room, an unexpected heat happens...!? "I'm the only one who is allowed to have sex with Kyosuke" says the younger, more passive alpha model.

When Miyato is about to be hit by a truck, Jogo throws himself in harm's way to save her. In the final moment before impact, Jogo wishes he could have told Miyato how he felt. But then he hears a mysterious voice saying, "You can do it over. This time, don’t have any regrets."

When he wakes up, he finds himself unharmed, lying on the ground, with a different version of Miyato beside him—she looks the same, but her clothes and hairstyle are different.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Kiran was the strongest soldier, but he lost his life in the battle against the Demon Lord. He accepts a proposal from the Goddess and is reincarnated as the daughter of Duke Heikelaar…? This is an adventure story where Lady Kikka, born with the memories of an experienced warrior, regains the "magic bullet" skill from her previous life, and rises to become a leader. Her gallantry will attracts people to join her.

(Source: Comic Spira, translated)

The end is here, the waterways have dried up, and the plants are dying. The world is in a panic, as food and survival become people's top concerns. Rice and noodles have become luxuries, and vegetables are priceless! However, at this time, someone posted a shocking video online. Succulent vegetables are dropped into the boiling hot-pot, all vibrantly green! The roasted leg of lamb is sizzling with rich golden color! The fish soup is white as milk with rich goodness! The former scientific civilization has perished, and the surviving humans are in a harsh struggle for survival against giant water-stealing creatures known as aqua gorgers. One day, Noah, a boy who lives in a remote sea area, saves a woman who is being chased by aqua gorgers, but she turns out to be an incarnation of the God of Fire, who has the power to burn anything she touches…!?

A boy and a girl travel in search of paradise at the end of the sand sea.

180137.description:
Published irregularly between 1998 and 2000, it's a documentary manga following the development of popular game software

The 1998 episodes are:
The Men Who Created Virtua Fighter (Yutaka Suzuki)
The Man Who Created the Derby Stallion (Hiroyuki Sonobe)
The Men Who Created Resident Evil (Shinji Mikami)

The 2000 episodes are:
The Men Who Created Gran Turismo (Kazunori Yamauchi)
The Men Who Created Super Mario Bros. (Shigeru Miyamoto)
The Men Who Created the PlayStation (Ken Kutaragi)

Not included in the tankobon release, it's the tech-toy promotional chapter: The Men Who Created AIBO (Game Creator Biography Special Edition)

Each chapter follows a strict structure, in which the the main character, a game creator, announces the concept of a groundbreaking game. At first, the staff members are against it, but later agree to develop it after being persuaded by the protagonist's enthusiasm.

Then a prototype is completed, but it's never good on the first try and he has to be re-done from scratch. After the release date is set and the game completed, the protagonist is confident about the quality of the game but worried if the audience will embrace. Of course, the chapter ends with the game becoming a groundbreaking hit.

The stories are exaggerated with typical shonen manga tropes and comedy scenes, with a significant part seems to be fiction; despite this the series has received numerous parodies and homages in the years following its publication.

Half a century ago, dungeons, monsters, and people who had received special abilities commonly referred to as "Skills" appeared. Those people were called Adventurers and challenged dungeons searching for dreams and riches.

Kisaragi Tsukasa is one of these adventurers. However, he received an inferior skill and has often been treated as trash. One day, he was tricked by his peers and was thrown into a dangerous dungeon.

What awaited him at the other end was the mythical monster, the God-Eater Fenrir. In despair over the overwhelming power difference, Tsukasa was prepared to die. That was when the master of the dungeon, Loki, appeared before him.

“Welcome to my castle.”

Thanks to Loki, Tsukasa’s skill evolved to become "Copycat"... A unique boy-meets-girl story woven into a modern battle fantasy is about to begin!

180163.description:
The Dang clan of Sacheon, once renowned for its poison and hidden weapons, is now on the path to its demise. That is, until Yeonmyeung Dang, an outcast boy of the clan, awakens by recollecting the memories of his past life as the 'god of swords' who devoted his life to mastering the sword. However, her plans are disrupted when Philip's brother, William Cardiner, schemes against him and removes him from the line of succession. In order to secure his power, William forces Ange to marry Aiden Fitzroy, an illegitimate child born between the emperor and a commoner. Will Ange learn to love the humble stranger she was forced to marry?

(Source: WEBTOON)

26-year-old Shouko who had to take over the household duties after her mother's passing is one day greeted by a shocking sight. Her 19-year-old runaway sister is back home. Pregnant.

With her furious father self-isolating in his office and her sister watching TV all day, Shouko is at the end of her rope. What is a woman to do when she reaches the limit for taking care of her selfish and ungrateful family members?

Former archery prodigy Yoo Sanghyun was destined for greatness until an injury forced him to quit. Though his coach helped him secure a stable job, he never felt like he belonged. Frustrated, he leaves it all behind to pursue game streaming. Leveraging his incredible archery skills and the charm of his noob character, he quickly rises to fame as "Almond." Now, he's determined to dominate the gaming world, but will his virtual success translate into something greater in real life?

On the surface, he seems to be always indulging in poetry and song, hanging out in bars and brothels. But in fact, he has secretly cultivating a group of talented followers in preparation to contest the kingdom, while manipulating the Tangjiabao in the Shu kingdom, the assassin guild led by Chu Hanfei, the former duke of the State of Chu. Three major forces have emerged, and all three are focused on finding the ancient book "Pushback Diagram." Meanwhile, Zhao Kuangyin, the grand general of the Houzhou, is also carefully plotting out his grand plan to unite the kingdoms.

With generous rewards from the system after getting bad reviews and his great ambition, Yang Chen worked hard and finally established his dominance in the world.

Karen is reborn in another world, but she's entirely ordinary—no powers, no special skills, and no grand mission to accomplish. Fortunately, life is easy as a rich noble.

Karen lives the good life until her mother completely forgets everything about her. When it's discovered that Karen is actually the child of an affair, she's banished from the family and forced to live on her own as a fourteen-year-old commoner! However, two years later, her family presents her with a chance to rejoin the ranks of the nobility under one condition: she must marry either the elderly, widowed margrave who lives on the frontier, or the dashing soldier who's seemingly destined for greatness. Which will she choose?

Min-Joo has a pretty appearance that would make men look at her at least once. Her job is an internet broadcaster. Two black shadows slowly approach Min-Joo, who was just running with her dreams of increasing the number of viewers and becoming famous. It cannot be taken lightly. 'Bite each other to death.' A suspenseful romantic thriller that moves between the online world and the world of three young men and women.

180183.description:
The imperial scribe Jurgen is devastated by the tragic death of his wife, Autilia. The perpetrator is none other than his closest friend, the crown prince, Sitri. Driven by obsession, Sitri’s ultimate goal is to claim Jurgen as his most prized possession, binding him forever in a web of control and desire. Unaware of the extent of Sitri’s obsession, Jurgen finds himself drawn deeper into a perilous trap.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Do-Yeong, a handsome but ordinary university student, falls in love at first sight with Chun-Sik, who works part-time near his school. Do-Yeong makes advances towards him, but Chun-Sik is completely unaware of Do-young's feelings... Will Do-Yeong be able to win Chun-Sik's heart?

Shunned and forced to mask her disfigurement, Arryll lives a miserable life as the illegitimate child of Duke Brixia. When her family’s crimes come to light, she dies a miserable death as their scapegoat. Then Arryll goes back in time… Now armed with future information that will help expose her family, Arryll plots her revenge and teams up with the captain of the royal guard, Ethan Velstein, to serve justice. However, her family’s crimes may go beyond just fraud and embezzlement…

180189.description:

When all is destroyed, will you persist? Or will you give in to the gray abyss? In a dystopian world, both the gifted and the wretched are making their last attempts at survival. Their struggles are fierce, and their desperation palpable as they work toward one common goal — to survive.

(Source: Manta)

180190.description:
Once a slave, Lev is unexpectedly freed by a passing nobleman named Nox and brought into his household to start a new life of quiet stability.

But everything begins to shift the night Lev shares a bed with Arad, Nox’s close friend.

From that moment on, the balance between the three begins to twist, tangle, and unravel, turning the mansion into something far more complicated than a place of refuge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

180192.description:
Ren Umeyama and Tsubaki Hattori have been together since elementary school and now they're high school classmate. Next to Tsubaki is a special spot for Ren, and not for any cute and popular girls. That said, and because of this, and because Ren did not want to ruin this current distance, he could not accept Tsubaki's confession. "But, you're my friend," Ren said, and yet he had fallen in love with Tsubaki. Then Ren finally realizes that the "friend" relationship he sought with Tsubaki was based on Tsubaki's resignation and determination.

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

180193.description:
Hoshino has always been a good-natured person and has always passed up on his own love life. Even now, at 27 years old, he has never been in a relationship. He was depressed because one more relationship had fallen through. However, Maki, a junior colleague sitting next to him, is not concerned about it, and today, he is still trying to make a move on him. Maki is one of the best in terms of outer look and work performance, but to Hoshino, he is a super-cocky junior. One night, Maki discovers that hHoshino's lost love is of the same sex... And they end up going out together...?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

180194.description:
A successor of a strawberry farmer Akito is an introverted closet gay and goes about his life in peace. One day, Nakagawa, a salesman for a confectionery manufacturer, comes to sign a contract. Akito avoids the bright, sparkling "city boy" Nakagawa, but when he is served the strawberry wine brought as a souvenir, he gets drunk! Nakagawa looks at him kindly and somewhat passionately, who has turned on his wanting-to-be-spoiled "switch". Nakagawa corners him by saying, "You are so cute and honest," "I want to know more about you," "I love you so much," and so on... Is this sales talk? Or is this...?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Tsukioka is unlucky in love but lucky… elsewhere. When classmate Tokieda catches a glimpse of what he's packing, he proposes a friends-with-benefits deal. Tsukioka worries he's too much to handle, but Tokieda knows exactly what he likes! What starts as a temporary fling "until we get girlfriends" slowly grows into something deeper.

A coming-of-age story about young love that's not as unrequited as they think!

(Source: Animate International)

180196.description:
Niimi and Sawane met in the student council of a boys' school and became lovers. After graduating from high school, the two high school boys choose different career paths, and they don't see each other for a long time, but then summer vacation arrives...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

180197.description:
The third installment in the "Love Alliance in Midnight" series is here!

After spending their school years fighting and "making up," Yoshio has become a bar owner and Tenma the young leader of the Shisui group, a yakuza organization. Stuck with each other whether they like it or not, they've become something akin to lovers.

After not seeing Tenma for a while, Yoshio grows worried and drops by the yakuza residence to ask about him. Upon Tenma's return, Yoshio jokingly comes on to him, and Tenma gives him free rein to do whatever he wants. As Tenma rides him with merciless fervor, Yoshio notices that something's amiss about him. The way Tenma's acting tells Yoshio that he's hiding something from him, and the fact that he won't open up to him makes Yoshio sad.

A love story between a caring bar owner and a tough, cool young yakuza boss: two men living lives full of bitterness, locked in a bittersweet lifelong love.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 真夜中ドラスティック

180198.description:
Jin and Ryou are Alpha with first-rate looks and family backgrounds. The two, who are best friends since their school days, share the same complex- they have never felt the pheromones of an Omega. Tonight they go for a night on the town again to encounter with the destined moment, but it is time to settle down and face life...? One day, when the thought of retiring as a playboy crosses their minds, Jin and Ryou have a fateful encounter with Ran, an Omega.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

180199.description:
"I fell in love with the way he thought of someone else..."

Mikeneko Ryokan, where the young dragon Kokufuu works, is famous for the beauty and deliciousness of its cuisine and is frequented by many yokai. Ryoya, a gourmand fox yokai who has been staying at the ryokan for a long time, is always bringing trouble to the ryokan and messing around with Kokufuu. Ryoya finds a Japanese painting he has been looking for for years at an antique market, but the painting was bought by a demon lord. When he goes to ask him to give him the painting, he finds that Benimaru, the demon" lord's younger brother, has taken a liking to him and is pressuring him to become his "mistress". Kokufuu, who knew of Ryoya's strong feelings for the painter that had lasted for a hundred years, was forced to turn his eyes away from the feelings that had been born in his heart, and together they go to the demon's mansion...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

180200.description:
Half human and half snake, Akemitsu Orochi is the noble son of a renowned family. Blessed with both beauty and an excellent pedigree, he is soon asked by his family to try and pair with another of noble blood for one month in order to continue his lineage. His pairing partner is none other than Mashu Kofu, a man of Siberian tiger pedigree who also happens to be his former fiancé.

They were engaged once before when they were children, but Mashu suddenly annulled their engagement and broke off their relationship, scarring Akemitsu for life. Akemitsu, at his uncle's behest, begrudgingly agrees to give it another shot and try living together for a month. Turns out, Mashu has become extremely handsome since their last meeting, but has developed a horrible personality. After Mashu boldly declares that he has no intention to fall in love this time around, Akemitsu hatches a plan to seduce Mashu and then break his heart...!

An arrogant young entrepreneur and a bewitchingly gorgeous yet pure business owner meet in a BL story where pedigree is king in a cruel hierarchical system!

(Source: Renta!)

180201.description:
Maizawa is still holding a grudge about the fact that he lost his girlfriend to his classmate Miya. His relationship with Miya, who is his nemesis, continues even after he enters the workforce, and for whatever reason, they both work at the same company. The charismatic Miya is good at his job and popular with both men and women. Miya's daily life is shining brightly, and Maizawa is depressed in the shadow of Miya, and his only emotional support is a secret account operated by Miya......! The way he posts naughty pictures under the name "MIA" makes Maizawa feel superior to Miya, as if he has Miya's weakness.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

180202.description:
Akiha, a trimmer who hates people but is well-liked by everyone because of his calm demeanor, is put in charge of training a newcomer, Hizuki, who is not very sociable. Hizuki is strangely getting attached by animals, but is hopeless at customer service, and Akiha has a hard time dealing with him. One day, when Hizuki gets drunk at a welcome party and Akiha takes care of him at home, he hugs him and confesses to him. He dismisses it as the ramblings of a drunk, but the next day, Hizuki continues to make passionate moves on him...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: きっかけは、君のすべて

180203.description:
Kanoh is mentally unstable with a sense of atonement for his former partner who was killed by his own hand, and Kairi is elusive and secretive, faithful to his sexual desires. As they grow closer as partners, their bodies connect as if they were breathing, and they continue their inexpressible relationship, until a new incident occurs, reminiscent of the Maisie crime, which involves the use of illegal drugs. In the process of investigating the connection between the cases and the victims together, he realizes that he and Kairi have a good "chemistry." He realizes that they are more than partners and reminds himself that he should not desire a relationship that goes beyond their current one. Kanoh realizes that he is more than just a partner.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: メメントスカーレット-ripe-

180204.description:
One fine day, a group of children who are part of the Boy Scouts come to a campsite. But bite marks found on one child's hand while preparing a campfire leads to tragedy... Will the children be able to survive this outbreak of pure murderous intent?!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

180205.description:
No escape. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #114

title.native: 以前助けていただいた元教え子ですが
title.romaji: Izen Tasukete Itadaita moto Oshiego desu ga

title.native: コネのためならしょうがないよね
title.romaji: Kone no Tamenara Shouganai yo ne

title.native: わたしに! ごほーび×ごほーし

180209.description:
Shintarou Mori, a first-year high school boy, is teased by his friends for wanting to find a beautiful girlfriend and having a sparkling social life. His classmate Inaho Sawatari is regarded as the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. The two of them shouldn't have anything to do with eacher, but when they're inadvertently mistaken for a couple, Inaho proposes: "How about we pretend we're really dating?" They act like a couple in public, but it turns out the most beautiful girl in the school is actually a very cute boy...!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)
synonyms: Inaho-kun Is Supposed to Be a Fake Sweetheart

title.native: 稲穂くんは偽カノジョのはずなのに
title.romaji: Inaho-kun wa Nise Kanojo no Hazu Nano ni

180210.description:
After surviving a car accident that left him in a months-long coma, Lee Soo-Han wakes up with no memory of his past. Standing by his side is a mysterious man who claims to be his husband—Jo Yeon-Seo. Although they’re supposedly married, the emotional distance between them feels insurmountable. Soo-Han grows wary of Yeon-Seo, yet he can’t help but be drawn to the man’s steadfast devotion. Just as Soo-Han begins to feel a connection, Yeon-Seo shatters his expectations with a shocking revelation: he’s ready to give Soo-Han a divorce—for his own good. The more his young husband pulls away, the more genuine Soo-Han’s feelings become. Determined to break through Yeon-Seo’s guarded heart, Soo-Han takes matters into his own hands.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: To Me Who Doesn't Love You

180211.description:
Hiding a dark past behind the quiet counters of a small New York art gallery, Theo thought he had finally built a safe life. But when financial ruin threatens the gallery, he goes to meet a mysterious benefactor who promises a way out. Waiting in the shadows is Cedric, the half-brother Theo abandoned twenty years ago in a place known as Paradise. Now a powerful figure with cruelty to match his influence, Cedric demands total submission in exchange for salvation. Driven into a corner by debt and guilt, Theo falls into a trap woven from vengeance and dark desire, where escape is no longer an option.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hardcore BL Danpyeonseon (하드코어 BL 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Hardcore BL Short Story Collection] The Ghost of Paradise

180212.description:
Posthumously-published collection of Nami Sano's one-shots and illustrations.

1. Tulip wo Kimi ni (チューリップを君に) [Tulip for You]
2. Shiawase no Chocolate (幸せのチョコレート) [Happy Chocolate]
3. Tsuki no Uta (月のうた) [Moon Song]
4. ラ・ルー (La Rue)
5. Non-surgar Coffee (ノンシュガーコーヒー)
6. My Home (マイホーム)
7. テイラーズ・ハウス (Taylor’s House)
8. 肩幅ひろし (Kata-haba Hiroshi) [Broad-shouldered Hiroshi]
9. Noppo ga Iru (のっぽがいる) [Tall Man Here]
10. Itoshi no Kami Isshu (いとしの紙一種) [My Dear Girlfriend]
11. Hito Yonde 8823 (人よんで8823) [a.k.a.8823]
12. Densha de Yomenai Manga Fair one-shot (「電車で読めないマンガフェア」用書き下ろし)
13. Sakamoto Desu ga? Blu-ray and DVD 2-koma one-shot 「 (TVアニメ「坂本ですが？」のBlu-ray&DVD特典用に書き下ろされた２コマ漫画)
14. Mougen Harta-you Illustration (モーゲンハルタ用イラスト)
15. Migi to Dali: Natsuyasumi (ミギとダリ「夏休み」)
16. Kimi wa Doko Iku? Tabi Manga Fair one-shot (君はどこ行く？旅マンガフェアの書き下ろし)
17. Harta Extra one-shot (ハルタEXTRA読み切り)

180213.description: One-shot spin-off of Sakamoto desu ga? published in Harta volume 36.

180214.description:
His first girlfriend is a girl who likes girls...!?

Note: Originally published in Bessatsu Shonen Champion 2017 Dec. issue under the title Kono Kakegae no Nai Jigoku (このかけがえのない地獄).
synonyms: このかけがえのない地獄

180215.description:
A modest but insistent paean to life, interweaving the stories of a sullen, middle-aged doctor and his innocent niece. The uncrowned masterpiece that was nominated for the Akutagawa Prize, losing only to Ishihara's Season of Violence, now shines once again in this manga adaptation!

(Source: Torch, translated)

180216.description:
Humanity trembles before the Grenimals-grotesque creatures born from corrupted desire. Among them roam the Lycanthropes, savage beasts driven by their lust for chaos and pleasure, and the Vampires, who see humans as nothing more than cattle to be bled dry.

As the world teeters on the brink of madness, those who hunt what should not exist the Executioners-rise to stand against the encroaching darkness. Among their ranks are Mutuki, a stoic, battle-hardened warrior, and his sharp-witted partner Yuri, as they plunge into one supernatural mystery after another-each case more twisted than the last, each unveiling horrors festering in the shadows of their crumbling world.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

180217.description: Zhao Zihui and his elder brother Zhao Ziyue were born and raised in Harbor City. One day, Ziyue discovers the existence of an alien species and abruptly leaves their home. A few years later, Zihui still can't find peace as his brother's disappearance comes back to haunt him.

180218.description:
Otome, who loves to make sweets, is invited by her high school tutor, Kohei Tsuchiya, to come work at his patisserie, “Patisserie MON.” Her expectations are high as she gets to work with the “teacher” she has always admired, but...?

(Source: Manga MEE, translated)

Note: Adapted as a J-drama in 2024.

180219.description:
Daimon and Otome finally confirm their feelings for each other and decide to go out together, but what happens “after that”? Based on the hit love story set in a patisserie, this is a complete collection of all the special-edition stories that were published after the serialization ended!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: パティスリーMON 完結編

180220.description:
Determined to tear down the fake angelic bitches and the homewreckers, Shen Yugui, a professional returning from overseas, master hacker, and elite martial artist, will do all she can to play dumb, win the heart of the icy CEO, and climb toward the summit of her life!

(Source: Webnovel, edited)
synonyms: In Nancheng to Wait for the Returning Moon
御曹司との恋に秘密はつきもの

title.romaji: Shenmi Zhenbianren: Boss, Jie Ge Yun

180221.description:
I've already died once, I won't die again! I've been reincarnated as Evelina, a saint in a fantasy novel who has lost her powers. The only problem is, this wicked saint is supposed to meet her end by burning at the stake! To escape her fate, I must use my powers of seduction to win over the three men who drove me to my demise!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 堕落聖女に転生した私、3人の従者たちに抱かれて困ってます
ทางหลุดพ้นของนักบุญลวง
La Fausse Sainte Aimée de Tous

title.english: The Fake Saintess Awaits Her Exit

180222.description: The near-future sci-fi manga's story centers on Hana, a woman who works in a pharmaceutical company, and her regular correspondences with the titular Pino, a robot equipped with an AI. Pino is tasked as a caretaker of the animals the company regularly uses for medical trials. But one day, Pino undergoes an unexpected change.

180223.description:
Se-Ju lives every day weary as a member of a crime ring that he joined to avenge his younger sister’s death. However, one day, he encounters a boy, Se-Jin, and reminded of his dead sister, takes him in. From there, what was supposed to be a temporary arrangement grows into something far more.

(Source: Manta)

180224.description:
Is it a banshee, a yeti, a gorgon, or...a cat? Monster Cats are a purrfect new breed of familiar furry friends crossed with freaky fun! If you think life with regular cats can get complicated, wait till you see what it's like for people who live with these charming supernatural pets.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

180225.description:
There's more to her than meets the eye... Having always been a good girl, Shushu is horrified when she's suddenly framed for murder and locked up in an all women's prison. To survive, she becomes the prison wife of her intimidating yet beautiful cellmate, Minicat. But is Minicat all that she... or he appears?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

180226.description:
A heartwarmingly cute yuri manga about a seamstress and a zombie girl. What if your friend became a zombie? What if you were in love with that friend?

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

180227.description: Note: 2 Pages Short Story Published on the Author's Pixiv account.

title.native: 彼氏が変なことするので困ってます…漫画
title.romaji: Kareshi ga Hen na Koto suru node Komattemasu... Manga

180229.description:
Three hundred years ago, God destroyed the world. All that remains of humanity lives deep underground, far from the blasted surface—and far from The Emissaries, remnant soldiers of the divine war against mankind. Most live quite lives in the tunnel cities, but the few daring or desperate enough to risk death work as scavengers, collecting relics of the old world...

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Void: No. Nine - Kyuubanme no Utsuro
ヴォイドナンバーナイン

title.native: Void: No. Nine -9番目のウツロ‐

180231.description:
Merely seeing her off, but it's still a pet's job.

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #114

title.english: The Result of Raising With Tender Loving Care
title.native: 愛情注いで育てた結果

180232.description:
1. Natsukusa -3-nen Mae- (夏草 -3年前-); Comic LO 2021-10
2. Natsukusa -3-nen Go- (夏草 -3年後-); Comic LO 2022-02

180233.description: Note: Originally published as a one-shot in GUSH September 2024 issue, was then picked up for serialization.

title.native: おっきいの大好きちはやさん

title.romaji: Boku ni Sawareru Kare no Te

title.native: 据え膳おにいさんは丸ごと食べたい
ラブミー・キャッチアップ

180237.description:
Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot in GUSH 2024 September issue, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

180238.description:
The raging fire showed her the true nature of the people around her. In this reborn life, she's going to reverse her unfortunate fate! Fighting off her wicked sister, breaking things off with her family, that Bai girl is acting crazy! Why's she acting this way, they wondered? Genius medical student, black-hat hacker, math prodigy… they're all just disguises. In the end, she's still that Xingchen in the heart of Master Lu.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: The Daughter of a Wealthy Family Went Crazy After Being Reborn
Thiên Kim Hào Môn Trùng Sinh Phản Đòn
การเกิดใหม่: ทายาทสาวผู้ดุร้าย
バッドエンドから帰ってきた彼女は

title.native: 豪门千金重生后杀疯了
title.romaji: Haomen Qianjin Chong Sheng Hou Sha Feng Le

180239.description:
On the Shenqi Continent, spiritual energy revives, releasing rampant demons. Countless forces crumble and disasters sweep across the continent, leading to the decline of the human race and an impoverished life for the people. Qin Feng, a god-level alchemist who has fallen into the status of a martial arts waste due to a frame-up, reverts back to his youth. Based on his experience in his previous life, he uses the advantages of alchemy to promote his martial arts cultivation. In this life, he vows not to let history repeat itself. He is determined to protect those he loves, eliminate all the evil and reach an unprecedented pinnacle!

(Source: MangaToon)

180240.description:
Roel Linthea is a timid, fragile girl who has been mistreated by her adoptive family. She's shocked and worried when she's sent away to marry Asran Hycariel, the son of a powerful yet infamously cruel ducal family. But to her surprise, she soon learns that none of the rumors are true, and everyone there is nothing but kind. And strangely, Asran seems to have known her since a long time ago... Will Roel be able to find happiness with her loving in-laws, or will the past come back to haunt her?

(Source : Tapas)
synonyms: บ้านสามีแสนสุข

180242.description:
Arwyn reincarnates into a novel as a vulnerable child trapped in an abusive family. Navigating the challenges of this fantastical world, she stumbles upon the young version of the male lead. Having read the novel, she knows that Shelby will eventually find happiness... but what of the current suffering the poor child is going through? She couldn't look the other way and extends a helping hand, which may lead to a chain of events that could ultimately shatter the original storyline.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: 10年過ぎてもあなたを愛してます

180243.description:
Elena wakes up as a disgraced side character in a novel. To survive, she must hide her commoner status. When the protagonist, Rosaline, discovers her secret, she forces Elena to do her work instead. Amidst the male lead's advances, Elena finds herself drawn to an apprentice knight she met by chance.

(Source: Manta)

title.native: 永遠の脇役なんていない

180244.description:
When the woman opened her eyes, she was being violated by a strange man. Unable to even remember her own name, she is endlessly violated day and night amidst confusion. She later learns that if she does not regularly have relations with the man, she will die. The woman is called Freya and ends up living with the man in this place where only the two of them exist…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Could you give me a new name?
ขอได้ไหม ชีวิตใหม่ของข้า

180245.description:
The buzzing of humans in the city at night. The headlights of cars glaring at intersections. In a corner of this confusing “modern world," there lives a small elf. This is a story of finding a little happiness with a lone elf.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: エルフが現代にいたら

180246.description:
"What I want is a 'future where I don't die', that's all."

Adela, the young damsel of the Laver family, a line of magicians, has always lived by total dedication and meek obedience to earn her family's love. However, one day, after being pushed by a servant and banging her head, she recovers her memory of her previous life and discovers that she is destined to be murdered.

Realizing her future, Adela stops pursuing her goal of winning her family's love at all costs. If her life is to be unhappy and unrequited, she prefers to live according to her own desires, leave her family now, and live peacefully as a commoner.

It was her decision, but...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: お嬢様はもうおしまい

180247.description: "The next time I'm reborn... I want to live a life of love and being loved..." That's how I... took my life. ……It was supposed to be! ? When you wake up to the applause of many people, you will be dressed in a beautiful dress and performing a wedding ceremony. Could this be...? Bonus time for the amount you suffered in your previous life? I'm Emma, who makes my heart dance. And then, Gideon, the King of the Horned Tribe who vowed to marry, appeared. "Let's finish the first night quickly." She captivated Gideon, the king of an enemy country, and reincarnated as a villain trying to manipulate the country. At this rate, she will not have sex because of the death penalty or the ability "Temptation" that is equipped in her body to force the opponent into heat. and die... I have no choice but to find an escape route...! ?
synonyms: A Reincarnated Villainess Is Destined to Die If She Doesn't Have Sex ~Entrapped Marriage With the Enemy King~

title.native: 転生した悪役令嬢はHしないと死ぬ運命～敵国王と篭絡結婚~
title.romaji: Tensei shita Akuyaku Reijou wa H shinai to Shinu Unmei - Tekkoku Ou to Rouraku Kekkon

180248.description:
The omega crown prince of the Kingdom of Wistad has been living in hell ever since the day he was tricked into imprinting on Duke Amandaris. This is because while an alpha’s pheromone is supposed to be enticing and irresistible, it is nothing but unbearable stench to an omega that has already imprinted. However, the crown prince finally sees a glimmer of hope when he hears that there is an extremely affluent foreigner in the kingdom who is capable of undoing an imprinting. Unfortunately, this rare information doesn’t come for free, so can the prince pay the right price to the man who has it all?

(Source: Tappytoon)

180250.description:
Hiyori, an art college student, meets Kyle, a mysterious handsome man with blue-gray eyes from another world. He claims to have come from another world to gather "anima" in order to save his own frozen and dying world. Hiyori has a special power, and he asks her to lend him her power to gather anima. The otherworldly fantasy love comedy between a slow-paced art college student and an unsociable handsome knight is about to begin..!

(Source : Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: そのくちづけは(異)世界を救う

180251.description:
A book club that will change your love life.
Gavin Scott, a star MLB player, is on the verge of losing his marriage. Desperate to win his wife back, he seeks redemption in Nashville's secret club, exclusively for alpha males, that uses romance novels to mend relationships. Will Gavin decode the language of the heart and secure a happily ever after?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

180252.description:
Baek Hyeon sacrificed everything to become the best actor in the industry. So when he's about to die in a plane crash, he makes a desperate wish for another chance to live. Hyeon's plea is granted, but who said anything in life was free? Reborn as his younger self, Hyeon must first become a successful K-pop idol if he wants to be an actor again. Can Hyeon make it in the cutthroat world of fierce competition, demanding schedules, and fake smiles? Or will he fail and lose his second shot at fame?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!

180253.description:
When Yu Seo-Hyeon sacrificed her life to save her first love, Ciel de Leopart, she never expected to wake up as Irene de Closhe in a world straight out of a book. Amidst this bizarre twist, she reunites with Ciel, who has now become a supporting male lead destined to betray the crown prince. As her unique guide abilities resurface, Seo-Hyeon is haunted by Ciel's intense, madness-filled gaze, a stark contrast to the man she once knew. Tangled in a web of past love and new identities, Seo-Hyeon must navigate a treacherous path where past and present collide.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: วิธีปฏิเสธความยึดติดของอดีตสามี

title.english: How To Reject My Obsessive Ex-Husband

180254.description:
A story of two people who had a sad fate until they found new happiness.

The time is the Taisho era. The orphan Meiko, who suffers from weak eyesight, lives a modest but peaceful life at a temple orphanage. One day, a suspicious person visits the temple and suddenly attacks Meiko.

When she wakes up, she finds that time had rewound several months back. To avoid death, Meiko follows a guide. There she meets her long-lost twin sister, Kanako, the daughter of a marquis... After her parents tell her the story of her birth, Meiko is to marry Matsuwaka Akashi, a military man feared as the "Demon Akashi," as Kanako's substitute-

(Source: Comic-Walker, translated)

title.native: 身代わり乙女の幸福な嫁入り～めいこと結びのあかし～
title.romaji: Migawari Otome no Koufuku na Yomeiri: Meiko to Musubi no Akashi

180256.description:
Yi Seo-Yo is a prince who grew up believing he was a Yang being. But when he reaches the age of thirteen, he discovers during a ceremony that he is merely a commoner, a fact that deprives him of his princely status and palace home. Just as he is about to forget about the palace’s splendor, his royal past, and Nareu-Ye, the boy he promised to take as his mate if he were a Yang being, Nareu-Ye appears in front of him with everything he has been stripped of. Then, in the distant future, Yun Seo-Yo is born, carrying the memories of his past life as Yi Seo-Yo. He meets Kwon Cha-Heon, who looks identical to Nareu-Ye but has an entirely different personality. Despite trying to distance himself from Cha-Heon due to his painful past, he gradually finds himself opening his heart to him…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ร่องรอยแห่งความว่างเปล่า

180257.description:
This isn’t the life I wanted!!! After reliving high school as Jin-U, the boy he once bullied, An-Cheol is now a new person. But his new life takes an unexpected turn. Once again, he is sent back in time to live as Jin-U. But this time, Jin-U is also back... as An-Cheol!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: ชีวิตเวรเอ๊ย 2

title.native: エミル・クロニクル・オンライン外伝　デルタサーガ デルタサーガ
title.romaji: Emile Chronicle Online Gaiden - Delta Saga

180259.description:
Sequel to the first Ar Tonelico PS2 game.

After the battle with Mir ended and the world was saved, Lyner and his friends were in the middle of a journey to gather the [feelings] they needed to craft a Song that would reach everyone in the world. However, while the world should be peaceful again, various strange incidents have started happening. Items produced through Grathmelding suddenly rose in price due to a shortage of materials, Tenba dismissed a large portion of their Reyvateil workforce, and this in turn caused these Reyvateils to begin falling into emotional instability one after another. And finally, the Tenba troops have started a war with the Reyvateils at Skuwat Village, while a "mysterious entity" that seems able to control the common subconscious of the Reyvateils seeks a confrontation with Lyner.

title.native: アルトネリコ 世界の終わりで詩い続ける少女
title.romaji: Ar Tonelico : Sekai no Owari de Utai Tsuzukeru Shoujo

180260.description:
24th of December, Silent night, senpai and I went out to look for the floating shadow. At that time we were kidnapped by aliens! The clumsy aliens accidentally swapped our brains, consequently "I became senpai and senpai turned into me... "

My new daily school life is in chaos, who can tell me what is going on?

Note: The series won the Silver Prize in the 10th Dengeki Novel Prize.

180261.description:
Sequel to the second Ar Tonelico PS2 game.

Having returned to Metafalss after winning the battle against the [Goddess], Croix and the others have begun preparing for [Metafalica], the Song Magic that will create a continent. The people’s expectations and anxiety, as well as fear of its failure weigh heavily on the Maidens Luca and Cloche. There is a girl who harbors mixed feelings as she watches the people from the satellite Sol Marta, high in the skies of Metafalss. Her name is Infel. The first [Maiden of Mio] who despite perfecting the Song Magic [Metafalica], was unable to weave a continent. The story of Infel and Nenesha from 400 years ago is at last told. What feelings did the two pairs of Maidens who devoted everything they had to the creation of the continent hold?!

title.native: アルトネリコ2 世界に響く少女たちの創造詩
title.romaji: Ar Tonelico 2 : Sekai ni Hibiku Shoujo-tachi no Metafalica

180262.description:
"Maybe I could have chosen something different..."

Keito is a late-20s company employee who's planning to get married as a "woman," despite not feeling cemented into a specific gender or sexuality.

Meanwhile, Aya is a married woman in her 50s who continues playing out the role of "wife" despite being in a marriage that's long since gone cold.

They both struggle with a gender that was decided upon birth and the "wife" role that became nothing more than a pantomime at some point. This is a story of two queer people who harbor doubts about how they've been treated and shoved into a "normalized" box, and try to take back their true selves. Be it "woman" or "wife". Be it "normal" or "common sense". This is a story for those who fight against what restricts them.

(Source: Manga Mavericks Books)

Note:
- Was nominated for the 30th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2026.
- Ranked #3 on the 2025 Kono Manga ga Sugoi! list of manga for female readers.

title.native: ボールアンドチェイン

180263.description: Life at Papilon, the elite magic school, is full of hardships for Rhea who's failing in every possible way. One day, when her hidden friendship with the top student and her childhood friend Sion gets discovered by the mysterious transfer student, Joon, Rhea can’t help but notice the energy of death surrounding him… Who will be the wizard to kill her?!
synonyms: Who's the Wizard That's Gonna Kill Me?

180264.description: Takes place between the Ciel Nosurge and Ar Nosurge games.
synonyms: Ar nosurge: Ode to an Unborn Star

title.native: アルノサージュ ～生まれいずる星へ祈る詩～
title.romaji: Ar Nosurge : Umareizuru Hoshi e Inoru Uta

180265.description:
Day 1: I must be seeing things. Wait, did that cabinet just move? Better check.
Day 3: I see them now! Damn it! Why is this world so full of supernatural beings!?
Day 101: Well, there's nothing to be afraid of! Time to put on my witchy dress and join them!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Become a Witch in a World Full of Ghost Stories
Becoming a Witch in a World Full of Monster Stories
Become an Enchantress in a World Full of Ghost Tales
“モノノ怪“.溢れるこの世界で俺は魔女になるしかなかった

title.native: 在充满怪谈的世界里成为魔女
title.romaji: Zai Chongman Guaitan De Shijie Li Chengwei Monü

180267.description:
This story happens in a cultivation world, Gu Qing He arrived in "Ark" during a time of crisis. "Ark" wanted to bestow incredible powers to Gu Qing He and thus started to modify him. After that, Qing He found out that his original world has actually already been infiltrated by the [Old Gods], overturning all the cognition he possesses since young.

With a danger that can arrive anytime. The Forged Immortal begins his journey, going against the ruling of the [Old Gods], changing the ending of the world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

180268.description: Jeongha, who has always had fragile health, meets Hyeon, a maid brought by her mother-in-law one day. Feeling intrigued by Hyeon, who is 12 years younger than her, Jeongha offers her a room and begins to take care of her... Despite their initial tension, Hyeon starts to feel unfamiliar emotions towards Jeongha, who takes care of her despite her cold demeanor... Where will this relationship, initiated by Jeongha's whims, lead?

180269.description:
Se-Ra, who broke up with her boyfriend, whom she even thought about marrying, On the first day of my new job, I found the back of my boyfriend's head at my new job and quickly poured coffee on him. It turned out that the man I had never met before was my boss, whom I would have to see every day from now on?

An office romance comedy about Oh Se-Ra facing the biggest crisis of her life.

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

180270.description:
Commoner orphan Julia Arte is cursed with repeatedly dying and being reborn on the same snowy mountain trail. Now on her ninth life, she is determined to break the curse by getting revenge on her former lover Vasily Marjoram, who not only left her to die but sent assassins to kill her. After becoming the second lady-in-waiting to House Marjoram's sworn enemy, Prince Lewisia Ortega, Julia pulls out all the stops to take down Vasily. But will her scheming bring more trouble than she bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

180271.description:
The catastrophe we all knew was coming has finally happened.
Academy City’s #3 – Railgun Misaka Mikoto.
Academy City’s #5 – Mental Out Shokuhou Misaki.
Those special girls stand at the peak of prestigious Tokiwadai Middle School.

In a way, this confrontation may have been inevitable. This is a true direct clash between Level 5s, where rules, manners, morals, and taboos are meaningless. They will settle this once and for all, even if it means destroying the world as we know it.

Both Level 5s will draw on their full specs with no concern for what happens to anyone else.

When the #3 and the #5 wield their full power against each other with no restraint or mercy, who will ultimately win?

Note: Includes 1 prologue and 1 epilogue
synonyms: To Aru Majutsu no Index Gaiden: Ace Misaka Mikoto vs Queen Shokuhou Misaki!!
とある魔術の禁書目録外伝　エース御坂美琴対クイーン食蜂操祈!!

title.native: とある魔術の禁書目録外伝 エース御坂美琴対クイーン食蜂操祈!!
title.romaji: Toaru Majutsu no Index Gaiden: Ace Misaka Mikoto tai Queen Shokuhou Misaki!!

180272.description:
A terminally ill orphan is gifted a second chance when she is reborn into her favorite novel as Princess Isabelle Bilothian. Despite being born with a curse that will kill her at age 21, she eagerly embraces the opportunity to relish two decades with her loving family and friends. However, as she tries to cherish her borrowed time, the story takes unexpected turns, putting her in a series of dangers. Can she overcome these threats and make the most of her limited days to live in happiness?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Was Just Having Fun With The Time Limit
ฉันแค่อยากสนุกกับช่วงเวลาที่จำกัด

180273.description:
So-A knows that having a crush on a childhood friend can be complicated, but it’s even harder when he gets possessed by… the duke?! When So-A’s friend Yu-Seong is suddenly possessed by Duke Hereis De Licariel, they must figure out a way to get Hereis back home -- which is easier said than done when Hereis sounds like he came straight out of a fantasy novel! Can So-A get her childhood friend back while having to juggle academics, sports, and a duke who also happens to be a swordmaster?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
synonyms: 幼なじみは今日から公爵様!

title.english: My Crush Got Possessed by the Duke

180274.description:
For over half his life, Gye Neul has devoted himself to the Baekya crime syndicate, serving as the personal ashtray for Yong Inyeop, the boss's son. With a body marked by cigarette burns and a tongue stripped of taste, Neul has resigned himself to this cruel existence. His only solace is that Inyeop has never violated his body further. But one day, an order sends Neul on a business trip, forcing him to confront a bloody past.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ที่เขี่ยบุหรี่

180275.description:
"Face your destiny."

In the alternate realm of the Otherworld—filled with creatures and Earth's catastrophes—an ancient warrior, a human summoned long ago into the realm, is determined to bring it all to an end. Fueled by the resentment of an unknown past, this journey unravels hidden identities, embarks on undercover missions, faces death trials, navigates through betrayals, and wades through bloodbaths. What do the shadows conceal, and what destiny awaits in the heart of the unknown?

(Source: WEBTOON)

180276.description:
After a life of hardship as an orphan, Ji-A Han finally achieves the dream of homeownership... only to have her moment of jubilation cruelly cut short. While indulging in her guilty pleasure--a riveting soap opera--she experiences a sudden, piercing chest pain and meets an untimely demise. But when she wakes up, she finds herself not in the afterlife, but within the very drama she was watching and as none other than its villainess! In a realm where a glance sparks a scandal and a step triggers a landmine of emotions, what fate lies ahead for Ji-A?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: I'm Stuck in a Crazy Drama
Prise au piège dans un drama
泥沼系ドラマに閉じ込められた

180277.description:
Hitoshi Ishida is a high school student who suddenly finds himself living alone after his father's company goes bankrupt and his parents run away in the night. Unlike his older sister Yuko, who lives in a dormitory on a scholarship and has excellent grades, Hitoshi, who has nothing to his name, ends up living in a shabby apartment. But then, Watanabe and Negishi say they will live together in the shabby apartment to keep an eye on things...

(Source: CoMax, translated)

180278.description:
Joshua is an overworked, underpaid production mage for the prestigious Knights of Schwarz order.

When the order’s corrupted commander dismisses Joshua from his toxic job, he embarks on a quest for a new purpose. Along the way, Joshua's path intertwines with Illya, the princess of a Demon tribe, whom he saves from hunters targeting “demi-humans.” As thanks, he’s welcomed to the Demon tribe village. Witnessing their torment by the Demon King's army and slave traders, Joshua resolves to employ his production magic to aid them.

Get ready for a fantasy where the greatest production mage and his friends work together to craft a splendid nation!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Crafty Mage: Frontier Settling Made Easy
title.native: 生産魔法師のらくらく辺境開拓 ～最強の亜人たちとホワイト国家を築きます!～
title.romaji: Seisan Mahoushi no Rakuraku Henkyou Kaitaku: Saikyou no Ajin-tachi to White Kokka wo Kizukimasu!

180279.description:
A genuine pure gag romance battle about a rich high school girl who volunteers to drive a convenience store bread shuttle just to see her.

(source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: High School Girl at the Convenience Store

180280.description:
"Senpai, you’re adorable when defenseless.”

Yasuhara is a kind salaryman whose love life seldom works out. He’s strangely attracted to his popular junior, Kurose.
