When a female employee asks Yasuhara out on a date, Yasuhara decides to have dinner with Kurose as “practice.” He’s supposed to be learning how to be popular, but for some reason he ends up having a one-night stand with Kurose...!

180281.description: Lost World: Shikaban was originally drawn by Osamu Tezuka in the early 1940s when he was a middle school student, and differs from the professionally published versions of Lost World. The series was first publicly released in 3 limited edition hardcover volumes by Meichokan Kyoukai on February 28, 1982, and received a general release when it was published in 2 volumes by Kodansha as part of the Tezuka Osamu Manga Zenshuu colelction from December 14, 1994 to January 17, 1995.

title.native: ロストワールド私家版

180282.description: "How can I keep you from feeling lonely when I'm gone? I know, you can just eat me..." A tale of a twisted sort of kindness, and true madness.

title.native: 僕を食べてマイダーリン

180283.description:
Despite being born into a noble family, Claudia faced severe adversity. She was confined to a shed and taunted as a "Demon Child" because her eyes were two different colors. In an effort to secure her a chance at becoming the Crown Princess, her father devised a scheme. Claudia remained determined to prove her worth through the demanding training. However, her dreams are shattered when the Crown Prince abruptly cancels their engagement to marry the new incarnation of the "Maiden Light," the legendary figure that once saved the world. Prince Arwin, derisively mocking Claudia, almost drives her to take her own life. At that moment, Claudia is saved by the mysterious Margrave Graham, who not only asks for her hand in marriage but also brings her to his castle. However, as night falls, Graham’s dreadful curse begins to manifest…

“Did she see me in such a disgusting state..?!”

This marks the beginning of an ill-fated noblewoman and the cursed aristocrat's Cinderella story!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: Le démon et la jeune fille aux yeux vairons

title.native: 捨てられた令嬢は魔王様に溺愛される
title.romaji: Suterareta Reijou wa Maou-sama ni Dekiaisareru

180284.description: A promotional webtoon for the mobile game "Ragnarok Arena". Ran and Maruna fall into the world of Ragnarok Arena! Their special monster collection begins!

title.native: 僕を食べてマイダーリン

180286.description:
1. Yoru no Sei Janai (夜のせいじゃない)
2. Hanasaku Otoko-tachi no Cup Noodle (花咲く男たちのCup Noodle)
3. Fruits Kozou Fruity (フルーツ小僧フルーティ)
4. Tojirareta Rakuen (閉じられた楽園)
5. Himitsu no Hanazono (秘密の花園)
6. Sajin no Kanata no Chi (砂塵の彼方の地)
synonyms: Hanasaku Otoko-tachi no Cup Noodle (花咲く男たちのCup Noodle)
Fruits Kozou Fruity (フルーツ小僧フルーティ)
Sajin no Kanata no Chi (砂塵の彼方の地)

180288.description:
Compilation edition of various Shimamoto's early works published between 1983 and 1987 for Shogakukan.

The stories are collected in the following order:
1. Honoo no Tenkousei - Kaijuu Sentou! [ 炎の転校生・怪獣戦闘!, Blazing Transfer Student - Kaiju Battle! ]
2. Taiyou no Senshi Wind Breaker X [ 太陽の戦士ウインドブレーカーX, Warrior of the Sun Wind Breaker X ]; (September 1986)
3-7. Hotondo Hero [ ほとんどヒーロー, Hardly a Hero ]; (1983)
8. Koi no Shikaku ga Nothing [ 恋の資格がナッシング, My Love Qualifications Are Nothing! ]; (May 1987)

180289.description: Kakeru is an ordinary high school student whose only notable trait is his athletic ability. One day, a delinquent named Izumi transfers to his school. Kakeru finds it difficult to approach Izumi, but they end up being assigned to clean the school together...!?

180290.description: Originally published in the Weekly Shonen Magazine.

180291.description:
1. Seishun Shigai (青春志願)
2. Seitokaichou ni Koi Shicha Ikenai! (生徒会長に恋しちゃいけない！)
3. Koutarou-chan Aishiteru! (光太郎ちゃん愛してる！)
synonyms: 生徒会長に恋しちゃいけない！
光太郎ちゃん愛してる！

180293.description:
Lilia, the newborn daughter of a marquis, has the memories of her previous life! With cheat-like gamer knowledge, she aims to become the strongest girl in this new "other world"!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 0歳児スタートダッシュ物語

180294.description:
Jang Minju is a rookie anchor on the fast track to success, but not everyone believes in her. During an interview, ace PD Han Wook coldly states she's not what they're looking for. Minju thinks it's unlikely she’ll run into the smug PD again, but suddenly, he's popping up everywhere and pressing her to work with him! At the same time, Kim Sinwoo, a senior colleague, starts to show interest in her too. As these two men orbit around Minju, one question emerges – how do they know her so well?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: あなたの声で私を溶かして

180295.description:
Michael is an exceptional mage who has wanted King Albert's heart since he first set eyes on him. Because Albert already has many lovers, however, Michael decides to become someone more special to him: the king's one and only minister of magic. Although the king and minister traditionally sleep together to exchange mana, Michael refuses and even invents a machine for the purpose despite Albert's frequent propositions. But when Albert overuses his magic in a wartime emergency and falls unconscious, Michael has no choice but to take the more traditional approach to save him...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: บัญชารักใต้เงาราชันย์

180296.description:
Zany alchemist Rebecca O’Klein is far from a typical noble lady. At 24, she is still unmarried and spends her days cooped up at the workshop practicing her craft rather than attending lavish balls. Unfortunately, her eccentric lifestyle is jeopardized by her family pressuring her to quit her profession and finally find herself a husband. But who would want to marry “The Oddball Lady of High Society”? Enter Carlyle Rowinster, a duke who’s also reluctant to settle down. He suggests Rebecca enter a contract engagement with him, and in exchange, he’ll help her become the greatest alchemist ever!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: おてんば令嬢の婚約者

180297.description:
To save her noble family from ruin, Nadia Sordi agrees to an arranged marriage with a stranger. When she goes to meet her future husband, she mistakenly believes it to be a man named Yuri, who convinces her to follow him home. Meanwhile, Pyotr, Nadia's actual prospective partner, arrives late and finds the scantily-clad Katerina waiting for him instead. By the time the four realize they've each met the wrong person, they've already come too far to change...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: สุนทรียศ าสตร์เสน่หา

180298.description:
Narin and Danwoo are in an arranged marriage, and on their wedding night, they simply sleep side by side without any intimacy. Narin tries not to think about it, but she can't help wondering if she lacks appeal. One day, while exploring a bustling market full of curious items, she purchases a mysterious incense burner recommended by a vendor. The seller claims that lighting incense in it will instantly enchant whoever smells it. Eager to test it, Narin lights the incense, and Danwoo, inhaling its scent, feels an unfamiliar heat rising within him. Sensing the moment, Narin approaches him, only to be grabbed from behind by someone else. Turning around, she is shocked to see another Danwoo standing there.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: どっちが本物!?〜恋を叶える魔法の香炉〜
ใครคือสามีข้าตัวจริง?!

180300.description:
With her wedding ruined by the groom's secret girlfriend barging in, Kang-Wu crashes at her best friend Tae-Ju's place, not expecting to run into her little brother Tae-Hui in the morning. Despite their awkward first encounter, Kang-Wu finds him to be perfect little brother material. But after he protects her from her obsessive ex's harassment, she sees him in a different light. He's tall and good-looking, he's a great cook, he's funny, he's sweet... Wait, has Kang-Wu already fallen for Tae-Hui?!

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: 离婚后，我爱上了朋友弟弟
แทฮี น้องแทจู

180302.description:
Despite the barriers between them as servant and master, Dean and Lady Sarah have always been close, and lately, their relationship has been warming up even more. But everything is disrupted when Sarah’s family pushes her into an engagement with the wealthy and chauvinistic Count Van Der Sar, who only wants an innocent virgin for a wife. Sarah is determined to do whatever it takes to dissuade him from marrying her. Unfortunately, the ensuing love affair threatens to bring about not only her own ruin, but that of everyone she holds dear.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: พรหมจรรย์ ฉันให้เธอ

180303.description:
"Something is wrong with my body..." Tetsumaru is the personal bodyguard of Ageha, daughter of the Harukaze conglomerate family. He is a faithful servant, but recently he has been suffering from a problem: when he sees Ageha, his heart leaps out of his chest. This must be a symptom of an illness! Palpitations, shortness of breath, tremors in his arms and legs... In order to protect the young lady, he can't give in to his sickness!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

synonyms: While an Elephant Blushes, a Crane Dances

title.romaji: Zou no Haji, Tsuru wa Odoru

180305.description: Hotel Lobsterblue: A hotel that will appear to serve any guest anywhere in the world at any time. This strange hotel has the quality of drawing out strong emotions and experiences from one's memories... A heavy, unpredictable dark human drama set at the most curious of hotels!

title.native: ホテル・ロブスターブルー

180306.description:
Ma Dohee comes from a family of witches cursed to die a horrible death if they ever fall in love. Fortunately for Dohee, her ability read people's emotions through color has been enough for her... or so she thought until she met her CEO, Cha Taesung. Since the day she first saw him, she strangely can't stop her heart from racing. She tries to bury herself in work and avoid him at all costs, but he suddenly joins her team for a big project. Just what can she do to stop this magical attraction?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: It's Okay Not to Love a Witch

180307.description:
Nabana Saki is a newly graduated teacher at a public junior high school. Her job as a teacher at a public junior high school involves not only teaching classes and club activities to students, but also dealing with parents, researching teaching materials, and a wide range of other tasks. Then one day, Nabana decides that she must change the school. This story is a tale of "fighting" with the school that everyone has attended.

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

title.native: アテナの卒業式 中学校教師 菜花さきの戦い
title.romaji: Athena no Sotsugyoushiki: Chuugakkou Kyoushi Nabana Saki no Tatakai

180308.description:
Newlywed life isn't so great for the heroine who wakes up as Lamaine, the villainess in the novel "The Blue Flower at the Duke's Estate." Although Lamaine's husband, Cedric, is handsome enough to make her nose bleed, he is unfortunately in love with the novel's female protagonist and despises Lamaine. But Cedric must stay married until he inherits the family title, and promises Lamaine a future divorce and hefty alimony in return for her cooperation. Meanwhile, Lamaine uses her skills as a doctor from her previous life to help people around the estate, blissfully unaware that Cedric's frigid attitude toward her is changing...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: She's a Villainess, but Her Husband Is Handsome

title.english: I’m a Villainess with a Handsome Husband

180309.description:
Sonomi had great grades and a bright future... Until she started making doujinshi! High schooler Sonomi scraping by with grades in the 1-4 (out of 100) range, selling items at flea markets and part time jobs to support her true passion: producing and buying doujinshi! A cautionary tale of a girl who chooses to devote her life and soul to her otaku passions, as well as an inspiring chronicle of the great efforts young otaku went through in the world of analogue art production and promoting themselves in the early days of the internet.

Note:
- The first half titled Soko was published in Comic Box Junior from 2004-2005. An additional 4 chapters with a retrospective perspective were published in Zero Sum Online from May 1st 2015 to July 17th 2015

title.native: 腐女子になると、人生こうなる！～底～
title.romaji: Fujoshi ni Naru to, Jinsei Kou Naru!: Soko

title.native: 美来さんは見た目だけ地雷系

synonyms: [เรื่องสั้นต่างโลก] อลวนรักต่างดาว

180313.description:
Possessing striking features, a dangerously relaxed aura, and a flawless physical frame, Cha Junseo is the ultimate Alpha male. As a high-profile transfer student, he effortlessly commands attention wherever he sets foot.

Baek Doa, who is openly gay, is no exception to Junseo's hypnotic charm. The moment Junseo arrives on campus, Doa finds himself mesmerized by his commanding physique. When their eyes meet across the crowded room, Junseo casts a suggestive glance his way, making Doa's heart race at the unexpected stroke of luck. Unlike other men who treated him like a cheap toy, Junseo is in a league of his own, and he is actively whispering sweet words of temptation directly into Doa's ear.

However, the moment Doa surrenders to temptation and thinks he has finally won the prize, the illusion shatters. He wakes up trapped inside a cold, unsettling cage, surrounded by haunting photographs from his past. Standing over him, Junseo smiles with chilling tenderness:

"Do you like it? I prepared it just for you."

"You look so pretty, Doa... even prettier than I imagined."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hardcore BL Danpyeonseon (하드코어 BL 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [ハードコアBL短編選] 土佐犬の檻

180314.description:
Even if a musician dies, he never dies. It's just covered. Singer-songwriter Kim Han-Seok, who became a legend in Korea with just a guitar... Waking up as a college student in the streaming era 30 years after his death!

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

180315.description:
Princess Rien Digrit, plagued by a curse where her husbands die on their wedding night, faces betrayal on her sixth marriage. After being murdered, she reawakens on the day of her fifth husband's funeral. Now solely driven by revenge, Rien seeks the ruthless Grand Duke Clocean Ellagadar and agrees to enter a marriage pact with him. But as Clocean erases and alters their contract's terms, insisting she forget its existence, Rien questions his understanding of their arrangement. Is this truly just a contract marriage, or is something deeper unfolding?

(Source: Tappytoon)

180316.description:
Kang Hyeon, who was ashamed of his poor family, cut off ties with those around him and studied desperately to achieve success, but eventually he realized that his ideals were wrong. To make matters worse, Hyeon, who has cancer, gets run over while trying to save someone who fell on the subway tracks, and returns to the past while listening to the melody of a symphony. Hyeon, who was determined not to live the same life as before, realizes that he has tremendous musical talent...

(Source: Naver, translated)

180317.description:
“I will take care of you. I will do my best until you are happy.”

I was planning to find an investment company to expand my business, but the proposal sent to me and Jin Yi-young included information about 'contractual marriage'. The opponent is Koo Gyo-Heon, who is known for being an asshole. But it's not that bad of a deal. I thought they would just live as a show window couple, but this man. He keeps approaching me. Weren't we married by contract?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: อรุณสวัสดิ์ครับคุณภรรยา

180318.description:
Anyone can see that he is an ordinary job seeker and a well-informed person. An unexpected job confirms that the mediocrity that has been his lifelong complex is an area where talent shines, and he decides to become a killer. In the crisis killer industry, which is an ecosystem that is different from the common sense of the world, can an ordinary, ordinary killer informant really become the best?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

180319.description:
Co-workers 'Jeong Ira' and 'Gong Eun-Do' have drinks to console each other over their breakup and wake up together the next morning. Two people who went from colleagues to an ‘uncomfortable relationship’ overnight! What happened between us last night?!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: อึดอัดนักก็รักไปเลย

180320.description:
When Olivia stumbles upon a dangerously handsome man bleeding in an alley, she never expected her life to flip upside down. As a single mom dealing with her child’s chronic illness, romance is the last thing on her mind—until she locks eyes with Damien. He’s not just a CEO of a powerful pharmaceutical company, he’s a werewolf battling his own demons. Desperate to suppress his primal urges, he has turned to an experimental drug. Horrific side-effects are plaguing Damien’s life—until he catches Olivia’s scent. She might just be the cure to his fading strength. But can he find her again after their chance encounter? And will she understand his desperate plight?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

180321.description:
Lady Carolina, the overlooked daughter of a powerful duke, has always believed herself to be the black sheep amid her illustrious kin. Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation’s next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable “Bloodthirsty Prince” of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias. Determined to prove her worth, Carolina takes a bold step into a world fraught with both political and mortal peril. As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Forget My Sister! Turns Out I Was the Real Saint All Along!
The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Disgraced No Longer, I'm Finding Happiness with the Prince!
The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power Glossary

title.english: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Disgraced No Longer, I'm Finding Happiness with the Prince!
title.native: 無自覚聖女は今日も無意識に力を垂れ流す　～公爵家の落ちこぼれ令嬢、嫁ぎ先で幸せを掴み取る～
title.romaji: Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tare Nagasu: Koushakuke no Ochikobore Reijou, Totsugisaki de Shiawase wo Tsukami Toru

180322.description:
The crying, wimpy, and fastidious detective, Emperor Sento. His twin assistants, Hoshigui Right Hand and Hoshigui Left Hand, are cloaked in a dubious atmosphere. The detective agency “Night Owl” is willing to take on any request, depending on money and conditions. There is a girl whose organs have been stolen, a top dancer who has disappeared, and surrounded by money and a hint of violence, the Owl eats rats today.

Note: Based on the series of short animations on Youtube @hundrednote100, with each detective having their own channel.

title.native: ハンドレッドノート―ナイトアウル―

180323.description:
The story takes place in a world ruled by people who possess "Lua," supernatural powers granted by the gods. Ceska, a multilingual speaker who understands every language, attends an academy for the children of royalty and rulers from various nations. She also works as an interpreter. Meanwhile, Shiki, the prince of a nation whose people have no Lua and are called "Yaguu" and endure harsh discrimination, enrolls at the academy. Driven by a desire to befriend Shiki, Ceska actively converses with him, gradually closing the distance between them. However, a certain phrase uttered by Shiki triggers a massive shift in the world… This fantasy weaves its tale around Ceska, a genius linguist, and Shiki, the handsome prince of an oppressed people.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

180325.description:
Noa worships Ibuki of the popular idol group ILY as a god. A chance encounter leads to an unexpected miracle...?

"I'm sorry to be an otaku's love, but from today on, I'm going to be a special presence of a god idol!"
synonyms: Without Love, I Can’t Be an Idol.

title.native: 愛がなければアイドルできない

180326.description:
When Byletta asked her husband for a divorce, he said he will if she wins a bet...

Byletta, daughter of a viscount who has talents for swords and business, has been married to Arnald, son of a count, for eight years...however, he was away at war, and they hadn't met even once. When the war ended, she decides to ask for divorce even before she sees his face. She writes Arnald a letter saying "Dear Sir, I would like to ask for divorce."

Arnald, handsome but had never loved someone, and Byletta, who was rumored to be a villainess, meet for the first time in their bedroom. He asks for a wager, and guarantees her that he will divorce if Byletta wins. If he wins, they will stay married forever.

"If I can get you with child in a month, I win." Arnald says. That was something Byletta could never imagine.

(Source: BookWalker Global)
synonyms: To My Unfamiliar Husband: A Request for Divorce
To Sir, Without Love: I'm Divorcing You

title.english: To Sir, Without Love: I'm Divorcing You
title.native: 拝啓見知らぬ旦那様、離婚していただきます
title.romaji: Haikei Mishiranu Danna-sama, Rikon shite Itadakimasu

synonyms: The Rising of the Commoner-Origin Officer: Beat up All the Incompetent Noble Superiors!

title.native: 平民出身の帝国将官、無能な貴族上官を蹂躙して成り上がる
title.romaji: Heimin Shusshin no Teikoku Shoukan, Munou na Kizoku Joukan wo Juurin Shite Nariagaru

180328.description:
In a world where swordsmanship and magic clash, Durandal is born into one of the world's most prestigious swordsman families. However, his innate skill is "Absolute Memory." A skill that allows him to never forget anything he has seen or heard, but it was completely useless in swordsmanship where power is everything. Eventually, the banished Durandal encounters "magic," and starts to change the life he had once given up on!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Exiled Failed Swordsman Becomes a Sorcerer: "Absolute Memory," Which Was a Garbage Skill for a Swordsman, Is a God Skill for a Sorcerer!

title.native: 落ちこぼれ剣士、追放されたので魔術師に転向する　～剣士のときはゴミスキルだった『絶対記憶』は魔術師にとっては神スキルでした～
title.romaji: Ochikobore Kenshi, Tsuihou sareta node Majutsushi ni Tenkou suru: Kenshi no Toki wa Gomi Skill Datta "Zettai Kioku" wa Majutsushi ni Totte wa Kami Skill deshita

180329.description:
Nanami, a college student, fell in love at first sight with her new delivery man. Not only is he handsome, but he also has a toned body and a fresh smile that is irresistible for her muscle fetish. Then one day, a friend took her to a blind date and she happened to run into the delivery man again! Nanami's heart is filled with excitement, but he's not smiling like he does at work, and he treats her with a bad attitude..?!

A bumbling love story between a handsome delivery boy and an awkward college girl!

180330.description:
A battle of secrets between a misanthropic magician and a lying swordsman!

Tycho is a young girl trapped in the "Black Tower" in the court of Spania. She is suspected of being an apprentice of a great sorcerer who is said to know the art of immortality. Meanwhile, Glen, a close associate of the third prince, is ordered to reveal the truth to Tico, who stubbornly denies the allegations. Tico, a country girl, and Glen, a caretaker. Both of them have "true purposes" in their hearts, but they are caught up in the powerful darkness of the palace...?!
synonyms: The Sleeping Witch in the Black Tower

title.native: 黒塔の眠れる魔術師 囚われの娘と知られざる禁術
title.romaji: Kurotou no Nemureru Majutsushi: Toraware no Musume to Shirarezaru Kinjutsu

180331.description:
The once-great Madorim sect has fallen on hard times after being embroiled in the Great War of the Heavens. The sect's Supreme Leader, Ju-Rin, is now faced with the return of his long-lost grandson, the son of his daughter whom he had abandoned many years ago. Possessing the same otherworldly beauty as his mother, he initially appears to be nothing more than a pampered scholar, unfit for the world of martial arts. However, he is in fact the King of Mount Wumian, the very same man who defeated the mighty Yellow River Dragon King, one of the Ten Great Masters of the Martial World! Having returned to Madorim in order to fulfill his mother's dying wish, Jin Murin, the Mountain King now sets his sights on reviving the sect and restoring it to its former glory.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Suspicious Boy Is One of the World's Top Ten Masters
The Mysterious World's Greatest Martial Artist Little Prince

180333.description:
Top model Orina has gained weight from the side effects of her psychiatric medication. She is told that she'll be fired if she doesn't appear in Japan's largest modeling event "TLC" in two months, so she starts an extreme diet... but what is a "beautiful body?" What does it mean to love yourself? It's only after her body shape changed that she realizes the value of her own beauty. Find your identity and transform your life for the better, through the body image issues everyone has!

(Source: forcs, translated)

180334.description: Non-chan comes up with the idea of ​​gathering stray cat friends and starting a company that will clean up the town. At first, the residents are suspicious, thinking it's just the stray cats messing around, but seeing how hard they work, they gradually start to trust the stray cats.

180335.description:
Magical girls and villains are enemies, but can neophyte Tanpopo's bond with the villain Shade topple that destiny?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: 魔法少女ダンデライオン

title.romaji: Ano Ko ni Naisho no Vtuber!

180340.description:
That short's gone viral! A manga portrayal of life inside a super-popular VTuber group! VTubers are supposed to maintain a squeaky clean image. In their little corner of YouTube, they're free to do whatever they want... From money to sex to insider gossip, they'll tell you all about it! See the (real) life of VTubers at their limits!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: VTuber Aru: Toaru VTuber Jimusho Aru Aru
Viaru: Toaru VTuber Jimusho Aru Aru

title.native: ぶいある！ ～とあるVTuber事務所あるある～
title.romaji: V-Aru! Toaru VTuber Jimusho Aru Aru

title.native: しがないモブ令嬢なので、王子の求婚は身に余ります！
title.romaji: Shiganai Mob Reijou nano de, Ouji no Kyuukon wa Mi ni Amarimasu!

180343.description:
During a school trip, high school sophomore Nagi and his friends, due to an accident, are thrown into Kakuriyo. A place between life and death. To return to life, they must overcome the various trials known as "Festivals"

*A survival suspense inspired by the currently TBS-owned obstacle course TV show "SASUKE" (Ninja Warrior in other countries)*

title.native: 南さんはあざといい子

180346.description:
In a world where vampires exist, a special undercover agency keeps the rest of society safe by hunting them down. Agent “First” Shin is the best of the best. The only problem is he keeps losing partners, so he’s decided to stick to working solo. However, his manager has other plans, and a recruit is assigned to him. The new guy just won’t leave him alone, yet annoyed as he is, First also can’t ignore his model-like new partner. Is it his potential as a partner... or something else?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: デイズ(D:AZE)〜二人のエージェント〜

180347.description:
Working on 5 publications for 18 hours a day with no break, producing covers for every horror manga magazine, 1-night trips with horror mangaka, appearing at events wearing all black, fan letters containing snake skin, publishers going under, big loans, etc etc...

The mangaka who would be known as the queen of horror with representative works like Fushigi no Tatari-chan and Bukita-kun tells the story of her career starting with the journey to her debut, the height of her success, and her retirement.
The industry of the 1980-90 and the connections she made there are all laid bare.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Note: It also includes an illustration and photo gallery, as well as 2 previously uncompiled stories.
synonyms: A Memoir of Becoming the Queen of Horror Manga

title.native: ホラー漫画の女王ができるまで
title.romaji: Horror Manga no Joou ga Dekiru Made

180348.description:
"Do what your master wants, okay slave?"

After a lowly introvert has a run in with cursed magic, he becomes king of his high schoo! Now, those around him must respond to his every desire...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 6 volumes and 18 episodes respectively.

title.native: ハーレム呪術、解禁～底辺陰キャは王になる～
title.romaji: Harem Jujutsu, Kaikin: Teihen Inkya wa Ou ni Naru

180349.description:
Komoro Yachiyo is a college student like any other, or would be if not for her relationship with a married middle-aged man named Tsuchiya. The story follows her as she starts questioning her place in Tsuchiya's life, who sees her as an easy girl who he can use when its most convenient to him.
Yachiyo begins seeking love from her friend Aki amidst her doubts, adding more questions and complications to her already messy sexual life.

title.native: 私のアンブレラボーイ

180352.description:
27-year-old Mio Sakurada, who works for a confectionery company, enjoys her work and has a fulfilling life, but she has one problem: she has never been in love.

One day, Mio attends a blind date and is saved from a crisis by a stranger. When they spoke, he seemed surprisingly shy and awkward, but Mio liked the man who gave her courage. Later that day, he comes to Mio's company as a new employee. Mio is swept away by a younger man who is usually a 'shady' guy, but approaches her straightforwardly and passionately.

title.native: 陰キャな後輩は溺愛上手
title.romaji: Inkya na Kouhai wa Dekiai Jouzu

180353.description: Note: Published in Young Magazine Kakehiki 2024 No.1

title.native: 殺しと嘘のマリアージュ
お茶屋さんは賢者見習い
虐げられ令嬢とケガレ公爵〜そのケガレ、払ってみせます！〜
title.romaji: Shiitagerare Reijou to Kegare Koushaku: Sono Kegare, Haratte Misemasu!

synonyms: Love is outside the Ticket Gate

title.native: 恋は改札の外にございます
title.romaji: Koi wa Kaisatsu no Soto ni Gozaimasu

180360.description:
Eun-Ha, who was bullied in school, is haunted by her past. In college, she meets her worst first love, Gu-Reum, who has hurt her the most in the past. Gu-Reum regrets his actions and tries to apologize to Eun-Ha, but she flatly rejects him.

"Don't apologize to me. I'll always hate you."

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

180361.description:
1. Kumo no Namae (雲の名前)
2. Natsu ga Kureba Omoidasu (夏が来れば思い出す)
3. Kirei (綺麗)
4. Paris Ryokouki (パリ旅行記)
5. Pet de Gojaru (ペットでごじゃる)

180362.description:
After working as an assistant writer for 6 years, Kim Jinwoo couldn't endure the mistreatment any longer. In the end, he boldly threw the script at his boss's face and resigned! The aftermath? Well, it's either the talk of the town among high schoolers during the girl group music bank commute or while watching it live... Here I am, being a legend with this story...

Suddenly, a status window appears before me, and a hilarious drama story pops up in my mind! Yeah! With this ability, I can debut as a drama writer too! But... the place to write is randomly assigned?!

180363.description: A novice cook with a thuggish face joins a wizard’s restaurant! Novice cook Onijima, who was transported to another world after being run over by a truck, ends up working and living in a restaurant run by the strongest wizard in the world. A fantasy story about working in another world, unfolded with the help of a merry band of demi-human colleagues!

180364.description:
"Let me touch you more..."

Miku, who suffers from a fear of men, finds a cute cafe close to the new apartment she just moved to. The manager is super-beautiful and, for some reason, takes a liking to Miku and asks, "Why don't you work here?" By sheer coincidence, they're even next-door neighbours. Miku starts opening her heart to this kind and cheerful woman... Wait... Man!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Secret With the Girl Next Door
title.native: 隣のオネエさんと秘密の
title.romaji: Tonari no Onee-san to Himitsu no

180365.description:
During the Xiande period of the Great Zhou Dynasty, Lord Shen Wei of Jianxing was defeated at the Chashi River in the northeast, which nearly resulted in the loss of six central provinces. His son Shen Zechuan was taken to the capital in disgrace, despised as the son of a loser. Xiao Chiye, the youngest son of the Lord of Libei, rushed to the capital at the news, and nearly beat Shen Zechuan to death. However, the weak-looking Shen Zechuan fought back fiercely, and even bit Xiao Chiye until he bled. It was the start of a fierce feud between the two. Unexpectedly, during their endless conflict, they accidentally discover the real reason for Shen Wei's defeat.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

180366.description:
When the game world and merged with the blue Earth, a new era dawns. Zhou Yi was transmigrated to this world as a low-level rogue, but something wasn’t right about his skills. The Eye of Death: All damage is multiplied by five and becomes true damage? Now he's dealing 9999 with one flick of his knife? The Hand of God: Always successful at pick-pocketing., and you can even steal the monster's attributes and skills? Zhou Yi decides he won't just be an ordinary character anymore. See that boss-level monster? One-shot!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Solo Strike: A Hundred Million Damage, My Damage Is a Little Bit Higher By A Billion Points

title.romaji: Wo De Shanghai You Yi Diandian Gao

180368.description: A yuri manga about a handsome tomboy x a chubby married woman!

180369.description:
Used as an obedient puppet by her adoptive mother, the Queen, Sae lived without freedom and died without power. Sent back in time, she refuses to play the victim twice. Armed with knowledge of the past, she begins a cold campaign of retribution against the royal court. However, unexpected allies emerge to stand by her side, helping her realize she no longer has to fight alone. What began as a personal quest for vengeance transforms into an all-out rebellion against a pre-written fate.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 身代わりの女王、二度目の人生を救いたい

180370.description:
After Yuuto breaks the new video game console that his friend's older brother bought, his older sister offers to do anything to make things right, but she soon finds that she's getting more than she bargained for. For the little brother she loves dearly, an older sister let's her body be defiled.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: 弟の身代わりになった姉
title.romaji: Otouto no Migawari ni Natta Ane

180371.description:
A young man is kidnapped by two bandits while gathering herbs in the forest and awakens in a hidden land where he's the only male among a sea of beautiful elven maidens.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

180373.description: A freshman literature student moves into a new apartment next door to an art student from the same university.

180374.description:
I can only offer you, someone so far away whom I shall never meet, my most deeply held secrets, these feelings that make me toss and turn.

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

180375.description:
The recent graduate Yu Zhou has just joined the workforce, when she runs into the cool lady Su Chang at the hospital. The two immediately hit it off, and after some teasing and flirting, they eventually come to recognize their feelings for each other. But what Yu Zhou doesn't know is that Su Chang isn't only beautiful and well-off, she's also a highly acclaimed voice actress. How will the self-proclaimed ordinary girl "Xiao Zhou" ever be able to bridge the distance to the "Bright Moon"?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Xi Wang Ni, Zhen De Hen Kuaile

180376.description:
Jiang Moli, an ordinary woman working part-time jobs, finds herself transmigrated into a trashy novel as the story's villainess. The story's System actually wants her to give up her own life to help the main characters get together. So Jiang Moli tries to finish her missions by doing as little as possible, but for some reason this is making the Boss Villain look at her kinda strange? See how the doomed villainess seduces the man by being lazy!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: She Quits the Female Supporting Role in Melodramatic Novel
ハードモードな悪役令嬢だけどテキトーにやり過ごすことにしました

title.romaji: Gouxiewen Nüpei Ta Bu Gan Le

title.native: 俺の学校では毎週デスゲームが行なわれている
title.romaji: Ore no Gakkou de wa Maishuu Death Game ga Oko na Warereteiru

180378.description:
High schooler Nina Yamada is serious, studious—and the only girl in her class at a formerly all-boys school. She doesn’t exactly get along with her classmates, but she’ll work her butt off for a good college recommendation no matter what! So one day, when her teacher asks her to get the truant Murata to come back to school, she puts aside her reservations and braves the local arcade…only to find Murata surrounded by girls waiting on him hand and foot! Can Nina get through to this absentee playboy, or will it prove to be the one thing her hard work won’t help with?

(Source: Yen Press)

180379.description:
Emil is a healer who, because of a weird series of circumstances, is the only man in a party otherwise comprised only of women. Of course, as with all healers, his main weapon is a staff... His just happens to be made out of meat.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (EBWH-064) was released on February 20th, 2024.

title.english: The Only Man in an All-Girls Party
title.native: 女性ばかりのパーティにヒーラーの僕が加入した結果
title.romaji: Josei Bakari no Party ni Healer no Boku ga Kanyuu Shita Kekka

180380.description:
A senior whom you've been longing for, a childhood friend you met again, a classmate you didn't know you had, that guy at your favorite restaurant...

The unexpected heat of a single night's passion making feelings bloom.

Each story is an original creation by six popular and talented authors. A gem of an anthology for adult readers, where happy love begins with a one-night stand!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Included Stories:
1. 星のない海　―　おむ・ザ・ライス
2. マジメなココロを夜にほどいて　―　小雨
3. Choose me!　―　真宮りんご
4. マロウブルー・コンプレックス　―　春名ソマリ
5. トレフルショコラにくちづけ　―　青日晴
6. 君には酔わない　―　KUJIRA
synonyms: The sweet love starting from one night anthology

title.native: メロウ・ナイト 一夜から始まる幸せな恋アンソロジー
title.romaji: Mellow Night: Ichiya kara Hajimaru Shiawasena Koi Anthology

180381.description:
The way Hinata-kun is acting. Please don't get my hopes up like that.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: 628th BF Manga Seminar Silver Award Winner

180382.description:
At 10:00pm, after the first round of drinking is over and the streets become deserted, the “conspirators” appear. The salaryman Tsuzumi, who is ordinarily a man of discipline, meets... an enigmatic woman known as Kuroda, who tempts him with fine wine, fine food, and a mysterious beauty. It is an unhealthy way of life, a second late-night feast after entertaining. Won't you be a co-conspirator and come eat with us, because after all, guilt is the best seasoning?

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

180383.description:
Violinist Masumi Todo gave up her dreams of becoming a professional musician after failing at an international competition. Despite her disappointment, she kept playing the violin. One day she accidentally falls down a flight of stairs and finds herself lost in another world. In the midst of her confusion, she is captured, accused of espionage, and forcibly taken to the Knight Commander Arc to explain herself. Caught in a desperate situation, Masumi's destiny will be illuminated by the “violin” that has come to the other world with her…

(Source: Qurie, translated)
synonyms: After the dropout, my re-employment office is the Strongest Order of Knights in the Another World!

title.native: ドロップアウトからの再就職先は、異世界の最強騎士団でした
title.romaji: Dropout kara no Saishuushokusaki wa, Isekai no Saikyou Kishidan Deshita

180384.description:
Masumi has fallen off the road to stardom and now she earns a meager living playing the violin, her specialty. On her way home from a part-time gig, she falls down a flight of stairs and finds herself transported to another world! She is immediately captured by a squad of knights and accused of being a spy! Naturally, Masumi tries to explain herself to the Knight Commander, Arc, but his suspicions remain unanswered… until Arc notices her violin, and asks her to work as a “musician” for his Order of knights until she is cleared of the espionage charge.

To her surprise, Masumi finds herself in a world where playing music helps to restore magical power!

Masumi, with nowhere else to go, accepts the offer and immediately sets to work. However, she learns that the greater the knight's magical power, the more demanding it is on the musician's skill. And then she discovers that Arc leads a group of knights who have been shunning other musicians because they are the “most powerful” ones.

(Source: Over-Lap, translated)

title.native: ドロップアウトからの再就職先は、異世界の最強騎士団でした　訳ありヴァイオリニスト、魔力回復役になる
title.romaji: Dropout kara no Saishuushokusaki wa, Isekai no Saikyou Kishidan Deshita: Wakeari Violinist, Maryoku Kaifukuyaku ni Naru

180386.description:
Rui, grandson of the CEO, is handsome and successful. He has been in love with Tatsu, his childhood friend and now subordinate, since they were kids, but his feelings were never reciprocated. Rui covers up for Tatsu's mistakes at work in return for sexual favors, making Tatsu please him with his mouth and fondling each other in the office at night after every one else has gone home. Tatsu doesn't know much about sex between two men, but when Rui goes a step further one night, he begins to discover another side of himself.

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: My (Younger) Boss is After My Ass!
title.native: 俺の上司（年下！）にお尻を狙われています！
title.romaji: Ore no Joushi (Toshishita!) ni Oshiri wo Nerawareteimasu!

180387.description:
Lee Lina, resident of the dystopian world Tolka, plays the VR dating sim Raison D’Etre with the pain setting at zero. After her 99th playthrough, she is gifted a new patch for completing all the endings. However, as she begins her 100th game, and her favorite characters start acting oddly affectionate to her in an unfamiliar storyline, Lina wonders if the reward is more of a glitch. Will Lina be able to unlock a new ending before shocking news back in Tolka makes it impossible to ignore reality?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 100回目プレイヤーなので高好感度はエンリョします！
I Turned Off the Pain Perception Setting!
You Turned Off the Pain Setting?
ปิดโหมดความเจ็บปวดไว้แล้วนี่คะ
Developers: Welcome to Game Creation Swamp
Développeurs - Bienvenue dans le marécage de la création

title.native: デベロッパーズ～ゲーム創作沼へようこそ～
title.romaji: Developers: Game Sousaku Numa e Youkoso

synonyms: The Beautiful Shut-in Girl Living Downstairs Was a New Vtuber at a Major Agency.

title.native: 下の階に住んでいる引きこもり美少女は大手事務所の新人
title.romaji: Shita no Ka ni Sundeiru Hikikomori Bishoujo wa Oote Jimusho no Shinjin VTuber Deshita

180391.description:
The protagonist, Mayu, gets dumped by her boyfriend after repeatedly refusing to have sex. Though her friends reassure her that she shouldn’t force herself if she’s uncomfortable, her anxiety only deepens. Then, she begins to encounter others who carry similar scars.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Notes:
- Chapters 17 to 25 were not compiled for a volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

180392.description:
One day, Ji-O is horrified to witness his girlfriend, Mi-Ho, devouring human flesh. How could this be happening? He's struggling to understand the events that transpired when Mi-Ho killed his close buddy. Ji-O flees in panic, only to run into his friend—whom he was sure was dead—still alive. Ji-O grapples with doubt, struggling to maintain his grip on sanity. Is Mi-Ho really the monster, or is everything just a horrible nightmare?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: แฟนสาวกินคน

180393.description:
Gio, who came camping on the island with his family, decides to stay at the only inhabited pension due to a storm. At night, he feels uncomfortable due to the unfriendly staff of the pension and a murder case occurs.

(Source: Naver, translated)

180394.description:
Beloved idol Yoon-Jae Ahn, renowned for his impeccable charm and striking appearance, secures a coveted spot on a popular variety show, boosting his solo career. Just as he’s savoring success, his forgotten past resurfaces, threatening his celebrity status. Can Yoon-Jae shield his career from the looming secrets? With stakes at their highest, will his charm and unwavering determination prove sufficient to conquer the ghosts of his past?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

180395.description:
Noa has struggled with hearing unsettling voices since she was a child. But when a mysterious murder takes place, the voice in Noa’s head urges her to uncover the killer. With the police skeptical and her sanity on the line, Noa must navigate a web of fear and suspicion, guided by a ghost, to catch a ruthless killer before she herself becomes the serial killer. Will Noa uncover the murderer, or will her own mind betray her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

180396.description:
In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome… to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don’t judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary-- I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who’s out to find love! The problem is… everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in “kiss” or “kill”?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: สี่สาวชาวกี

180397.description:
The main character, Cha Ji-Ho, is an elite student who grew up with a mother who is passionate about education and never missed the top spot in the entire school. Even though all of her life plans went according to her mother's wishes, there was a boy she secretly had a crush on, and his name was Yu-Chan. One day, Ji-Ho switches his notebook with Yu-Chan's and discovers his great secret...

A life-scam marriage romance between a woman who realized that her life was short and a man who believed that she could save someone with her own abilities.

(Source: Naver, translated)

180398.description:
Someone stole my movie from the future!

A-Ram, who happened to go to the future, saw an impressive movie there and returned to make the same movie, but that work was a work for which Ga-Eun and U-Bin, who are currently film students, had just completed the script. A-Ram, realizing this fact, is obsessed with the desire to create her own work and tries to eliminate Ga-Eun and U-Bin. Ga-Eun and U-Bin fight against A-Ram to survive and to retrieve their future and precious works that were stolen by A-Ram.

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

180399.description:
Pointy ears, check. Furry tail, check! Here goes nothing—Nene’s life as a cat starts now!

A meek little mouse from the rodent island of Konoshima, Nene smuggled herself into the land of catfolk and arrived at Rairai Teahouse looking for work…but found it already staffed by ten older cat girls! Surrounded by pretty faces, sharp claws, and even sharper eyes, Nene’s ready to give work all she’s got—after all, she can’t afford to be one paw out of place!

(Source: Yen Press)

180400.description:
Edelweiss Millen, a transfer student who purely admires music. However, he struggles to maintain his fake identity after being threatened by his successor to pretend to be his successor if he wants to continue attending the music academy.

(Source: Naver, translated)

180401.description:
I met the naive me from 10 years ago.

“I will fix everything, our lives.”

Kwon Ji-Jae ultimately chose to die at the age of 28 due to trauma from a past incident. However, when she came to his senses, she returned to the past 10 years ago, right before the terrible “event” occurred. She comes face to face with her younger self... can she be happy?

(Source: Naver, translated)

180402.description:
Saiha has had the power to manifest blades from thin air since childhood. After an incident gives her a taste of the thrill of battle, she spends her days pursuing ever more powerful enemies in search of deadly challenges, as she becomes feared as a monster herself.

(Source: Shounen Jump Plus, translated)

180403.description:
Park Geon, who grew up as a great capitalist dog in an unfortunate environment, is humiliated by a mysterious man while working behind the scenes at a billiards game. Park Geon , who left his bitter wounds behind, infiltrated the casino to carry out a commission for assassination, which was his main source of income, and when the commission was completed, they were reunited in a place full of blood. With the mysterious man who brought shame to him. However, because he was holding a gun and not a pool table, Park Geon was easily overpowered and stubbornly made a suggestion to survive...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

180404.description:
'There exists a secret organization that uses geniuses with a desire to kill to monopolize power!'

Do Mado, a retired soldier who suffers from delusions of murder after serving in the war. At a mental counseling center he visits for treatment, he is handed a business card with a mysterious phone number, claiming to be the top genius in South Korea. When he presses the number, the counselor who connects gives Do Mado four options to choose the aftercare service he wants... 1. Assault, 2. Kidnapping, 3. Robbery, and 4. Murder.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

180405.description:
Yun-Oh is revered as a goddess by the whole department for her kind and gentle attitude, but her real personality is quite the opposite. While she was hiding her true face at school, her ugly side was revealed when she ran into her classmate Ui-Jin at a bar. She was nervous that Ui-Jin, who was popular and friendly with everyone in the department, might start a rumor. However, Ui-Jin says that he cannot remember anything that happened that day. Or is he pretending that he can't...?

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)
synonyms: 真逆な二人は惹かれ合う

180406.description:
A murder game to get 5 billion on a deserted island begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: 死にたがりのデスゲーム

180407.description:
Abandoned South Korean spy, his desperate revenge unfolds in a unified Korea.

(Source: Naver, translated)

180408.description:
A mouth-watering eating romance between Eun-Gyeom Yoo, the heir to a tonkatsu conglomerate who cannot eat tonkatsu due to childhood trauma, and Hye-Sang Dokgo, a poor civil service exam preparation student with an Engel index of 99% who eats a lot.

(Source: Naver, translated)

180409.description:
Hui-Do is going through a tough high school life. She enjoys reading webtoons in her spare time and dreaming of living like a character. Then one day, she finds herself in a real webtoon. She has to complete a mission in the webtoon and get a reward in order to save her deceased mother... Will Hui-Do succeed?

(Source: Naver, translated)

180410.description:
Mumyeong Heo’s grandmother passed away years ago. But when he visits her home to spend some time in the quiet countryside, he notices that someone kept it clean all this time. His new neighbors aren’t exactly thrilled by his visit. In fact, most of them don’t want him around. But that’s when his nasty neighbors go missing one by one… for better or worse.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: หมู่บ้านเร้นลับ

180411.description:
Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. Olive Charleterre was once a bright young debutante, until her spirit was broken by the emperor’s cruelty. Yet when Ludwig opens his eyes, he finds he has been sent back in time to his childhood. Whether he uses this boon to reclaim his lost love and forge a new path away from his villainous future -- only time will tell.

(Source: WEBTOON)

180413.description:
“Huh? You’re already 27 years old”.

The Saint Marialite’s engagement with the crown prince was called off because of her age! Due to various circumstances, the level-headed Marialite acknowledges this and returns to her hometown. She encounters a child raised in secret…? What's more, after growing up in a short amount of time, he falls for Marialite, and wants to take her back to his own country!

A romantic fantasy story about a level-headed saint who gets dumped for being in her late twenties and ends up living with the demon prince instead! The adored fantasy’s long-awaited serialization!
synonyms: The Happiness of the Old Miss Saint

180414.description:
The story follows a pair of adventurers: one who is an alcoholic and one who is a heavy smoker. The two enter ancient dungeons to embark on bounty-hunting and house-hunting.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Day Labor Dungeon of Alcohol and Cigarettes

title.native: 酒と煙草の日雇いダンジョン
title.romaji: Sake to Tobacco no Hiyatoi Dungeon

180415.description: With his eyes narrowed, wearing a kimono, and holding a tobacco pipe in his hand - the older guy I admire, whom I see every morning, is definitely playing around... Or so I thought, but in fact, he's incredibly pure--!?
synonyms: 神祕卻療癒的八雲先生

title.native: あやしい癒しの八雲さん

180416.description:
Fermat's Last Theorem. It is the greatest problem in mathematics, and has fascinated mathematicians all over the world for 350 years. In 1951, in postwar Japan, a young mathematician took on the challenge of the "Devil's Proof." His name was Andy Homura. His life and the history of the mathematics world were set in motion by the appearance of a great genius, a young girl named Lama. The proof that Homura bet her entire life on begins

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 神にホムラを ―最終定理の証明方法―
title.romaji: Kami ni Homura wo: Saishuu Teiri no Shoumei Houhou

180417.description:
The story begins one night in H-county’s Dabazi Village, where a floating corpse was discovered. After the villagers reported it to the police, Old Zhong and Zhang Kai came out to handle the case. The corpse was handcuffed and brutally murdered. Nie Yun ordered Old Zhong and Zhang Kai to solve the case within seven days. However, during the process, two other policemen died on the job. And when the critical witness who linked everything together was finally found, he has already been dead for seven days.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

180418.description:
With the help of everyone who loves manga, manga culture has blossomed. But now the manga industry is suffering from piracy. We need your help. Please read this manga, and let's create the future of manga together!

(Source: CODA, translated)

180419.description:
Saint Violet comes to the prison to save the Holy Knight ‘Lahart’ who has been corrupted by the demonic energy. Violet decides to save Lahart using the only healing method found in the old book. Lahart regains his senses with her help, but neither of them can easily extinguish their desire for each other...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Notes:
- Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Baedeong Danpyeonseon (배덕 단편선) Collection.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: [Immoral Anthology] Repentance of the Immoral Paladin
[A Selection of Short Stories from Betrayal] The Repentance of a Apostate Knight
[เรื่องสั้นรักสุดฉาว] ให้ข้าช่วยเถอะนะ ท่านอัศวิน

180420.description:
Straight-A student Yu Chu finds herself in the world of a fiction novel with her consciousness transmitted into the body of its antagonist, Zhong Ruan. Tasked with creating a new fate for the character, she is soon thrown into a romantic comedy as she begins to attract some male attention.

(Source: Manta, edited)

180421.description:
An observational comedy about an older man curious about the beauty products of a seemingly perfect girl(?!).

Kameyama, an ordinary salaryman, can't help but wonder what that pretty girl at the train station is wearing. That Milbon scent is lovely! Her glowing skin... must be some kind of treatment! Which brand's cosmetics is that? All of those "cute things" he used to obsess about, now appearing before him in person!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)
synonyms: Cute Girl I Saw at the Station Today.
Kyou, Eki de Mita Kawaii Onna no Ko.

title.native: 今日、駅で見た可愛い女の子。
title.romaji: Kyou, Eki de Mita Kawaii Onnanoko.

180422.description:
Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: Momose Akira's First Love is a Failure.
Momose Akira's First Love Is Coming Apart.
Akira Momose fracasa en el amor
Les premières amours difficiles d’Akira Momose

title.native: 百瀬アキラの初恋破綻中。

180423.description:
In a world where people's lives are controlled by "dolls," there's a boy who has been secretly rebelling against the dolls, meets someone who effortlessly slays the dolls and dreams of creating a nation for the people...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

180424.description:
Chishio was always losing at badminton to his incredibly talented childhood friend, Hibana. But during one of their matches, a sudden accident happens, and Chishio ends up winning! While he feels guilty, Chishio starts to realize that his desire for victory is even stronger than he thought...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

180426.description:
Seo-Yun Mun’s life has been a rollercoaster of heartaches—losing his mom, dealing with his dad’s cheating, and abandoning his beloved piano. But one constant has been his best friend, Yeon-Jae U. Surprise, surprise, Seo-Yun’s head over heels for him, but Yeon-Jae already has a girlfriend. What makes it spicy? Yeon-Jae is all about pushing those boundaries, blurring the lines between friendship and something… deeper.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: อาบแสงตะวัน

180427.description:
When gifted fortune teller Park Do-A dies, she transmigrates into the body of Bunnie, a curse absorber for the daughter of an archduke. As the new Bunnie, she befriends Demian, a boy prophesied to bring ruin to the empire. But when Bunnie reads Demian's fortune, she learns that, actually, he has the potential for greatness and prosperity, so she decides to shape him into the next emperor instead. Will these two be able to defy destiny and rewrite their futures? Or will the curse of fate prevail?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: 偽物公女は黒幕の運命をみる
วายร้ายผู้ขับเคลื่อนดวงชะตา

180428.description:
I'm falling for the servant of my lady's enemy!

Lady Ersetta refuses to marry the man her father has chosen for her and asks her maid Farmé to meet him in her stead. But Lord Ligieri, her hated enemy, sends his servant Angelo to cover for him as well! Turns out, Angelo is oddly charming and Farmé can't get him out of her head!

(Source: Manta, edited)

180430.description:
The story is set in a rural village where the locals worship a deity known as Futamata-sama. Emiko, a young girl who prays to Futamata-sama every day, dreams of going to a fashion school in the city. When she hears that her dear friend Kimi-chan, who shares her passion for fashion, is getting married, Emiko takes a decisive action.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
180430.hashtag: #わたしのまちのふたまたさま

title.native: わたしのまちのふたまたさま
地獄先生ぬ〜べ〜 百物語見聞録

180433.description:
Falling in love, sparkling, shining, and melting together…

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: シンカリオン ダイブ ザ ワールド

180438.description: Riko, a high school girl who loves Digimon, struggles with Agumon to restore the Digimon toys that have materialized!

title.native: デジモンリコレクション

180439.description:
“A villainess without blood or tears”

James Moriarty, the most fearsome criminal, met his demise after a confrontation with a famous detective at a certain waterfall. He found himself possessed by a beautiful young lady from another world, and what he saw there was the insidious abuse by other noble daughters. He has no memory, but his brain is still the same. He wields the power of his lucid mind and the perfect crime equation to the fullest for the sake of only one girl in a world without a great detective. The bullied young lady dies and is reborn as Moriarty, a villainess without blood or tears.

(Source: Comikey)

title.native: 未来の黒幕系悪役令嬢モリアーティーの異世界完全犯罪白書
title.romaji: Mirai no Kuromakukei Akuyaku Reijou Moriarty no Isekai Kanzen Hanzai Hakusho

title.native: お母さんを僕にくださいっ！？ 〜彼女の巨乳すぎる母親と種付けSEX〜
title.romaji: Okaa-san wo Boku ni Kudasai!?: Kanojo no Kyonyuu Sugiru Hahaoya to Tanetsuke SEX

title.native: クリスマスのお願いっ！？ 〜金髪ビキニのムチムチ巨乳美少女サンタさんとHな事をさせてください！〜
title.romaji: Christmas no Onegai!?: Kinpatsu Bikini no Muchimuchi Kyonyuu Bishoujo Santa-san to H na Koto wo Sasete Kudasai!

180442.description: A high school boy, Reiji, is saved by a Digimon, a biological weapon from the future... A battle that transcends time and space unfolds!

180443.description: Gankoomon, a holy knight-type digimon, comes to Haruka, a boy whose father has gone missing, as his substitute father!

180444.description: The Royal Knights are swept away by Wanyamon! A slapstick drama of loosely cute digimon and his friends!

title.english: Mini Digimon: The Story of the Royal Knights
title.native: ひらがなでじもん・ろいやるないつ物語

180445.description: A manga prequel of the web novel Digimon Seekers, focusing on a teenage Xu Yulin and her partner Ryudamon when Yulin was known as the hacker "Witch of the Crossroads" (三叉路の魔女).

title.native: タイマド ～タイムスリッパーおもてなし窓口～

180447.description:
Crime is ever-rising, a fact that police officer Shiro Isogai lives with every day. After the brutal murder of his fiancée, Isogai has been working tirelessly to find the killer. Suddenly, a “mysterious informant” begins popping up, helping the police locate serial killers one after another. Isogai knows this could be his chance for closure and decides his only hope is to team up with this person. But when it comes time to meet the secretive ally, he’s surprised to be face-to-face with a young woman, Kuroi Hinata. Teaming up with Hinata and her “sixth sense,” Isogai prepares to hunt the city’s deadliest criminals and find the clues he needs to catch his fiancée’s killer.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer
title.native: 今夜もシリアルキラーと待ち合わせ
title.romaji: Konya mo Serial Killer to Machiawase

180448.description:
Takamine-san has the air of a haughty girl, but she loves to play like an elementary school kid. Asuka-kun is burly and fierce-looking, but he is actually gentle and kind. The two enjoy playing old-fashioned games together, but every time, they inevitably end up in a heart-stopping situation...? This is a four-panel love-comedy with maximum joy, featuring two precious kids that you will want to watch over and protect!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)
synonyms: Takamine-san Wants to Play with Asuka-kun

title.native: 高嶺さんは、飛鳥くんと遊びたい。
峰家の双子は似ていない
ミアプラキドゥスより愛をこめて
title.romaji: Mia Placidus yori Ai wo Komete

180451.description:
Seven boys live under the care of Ms. Marge at Vamfield House. Their peaceful lives are shattered one day after they stumble upon a secret room...

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: DARK MOON: Los Chicos de Vamfield
ヴァンフィールドの子どもたち by DARK MOON

title.english: CHILDREN OF VAMFIELD by DARK MOON

180452.description:
"How did I not see her true nature? If only I could go back and change the past—"

Charlotte had been living happily with her kind and sweet stepsister, Cinderella. But one day, she is falsely accused of assassinating the king and is executed. The person who framed her was none other than Cinderella herself. Consumed by regret and fear, Charlotte dies, only to wake up and find herself back in the time before her death. Now, she vows to take revenge on her sister in this gripping, suspenseful tale of an endless loop of vengeance!

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

Note: An extra chapter is included

title.native: 私はシンデレラに殺された

180453.description:
From the one-shot of the same name that amassed over 1,580,000 views! A classmate who is always nonchalantly late to school, but his true identity is...?! The new serialized story of battles and oversleeping begins!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

180454.description:
Chou Yufeng, the CEO of a listed company, is unexpectedly sent back to the year 1983. Seeing his teary young wife and his despondent younger siblings who have just lost their parents, Chou Yufeng vows to make his mark in this new era!

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)
synonyms: Rebirth: Back to 1983 to Be a Millionaire

title.romaji: Chong Sheng: Hui Dao 1983 Dang Fuweng

180455.description:
Zuo Ying, a well-known crime-solving expert from Huanyang University, is accused of a crime by her own daughter Zuo Yang. On the verge of a death sentence, the court suddenly commits Zuo Ying to an asylum instead, while Zuo Yang is promoted highly for solving this case. Then, a series of mysterious murders occur in the city. Unable to solve the case, Zuo Yang is forced to ask her mother for help. Facing her once-loving mother with complicated feelings, her cheeks dripping with sweat. "My precious daughter, all you have to do is ask nicely, why don't you?" Zuo Ying looks at the newspaper in her hands and smiles. The handcuffs conspicuously shackle the prisoner, but who is the real caged bird here?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

180456.description:
Kaname, a college student, has been dating his handsome and athletic boyfriend, Ren, for half a year. His loyal younger boyfriend dotes on Kaname lovingly every day, but Kaname is worried that they still haven't had sex yet. When he tries to tempt Ren in every way possible, Ren just ignores the attempts... Until one day, when one of Kaname's friends tells him about a spell that would let him "fulfill his desire in dreams." When he skeptically tries it, he dreams of Ren doing all sorts of naughty things!?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 好きすぎるから早く抱け

180457.description:
Sylvia's past life was marked with nothing but relentless torture at the hands of her adoptive sister and husband. Regressed back to the moment she decided to take the fall for her evil sister's crimes, Sylvia is now resolute to reverse all the terrible decisions that left her in such abusive and toxic relationships. And it's at that moment she has a steamy run in with her ex's uncle!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: After breaking up, I had relationship with my ex's uncle-in-law
許婚の叔父と恋に落ちました

title.english: Live Happily Ever After With My Ex's Uncle
title.native: 分手后和前任的小叔HE了
title.romaji: Fen Shou Hou He Qianren De Xiaoshu HE Le

180458.description:
The happy and peaceful life of the innocent college girl Song Xiaoan is shattered when she is accidentally kidnapped and taken deep in the mountains. Thankfully there was the undercover agent Zhou Sihan there to help. Xiaoan thought that the policewoman would help her escape to safety. But she discovers that Sihan might be hiding something even more sinister…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

180459.description:
A new type of manga where you follow the story while solving mazes and puzzles. Join Shin-chan on an adventure to save Action Mask, who has been captured by the Quiz Demon King.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: クレヨンシンチャンゲームブック

180461.description: Note: Published in 22 parts on Kanabun's PixivFANBOX account

title.native: サキュバス3姉妹に搾り取られる話

180462.description: A series inspired by the real life german boys choir Tölzer Knabenchor

180463.description: "You got wet from watching other people have sex… You're surprisingly lewd." My sinful body is coming from my sleeping sister's boyfriend's touch…

title.english: Pretending to Sleep Can't Stop Him...
title.native: 寝たふりしても、無駄だから~姉の彼氏が私を夜這う
title.romaji: Netafuri Shite mo, Mada Dakara: Ane no Kareshi ga Watashi wo Yoru Bau

180464.description:
Falling to despair, going mad with pleasure...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2021-03

180465.description:
Having one girlfriend makes it hard enough, but two girlfriends gets messy. The solution? Turn your love triangle into a love threesome!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: This is a continuation of the Japanese CG Set “ラブトラ！” by Diletta. This story can be enjoyed as a standalone title.

180466.description: Extra chapters released separately in Comic Action to commemorate the release of the volumes.

title.native: 夜のまにまに 番外編

180467.description: A one-shot collection centered on the exploration of the sexual components of death and its inherent eroticism.

180468.description:
Struggling actor Yu-Myeong Shin has spent the last 15 years of his life trying to make it big, but has always failed to. After a devastating cancer diagnosis, he’s drowning his sorrows when a Yeon-Gwi, an acting ghost, appears and offers to send him back in time and with an added boost of life energy to start his career over. Yu-Myeong leaps at the chance and becomes a college student once more, running into Ryu-Shin Seo, his one-time rival. But this time, Yu-Myeong has the acting chops to back him up, and even Ryu-Shin will have to acknowledge him!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: ออร่าดาราอัจฉริยะ

title.english: The Aura of a Genius Actor

title.native: 吸血鬼作家、VRMMORPGをプレイする。～日光浴と料理を満喫していたら、いつの間にか有名配信者になっていたけど、配信なんてした覚えがありません～
title.romaji: Kyuuketsuki Sakka, VRMMORPG wo Play Suru. Nikkyouyoku to Ryouri wo Mankitsu Shiteitara, Itsu mo Ma ni ka Yuumei Haishinsha ni Natte Itakedo, Haishin Nante Shita Oboe ga Arimasen

180470.description:
Gloria wakes to find that she has become the infamous evil stepmother of a cute little werebunny?! She has mysteriously entered a fantastical world of knights and werebeasts, but not as its main character. Now, she must prove that she is not the terrible person everyone thinks she is. It won’t be easy, but she has help. The World Tree’s butterfly guardians will aid her in winning the trust of her new husband and stepdaughter.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Became the Rabbit Heroine’s Stepmother
I Became The Stepmother of The Rabbit Yeoju

title.native: 吸血鬼作家、VRMMORPGをプレイする。@COMIC
title.romaji: Kyuuketsuki Sakka, VRMMORPG wo Play Suru. @COMIC

180472.description:
Sell me! I'll be the most expensive lady to obtain. While scheming to get out of an arranged marriage, Cesare runs into Adele, a shoeshine girl from the slums. The two make a 3-month deal to help Cesare elude marriage. However, Adele is so different from the women he's met before that he can't help but be drawn to her.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: เล่ห์รักชนชั้นสูง

180473.description:
The hero is a high school student with the very odd name of Yubi Chizuo ('Finger Mapguy'). He lives in a cheap boarding house with a scummy river oozing by in front of it. The locals use the river as a handy place to get rid of their trash. Flies result. In abundance. The infestation gives Yubi Chizuo no end of trouble. One evening, a particularly large specimen buzzes up in front of Chizuo, and addresses him in fluent Japanese. Understandably shocked, our hero swats the six-legged prodigy flat on the spot. Chizuo finds himself haunted by the Ghost of the Talking Fly. And then he realizes that a mysterious black cat has started tailing him everywhere he goes...

(Source: Comipress)

180474.description:
A collection of Seiichiro Tokunami’s adolescent manga selected by Tokunami himself. Who knew the creator of Human Clock had written such a strangely compelling work! Includes a specially written autobiography, "Kyousei no Mangaka."

(Source: Ohta Shuppan, translated)

180476.description:
One morning, the author's husband, who used to be a " super salaryman ," said with a straight face, "I want to die." He was suffering from depression . This is a story about his life battling the illness together with his wife (the author), an unsuccessful manga artist.

The book depicts all events, such as suicide attempts, improvement, and worsening of symptoms, with a soft and smooth touch.
synonyms: My S. O. Has Got Depression
How Do I Cope with My Husband's Depression?

title.native: ツレがうつになりまして。

180477.description: A sequel to the hit essay manga "My SO Has Got Depression"—detailing the husband's situation as he's more stable as a stay-at-home husband.

title.native: その後のツレがうつになりまして。
title.romaji: Sonogo no Tsure ga Utsu ni Narimashite.

180478.description: The latest and the last book in the "My SO Has Got Depression" series, detailing their life seven years afterward. The road to recovery now that they have a child to take care of.

title.native: 7年目のツレがうつになりまして。
title.romaji: 7-nenme no Tsure ga Utsu ni Narimashite.

180479.description:
Ten years after being transported to another world.

It was more than enough time to awaken from what at first, felt like an exciting dream in a fantasy world. And on this 10th year Wasa Tooru finally decides to give up searching for a way to return to Japan, after being unsuccessful for so long.

It was then that he received a job offer — to be the bodyguard of twins who have knowledge of Earth.
synonyms: On The 10th Year, The Transferee Who Gave Up Returning Finally Becomes The Protagonist

title.native: 十年目、帰還を諦めた転移者はいまさら主人公になる
title.romaji: Juunenme, Kikan wo Akirameta Tenisha wa Imasara Shujinkou ni Naru

180480.description: A collection of Asumiko Nakamura's works, compiling BL oneshots written by her in through the last 10 years.  Includes "Haru no e", "Natsu to Fuyu no Deau basho", "Boku no Sukina nii-chan", "Hentai", "Boys Love", "Onshitsu no Kajitsu" e "Warui Otoko".

title.native: 超音速怪鳥パニックコンコルド

180482.description:
In the midst of his daily life in Japan, Tohru was suddenly transferred to another world. In order to find a way back to Earth, he worked as a solo adventurer, and before he knew it, nine years had passed. Now in his tenth year in this other world, Tohru has finally resigned himself to living out his life here. That is when he receives a top-secret request from the head of the Adventurers' Guild, who is impressed by his abilities. The job is for him to protect a pair of smart and beautiful twins, Yuufi and Merry, from Harlan, the man in charge of the trading company they had inherited! Tohru decides to help the twins, and it will put his honed skills to the test...? His tenth year of living in another world is going to be a lively one.

(Source: MF Bunko, translated)

title.native: 十年目、帰還を諦めた転移者はいまさら主人公になる
title.romaji: Juunenme, Kikan wo Akirameta Tenisha wa Imasara Shujinkou ni Naru

180483.description:
Nadia Lancaster is the youngest daughter of a humble baron, and a proposal from the infamous Duke Staton was the last thing she was expecting. Afraid to refuse such a powerful man in the empire, she is forced to accept despite the chilling rumors that swirl around him. Before she knows it, it’s their wedding night and her mind is filled with nothing but anxiety. Will Nadia be able to look past the rumors and give her new husband a chance, or does she found out that he really is a bloodthirsty beast and live out the rest of her marriage life in constant fear?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: เจ้าสาวอสูรไร้ใจ
野獣公爵に嫁いでみたら

title.english: Married to a Duke Called Beast

180484.description:
Detective Ju Hyeok's ordinary life is flipped upside down on the day the killing vote begins, giving citizens a chance to punish killers that evaded punishment. Gae-Tal, the mysterious figure controlling this system, claims it's justice for the forgotten, while Hyeok and his team try but fail to prevent the deaths. With the increasing number of victims and growing support for the votes, will Hyeok be able to catch Gae-Tal and stop this madness? Or will he have to witness the demise of true justice?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

180485.description:
1. Zouroku no Kibyou (蔵六の奇病)
2. Jigoku no Komoriuta (地獄の子守唄)
3. Madara no Tamago (まだらの卵)

6. Hebiya no Kai (蛇屋の怪)

1. Tsuge no Ki (黄楊の木)

A dark fantasy tale that takes place between life and death!! 
Rookie police officer Onikawa Rensuke with a brutal past faces off against monsters in another world where multiple red moons float in the sky! A battle between criminals and near-death warriors begins in the world between hell and the present world!!

2. Dare ka ga Kaze no Naka de... (だれかが風の中で…)
