5. Christmas (クリスマス)
synonyms: Dare ka ga Kaze no Naka de...

180495.description:
It is based on the work "ピクニックは終末に" which Takami Kazuyuki submitted under the name of "Enokino Hidehiko" (榎野英彦) to the 6th Dengeki Game Novel Award and made it to the final selection.

Each volume is an omnibus, with a different protagonist in each work. The story revolves around a boy and a girl who are guided by members of a mysterious organization called the Organization to visit parallel worlds, where they help to change those worlds from the brink of destruction to a better one.

title.native: 時空のクロス・ロード

180498.description:
Based on the erotic game by Astronauts: Sirius.

We live in an age where everyone is streaming. Dangerous video streaming, which is a way to satisfy one's desire for self-expression and approval, has become popular, and there have been a series of scandals across the country. Here at Toogami Academy, students have repeatedly caused scandals with their videos, causing a public uproar, and one teacher is assigned to the school. He is Masayoshi Yamato, an agent known as "firefighter" who specializes in scandals. Under the orders of the chairman of the board, he uses his penis to "educate" the female students who are repeatedly playing around with sex, and calm them down!

(Source: parabook, translated)

title.native: 艶嬢学園～【炎上女子】を指導せよ！～
title.romaji: Enjou Gakuen: [Enjou Joshi] wo Shidou Seyo!

180499.description:
A collection of the latest unpublished short stories from 2015-2021

The book contains the autobiographical story "Sodom 1985 (Parts 1 and 2, 2020-2021), which depicts the author's encounter with "Lychee Light Club" Grand Guignol Theatre play, plus other works filled with the struggles and growth of impressionable boys and girls.

The other chapters are homages to great works of literature and cinema: "Youth" (2015), originally by Tanizaki, "Death in Azabu-juban" (2018), in reference to "Death in Venice", "Female Student" (2018), originally by Osamu Dazai, & "Soma Kill Trailer" (2020)

title.native: 古屋兎丸短篇集 1985年のソドム

180500.description: One day, Yamato Onitsuka, an office worker, kills another man who attacked him. When he took that man's life, a sound effect rang in his head informing him of his own strengthening and the acquisition of a spell. He had become a "murdelizer", a being whose level goes up when he kills someone. Yamato Onitsuka resolves to survive even if it means killing people as and to keep on living he needs to kill someone within a week or he will die.

title.native: レベリング・マーダー

180503.description:
Their path marked the golden age of Japanese cinema.

In the Japanese film world shortly after the war, Natsumi, an interpreter, meets Negawa, an aspiring director.

The two end up making films together marking the golden age of Japanese cinema—

180504.description:
We tell stories and we are told stories. For whom?

A high school girl looking for a chance to confess her feelings to a classmate, a gunman who has lived by luck, a drifting cruiser, African people suffering from drought... everyone is waiting for a heavy rain. With the same wish, whose story is this at the end?

Three stories submitted to the 5th Torch Manga Award, "Waiting for the Heavy Rain," "Kojima's Pheasant," and "Business Negotiations," are now available.

The winner of the 5th Torch Manga Award, the Runner-Up Prize, touches on the primitive foundations of storytelling.

title.native: 収入源のわからない高身長独身美人
title.romaji: Shuunyuu-gen no Wakaranai Kou Shinchou Dokushin Bijin

180508.description:
PAVILLO grew up in the underground, where it is full of monsters. He came to the ground above, looking for peace. However, that dream was short-lived, as monsters started attacking him even here, and soon, people started calling him a hero...

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: Don't Want to Be a Warrior

title.english: I Don't Want to Be a Hero!

180509.description:
High school freshman Mi-So is enthralled when she sees her classmate Hyo-Jeong playing a retro handheld video game on the train. Hyo-Jeong’s always seemed kind of intimidating, but the way her eyes sparkle as she plays makes Mi-So want to learn more about retro games, and muster up the courage to befriend her. When Mi-So and her older brother Min-Jun head to the old video game store in their town, not only do they find that it's run by Hyo-Jeong and her older sister, they also discover a nostalgic portal to the past…

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.english: The Video Game Store Under the Barbershop

180510.description:
Noah is the sole survivor of the Venter family, who were known to possesses dark powers. When he arrives at the orphanage with his cute(?) teddy bear Chappy, there were monsters there, just waiting to engulf the children...!!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

180511.description:
The Demon Lord is defeated... and the world is at peace. But... he didn't make it in time....... Albus the Hero is in a hurry. The story starts over, and everything goes back, as it should, to where it all began. Time is of the essence in the repeating adventures of Albus the Hero, who remembers it all. Time is limited! Efficient strategy is key! When you recruit a priest to join your party, you have to be forceful! You don't want him to take things the wrong way. And before you know it, you'll be facing that dangerous S-class demon. Albus the Hero will finally claim his desired future in this ultra-fast real-time attack fantasy adventure!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

180515.description: Written for the 10th anniversary of Kodansha's Morning Two magazine, this one shot tells the story of a lady on the day she is destined to die.

title.romaji: Kyou wa Kanojo no Shinu Hi

180517.description:
Hatori is an ordinary teacher leading an ordinary life at an ordinary high school. One day, he notices that one of his students, Spica Tsumugi, is being bullied. On his way home from school, he ends up alone with Tsumugi in the rain. Hatori calls out to her, “Sensei will help you!" But Tsumugi gently takes his hand and says with a smile, “Hatori-sensei is such a liar."

Teacher and student… two people who should not get too close. The seductive girl that will turn Hatori's ordinary life upside down…

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

180518.description:
"XX is a cuck."
"I hear OO is a slut."
"I bet I can get her to sleep with me."

During lunchtime, all the juvenile dirty talk was giving Ogami a headache. He left the classroom and went to the gym's storage room in search of a quiet place where he could be alone. There, Ohgami saw Seri, another loner in his class, masturbating… or is she… urinating? Ogami tried to hide, but she had already noticed him watching. To Ogami's surprise, Seri suggests that the two of them can do something to “relieve stress” together…

(Source: Comic Doop'z, translated)

title.native: アオハルハラスメント

180519.description: It is a wholesome story about a bottom-tier masseuse (♀) who heals her female customers with her hands.

title.native: 底辺マッサージ師(♀)が女性客を揉みほぐして癒やす話
title.romaji: Teihen Massage-shi ga Josei Kyaku wo Momihogushite Iyasu Hanashi

180521.description:
I just wanted to watch a movie with my friend in my dorm room, but I accidentally put in a disc that turns out to be...... lesbian porn......!

(Source: DLSite, translated)

180522.description: A collection of short 1~4 page stories full of cute flirting girls!

title.native: おまえらのいちゃいちゃでまえがみえねぇ。

180524.description: Follows the story of a boy named Yuusuke, who encounters Robomaru, a small red robot with a rabbit-like appearance. After some repairs, the two become friends and start fighting against other robots in tournaments.

title.native: 宿無しエルフを拾う話
新・官能劇画大全 羽中ルイ 官能詩人・羽中ルイ作品集
title.romaji: Shin Kannou Gekiga Taizen Hachuu Rui Shijin - Hachuu Rui Sakuhinshuu

180528.description:
Seo, an ordinary classmate who had confessed to me before, turned into a super-popular pornographic actor!?
Distressed in the pink-collared tree who "never had an orgasm in bed", he's determined to ask Seo to help him practice comfortable sex. However, not only my body but my heart is also being messed up by him...

180530.description:
Lucianos is the head of a prestigious aristocratic family. Though considered quite beautiful, he is seen as socially awkward and unfriendly—which suits him just fine. Everything changes when his life is saved by the handsome gladiator known as Dominatos. Suddenly, Lucianos is filled with feelings he's never experienced before! Lucianos throws money at the man and meets him for secret trysts, knowing their social status further complicates matters. But when Dominatos decides to fight the emperor's favorite gladiator, will Lucianos lose the only man he's ever loved, or does fate have other plans?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Bowing to Love: The Noble and The Gladiator

180531.description:
A special anthology paying tribute to the works of Fusako Kuramochi. Including manga, illustrations, a short story, and a conversation between Kuramochi and Taku Tsumugi. Not to mention brand new side stories from Eki Kara 5-fun and Tennen Kokekko!

1. Prologue (プロローグ) [Fusako Kuramochi]
2. Nobuko to Aono (野生子と青野) From Eki Kara 5-fun [Ayuko]
3. Koufuku na Shokuji (幸福な食事) From A-girl [Yuki Andou]
4. Anata ni Aete Yokatta (あなたに会えてよかった) From Cheap Thrill [Ryou Ikuemi]
5. scene67.9 From Tennen Kokekko [Kazune Kawahara]
6. Eki Kara 5-fun episode#16.5 [Fusako Kuramochi]

8. Iriya to Haruto (イリヤとハルト) From Eki Kara 5-fun & Hana ni Somu [Haruko Kumota]
9. Shige-chan (シゲちゃん) From Tennen Kokekko [Karuho Shiina]
10. Kawaiku Naru no wa Taihen Nandesu (かわいくなるのは大変なんです) From Tennen Kokekko [Taamo]
11. Pocket ni Itsumo Chopin (ポケットにいつもショパン) From Itsumo Pocket ni Chopin [Aya Tsuge]

16-18. Tennen Kokekko Tokubetsu-hen scene 1-3 (天然コケッコー特別編　scene1-scene3) [Fusako Kuramochi]
