title.romaji: Kuramochi Hon: Kuramochi Fusako Koushiki Anthology Comic

180532.description: Nanase Ayane is a young single mother and an omega. Despite her difficult circumstances, she enjoys a happy peaceful life with her daughter Rin. However, the halcyon days come to an end when she once again crosses paths with the person who scarred both her neck and her life five years prior...
synonyms: I Don't Even Know Your Name
I Don't Even Know His Name

180534.description:
It was something strange, something that absolutely shouldn’t exist...
Madoka, a sixth grader, returned to the town where he used to live after three years away, during a summer in Kyoto. His reason for coming back was to see his classmate, Kazuki. But at Kazuki’s house, there was something clearly out of place...

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

180535.description: A story about a vampire boyfriend.

title.native: 君に噛みつかれて死にたくない

180536.description:
Runa has a crush on her kind and handsome teacher, Mr. Itsuki. But one day, she discovers his true nature-he's not the person she thought he was at all. Instead of the caring teacher she admired, he's manipulative and unethical. Now, her school days are filled with him teasing and tormenting her, and even though she knows she shouldn't take him seriously, she can't help the way her heart races whenever he's around. This is the story ofa complicated and forbidden attraction between a high school girl and her teacher.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

180537.description:
It's another idol competition!
A new star will be born!
When the show took the theme of choosing the new Ziwei Star, it caught the attention of the actual Ziwei Emperor in the heavenly courts, and he decides to descend to the mortal realm to enter the competition himeself. Soon afterwards, who will become the next "Ziwei Star" is the talk of the town!

In this competition, it will be a three-way battle between the management's choice vs the people's choice vs the choice of heaven. A fierce battle for the coveted C spot is about to begin!

(Source: Dongman, translated)

Note: Season 3 is a new storyline featuring a new main character. Most platforms have Season 3 as a separate entry from seasons 1&2.

180538.description:
The heart of all living things hardens and remains after the body dies. One day, a traveling merchant named Faris finds a girl collapsed in the desert and rescues her. The girl introduces herself as Eva, and Faris takes her to the oasis city of Aulof. As they walked through the town's streets, lined with villas, Eva gradually begins to trust Faris, finally telling him, "That's the house I ran away from." This is the beginning of the story of a girl carrying a "taboo."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

180539.description:
In a world where humans and insects are in conflict with each other, Mashiro heads for the mountains to eradicate the insectoid menace. There, he runs into a mysterious girl named Yuren, who lives with her mother on this hazardous hill riddled with bugs. Mashiro is shocked by this fact, but, perhaps, there is more to Yuren than meets the eye...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

180540.description:
Based on the erotic game by Pin-Point.

Kanade and Hajime were attracted to each other through their common hobby of movies. However, their peaceful adolescent life is suddenly changed when Matsuoka, who has a reputation for being a womanizer, starts messing around with Kanade. Kanade, who had stubbornly refused his advances, is caught off-guard and her weakness is revealed. Kanade gives her body to Matsuoka on the promise that it will only be for this summer, but she tries to keep her pure love for her boyfriend. However, she is unable to resist Matsuoka's blows, which are the first time for a virgin to feel such pleasure, and the purity of her mind and body are taken away one by one....

(Source: parabook, translated)

title.native: 夏休み明けの彼女は…～恋人未満の清純少女がセックスに目覚めてしまいました～
title.romaji: Natsuyasumi Ake no Kanojo wa...: Koibito-miman no Seijun Shoujo ga Sex ni Mezamete Shimaimashita

180541.description:
The world is plunged into an ice age, and 95% of humanity have been wiped out! Despite his kindness, Zhang Yi was betrayed and killed by the very people he helped.

But Zhang Yi is reborn with an awesome power – space manipulation! Given a second chance, he starts hoarding supplies like mad to prepare for the icy apocalypse. This time, he'll be ready to rule the frozen wasteland! He vows to bring vengeance on those who betrayed him in the past life!

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)
synonyms: Global Freeze: I Created an Apocalypse Shelter
Freezing the World: I Built a Doomsday Safehouse

title.native: 全球冰封: 我打造了末日安全屋
title.romaji: Quan Qiu Bing Feng: Wo Da Zao Le Mori Anquanwu

180542.description:
A girl who lives on the moon. A young man who swallowed a star. A high school girl who suddenly steps into the "night" through a gap in her daily life - short night time stories that are happening somewhere in the universe.

A compilation of four poetic short stories.

180543.description:
A tale of debauchery and lust running through a family.

(Source: POSTYPE)

180544.description:
This is an "after-story" about their honeymoon period.

Note: A booklet originally bundled with the Animate edition of the tankoubon.
synonyms: 君の夜に触れる アニメイトセット
Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru Animate Set
君の夜に触れる【20P小冊子】
Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru [20P Shousasshi]
Kimi no Yoru ni Fureru 20-page Booklet

180545.description:
Booklets that were originally bundled with the Yoake no Uta special-edition tankoubons.

1. A collection of short stories about the daily lives of Alto and Elva at 12-, 14-, and 16-year-old.
2. It was not long after Alto and Elva had met. Just before Christmas day, Elva told Alto to “go spend the day with family”. Reluctantly, he goes back home, but he is not sure what to do there…?
3. "Bon no Hanashi" Alto lends Elva a book recommended by a librarian, but the book is...!?
"Ryouri no Hanashi" The secret to the delicious taste of Alto's cooking is revealed!
4. The story of a (tentative) date between the two of them!
synonyms: 夜明けの唄 アニメイトセット

180546.description:
As an NPC stuck in the horror game, Charlotte sees a chance for freedom with the arrival of the handsome male lead, Dietrich. Desperate to escape, Charlotte aims to help Dietrich beat every level and unlock the final room. However, she is also forced by the game system to hinder him by obeying its mysterious and cruel demands. Can Charlotte's growing feelings for Dietrich break her free from her passive NPC role and escape the deadly game, or will her story lead to a chilling Game Over?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 主人公とホラーゲーム世界に監禁されました
Imprisoned with the Horror Game's Male Lead

title.english: Trapped With the Male Lead in a Horror Game

180547.description:
Why is the toughest girl in school trying to be my type?!

"My type? A girl with long black hair who carries herself well."

That's what I told my friends during a casual conversation about romance. The very next day, Shimizu— the blonde delinquent who sits next to me— suddenly shows up with her hair dyed black. From then on, every time I mention my ideal girl, she starts doing things she normally wouldn't— showing up to cooking class (which she used to always skip), packing me homemade lunches, etc.

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: The Delinquent Shimizu-san Sitting Next to Me Has Dyed Her Hair Black

title.english: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
title.native: 隣の席のヤンキー清水さんが髪を黒く染めてきた
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Yankee Shimizu-san ga Kami wo Kuroku Sometekita

180548.description:
The smile of an angel or the temptation of the devil? Monkey Punch invites you into his mysterious world!

(Source: Weekly Comic Action, translated)

180549.description:
Ren Kisaki has lived his life alone, writing novels from his wheelchair. Suffocated by help and frustrated by his perceived helplessness, he repeatedly pushes others away to the point that his caregivers have all but given up on him. That is, until the day newbie caregiver Rintaro Maki arrives on his doorstep.

The kind and perceptive Rintaro — who sees Ren for himself, not only his condition — offers a connection Ren had long thought himself incapable of. Pushing out of his comfort zone, Ren finally starts opening up... giving him the strength to courageously confront his past and pursue, for the first time, his own story.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.romaji: Boku ga Aruku Kimi no Kiseki

180550.description:
Matsuda Kei is a private investigator who specializes in quirky cases centered on his local neighborhood around the shopping arcade. He's recently taken on a new roommate (and lover) named Kamiko who is unemployed, ruthlessly horny, and was actually a classmate from his past. While the two work together to solve cases, they carry on in what starts as a strictly physical relationship... until Matsuda finds that this temporary situation he has entered with Kamiko might be turning into something more.

(Source: INKR)

title.english: The Troublesome Guest of Sotomura Detective Agency
title.native: 外村探偵社の招かれざる客

180551.description: Note: Part of the 2023 Postype Winter Anthology (포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

180552.description:
Believe it or not, it doesn't matter. But “that” did happen....... During the 1970s, in a certain prefecture in Kyushu, unexplainable phenomena suddenly started occurring in a peaceful rural town. Wild dogs, natural disasters, fatal accidents, strange noises, and horrifying hangings....... What in the world is "that"? From elementary school to high school, “I” have actually witnessed these supernatural incidents and the tragedies they caused. Don't you dare look away.

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

title.native: 首くくりの町 ～篠宮神社シリーズ～
title.romaji: Kubikukuri no Machi: Shinomiya Jinja Series

180553.description:
For years, the Celestial Empyrean defended the lands against Honkai hordes but she always refused to join the Springfest celebrations. Can her little companion find a way to return warmth to her heart?

(Source: Honkai Impact 3rd)

180554.description:
Amelia, who dreamed of becoming a great alchemist, worked hard to be appointed the youngest court alchemist in history. However, she was given an impossible workload and constantly got bullied on a daily basis. Finally, her fiancé broke off their engagement and she was expelled from the court....... After losing everything, Amelia must find her happiness in a new home, after reuniting with her childhood friend Thomas...

(Source: Comic Gardo, translated)

title.native: 元宮廷錬金術師の私、辺境でのんびり領地開拓はじめます！　～婚約破棄に追放までセットでしてくれるんですか？～
title.romaji: Moto Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi no Watashi, Henkyou de Nombiri Ryouchi Kaitakuhajimemasu! Konyaku Haki ni Tsuihou Made Set Deshitekureru n desu ka?

180555.description:
Amelia is the youngest person ever to be appointed the court alchemist. However, she is forced to carry an impossible workload, bullied by people jealous of her unparalleled talent. In addition, her sister steals away Amelia's fiancé, who banishes her from the royal capital! But Amelia is overjoyed to be finally free to live her life as she pleases. She travels to the frontier territory governed by her childhood friend Thomas. Surrounded by kind people, she begins a relaxed frontier life, totally different from the toxic environment of the capital!

(Source: Over-Lap, translated)

title.native: 元宮廷錬金術師の私、辺境でのんびり領地開拓はじめます！～婚約破棄に追放までセットでしてくれるんですか？～
title.romaji: Moto Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi no Watashi, Henkyou de Nombiri Ryouchi Kaitakuhajimemasu! Konyaku Haki ni Tsuihou Made Set Deshitekureru n desu ka?

180556.description:
A decade after the fall of Shin Oktaro, Frey, a back-alley thief, stumbles upon a clue to the sibling he lost long ago. But when Koo Ilyeong, the enigmatic CEO of SNT, crosses his path, a dangerous offer is made. Under the guise of benevolence, Koo dares Frey to earn his redemption, pushing him into a game where the rules are never clear, and the stakes grow darker with each move. What is Koo's true intent, and how far will Frey go before he's consumed by the shadows of his past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

180557.description:
While grading assignments, Heo Do-ahn comes across a piece of fiction written by Kang Soowon - one that was never meant to be seen by anyone. In it are tales about an intimate encounter with the department’s favorite, Yoo Sung-on. Do-ahn knows he must look away, but is drawn in deeper and deeper as the lines between fantasy and reality appear to blur…

(Source: Lezhin US)

180558.description:
Jun-Won is a perfectly ordinary office worker who values routine and predictability above all else. Because of this, he finds himself constantly aggravated by Yi-Jae, a fellow colleague who joined the company at the exact same time. From their work ethics to their basic personalities, Yi-Jae is the complete polar opposite of Jun-Won, making his very presence a daily source of intense frustration.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ขออนุญาตไม่จับมือแล้วกันนะครับ
เล่ห์ปีศาจ

180561.description:
Tommy is on the verge of being expelled after failing his graduation exam several times. He must pass this exam no matter what, but the monster he must defeat, Murtung, likes human bodily fluids the most...? While trying to escape from the creepy Murtung attack that is closing in on him, Tommy gets stuck in a wall, and a troublemaker at school named Pestle Big, who happens to be passing by, offers to help him pass the exam if he sucks his member just once. Graduation or chastity? Tommy stands at a crossroads in his life...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: 助けてくれ！〜壁に挟まった俺の前に生意気なアイツが現れて〜

180562.description:
In a world where one's secondary gender determines everything, social status is set from birth. Inu, an alpha from a low-income family, is desperate to secure a future among the elite. To guarantee his success, he resorts to abusing pheromone enhancers…but when the side effects temporarily turn him into an omega, his carefully laid plans spiral out of control. So when Hae-Yeong, a former classmate and a dominant omega from a powerful family, Hae-Young makes an unexpected proposal to cure him of his new-found issue, he has no choice but to consider it. Faced with a deal that could change his fate, Inu must decide how far he is willing to go to rewrite his destiny.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

180563.description:
My serenade, my Kieron.

During one of his conquests, the heartless Archduke Kieron discovers Melusine, a mermaid in captivity. Their bond deepens, but according to legend, mermaids must kill their lovers to return to the sea. Melusine cannot bear to harm Kieron and leaves instead. What cruel fate awaits the lovers?

(Source: Manta)

180564.description:
Noah’s a small-time pickpocket. He’s a bit of a slacker who’s never really had a steady job but when he hears of an opportunity to steal a rare diamond, for the first time in his life, he gets ambitious. With his new crown jewel, he plans to start fresh and escape his mediocre life. But things don’t go according to plan when two guys, who have it out for each other, both get involved. Noah’s really mashed up between a rock and a hard place. How the hell is he going to get out of this one…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

180565.description: While going home from his part-time job, Zen, a normal guy, suddenly got transported in the middle of the street of an unknown world. He met a silver-haired man who hid his eyes and learned that he's now in a parallel universe. Zen is a simple man—he doesn't really get what's happening but there's something called "Dom" and "Sub" and he's entranced by the man's glare. Now he can't get enough of his commands.
synonyms: こっち向いてグレア LinkRing編

180566.description:
Kang Tae-han, known as the Heavenly Demon (Cheonma), whose power once reached the skies, returns to his original life after 60 years!

“Wow… in such a blessed era, and my body’s in this state?”

“Your body’s screaming for help, but are you not hearing it?”

The physical and mental recovery project of the old-fashioned, grumpy(?) Heavenly Demon Kang Tae-han begins!! For the exhausted office worker drowned in alcohol and overtime, for the athlete whose body is broken and performance is failing, for the head of the family crushed under the weight of life, for modern people filling themselves with fat just to survive— All you weary souls of modern life, come get a massage!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Will Give You a Massage
ゴッドハンド天魔様～心の凝り、ほぐします～

180567.description: Cheol-Woong, who becomes a hopper player and notices the bout against the world. The night world now calls him like this. Madame Tinkerbell !!

180568.description:
Psychological abuse from parents is hard to make known.

Ever since she was little, Tsubaki had felt uneasy about these words and actions, but when she realized it was a threat to her life, she decided to run away from her parents. Choosing to live for herself. This book details her experience and the necessary steps she took to sever ties with them as much as possible in today's Japan.

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.
synonyms: To live, I ran away from my toxic parent

title.native: 生きるために毒親から逃げました。
title.romaji: Ikiru Tame ni Doku Oya kara Nigemashita.

180569.description:
A realistic and useful record of escapes by toxic parent survivors who abandoned their parents! By abandoning their parents, they were able to get their lives back.

Manga artist Ozoe Tsubaki, who also abandoned her toxic parents, interviews toxic parent survivors. How did they abandon them, and what did they gain from doing so? A comic essay on "how to abandon" toxic parents!
synonyms: It's okay to abandon such parents ~The escape records of a toxic parent survivors~

title.native: そんな親、捨てていいよ。~毒親サバイバーの脱出記録~
title.romaji: Sonna Oya, Sutete Iiyo.: Doku Oya Survival no Dasshutsu Kiroku

180570.description:
Asahi, the student council president who is smart, has a good personality, and is loved by everyone has a secret he can't tell anyone. That is to be "embraced by a man." He wants to have "experience" by the time he graduates, so he looks up a dating site but he gets found out by Hida, who always had an unfriendly attitude towards him! I know that he's just teasing me and thinking "I'm interested in seeing the real face of senpai who's always acting like a goody-two-shoes," but my body can't help but feel good...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 会長、イイコはもう終わり

180572.description:
Chan Lee thought his life hit rock bottom when he lost his office job. Then he started working at a convenience store connected to another world. With customers ranging from dog men to goblins and dragon girls, every shift brings new chaos. Between supernatural mishaps and late-night shifts, Chan soon builds an unlikely community of loyal regulars.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Convenience Store Worker From Another World
気づいたら異世界でコンビニ店員してました
ร้านสะดวกซื้อต่างโลก

180573.description:
After school, what secretly takes place in the clubroom is... a critique of canceled manga!?

I, Tsukimori Tsukasa, am a high school student with dreams of becoming a manga artist. I've made it to the final selection of the manga contest in the hugely popular manga magazine, Weekly Comet. So, every day, I find myself in the manga clubroom, agonizing over storyboards as I aim for my debut... but then there's Kotori Yuu, a younger club member with an unusual obsession for canceled manga, who is always poking her nose into my business.

"You know… it’s just that you have terrible taste. It’s like you're enjoying watching a death game from a safe distance, like some rich person entertained by the plight of the poor."

"No, that's not it! What I’m after is the beauty of the final moments! The aesthetics of a close call! The way the defeated live their lives!"

"You’re just an extremely bothersome person!"

The manga clubroom is, as always, filled with silly conversations.

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

title.native: 小鳥遊ちゃんは打ち切り漫画を愛しすぎている
title.romaji: Kotori Yuu-chan wa Uchikiri Manga wo Itoshi Sugiteiru

180574.description:
Hello, viewers! Welcome to the world of monsters, where certain people are awakened with specific characteristics and can become hunters. But our MC, Si-U, was awakened with absolutely no characteristics. How useless! Just when he'd lost hope... Ding! “Subscribe to gods' channels and get god-like characteristics.” Now, with the skills of the gods, Si-U, a used-to-be nobody, is making his name heard throughout hunter society. Like and subscribe to see if he’ll be able to pull this off!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

180575.description: Saeki Kaoru is the coolest girl in school, but she's also mysterious and intimidating. But in truth, she is just shy, and also have a crush on the meek Himura Miharu.

synonyms: シャラップ・アンド・ダンス

180578.description:
The widowed Evelyn Winter is the master of her home until Colonel Gilath Black, her scorned ex-lover and former servant, darkens her doorstep with accusations of treason. As Evelyn fights to maintain her rightful place as the duchess, Gilath, her once faithful and timid dog, lurks at every corner like a bloodthirsty wolf ready to pounce. But are Gilath’s actions driven by revenge or lust? Does the colonel seek to rekindle their old love or to ensure Evelyn’s life goes up in flames?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Bitten by the Dog I Abandoned
捨てた犬に噛まれた時
Khi Tôi Bị Chú Chó Tôi Bỏ Rơi Cắn

180579.description:
Han Yi-Yeon, a high school student with a genius talent who excels at all sports, is about to experience a new challenge: a table tennis pro who challenges him to overcome his weaknesses. Fueled by a competitive spirit, Yi-Yeon dreams of revenge with his vanishing "penholder" racket!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Penholder ศึกดวลลูกเด้ง

180580.description: Kim Tae-Seok, who worked on a construction site, receives a notice of passing the document screening for the major company El Sung. At the same time, a message pops up in front of him: 'You have entered the path to becoming a regular employee tutorial. Would you like to proceed?' Follow Kim Tae-Seok's struggle to become the legendary all-around employee in this corporate adventure!

synonyms: My Childhood Friend Seems to be The Main Heroine

title.native: 俺の幼馴染はメインヒロインらしい。
title.romaji: Ore no Osananajimi wa Main Heroine Rashii.

synonyms: Why Does Mrs Kuramoto Create Corpses?

title.native: 倉本さんはどうして死体をつくるのか？
title.romaji: Kuramoto-san wa Doushite Shitai wo Tsukurunoka?

title.native: ラスボス少女アカリ～ワタシより強いやつに会いに現代に行く～
title.romaji: Last Boss Shoujo Akari: Watashi yori Tsuyoi Yatsu no Ai ni Gendai ni Iku

title.native: ミントマンゴーかき氷
異世界コンビニのおっさん、実は最強。
title.romaji: Isekai Konbini no Ossan, Jitsu wa Saikyou.

title.native: ソードアート・オンライン IF 公式小説アンソロジー
title.romaji: Sword Art Online IF: Koushiki Shousetsu Anthology

180588.description:
"Tuberculosis" depicts the adventures of Kenichi and his uncle inside a boy's body.
After being injected with a drug called ZX that was discovered by Kenichi's uncle, Kenichi and his uncle have shrunk and become very small. When they enter the body of a boy and reach his lung, they find that tubercle bacilli (bacteria) are opening a big hole in the boy's lung. Tubercle bacilli send Mode (a tubercle bacillus), a daughter of Dr. Iyoa (also a tubercle bacillus), to Kenichi and his uncle to learn the human language. The two make friends with Mode, but a war breaks out between the tubercle bacilli and the commandos in the boy's brain, and the two become involved in the war.

(Source: Tezuka Osamu Official)

180589.description:
The talented thief Golden Bat is after the “Ruby Diamond”, a jewel belonging to the Duke of Sarada. Will he be able to get his hands on it?!

(Source: ogonbatter.web)

180590.description: Mika Hojo, a genius perfumer who has a rare talent for instantly sniffing out any scent. Today, she continues to heal the wounds of her heart with "fragrance" for various people.

180591.description:
Patients disappeared one after another from a mental hospital. Led by Drome, a wizard from Arabia, as president, the Yokai Club is a group of psychopaths, monsters, and ghosts, all of whom have been ostracized by ordinary people.

They take mentally ill patients out of the hospital and induct them as new members. Ken-chan, the nephew of the director of the hospital, Mr. Mustachio, infiltrates the Yokai Club and learns of their goal of turning the world's people completely crazy. Ken-chan escapes from the club and meets Sachiko Sarutobi, the girl they are after, and tells her about the plans of the Yokai Club. Sachiko has an abnormal constitution inherited from her ancestors, which allows her to use ninjutsu.

The Yokai Club creates a series of incidents that drive the people of the world insane. Drome's evil influence extends to Mr. Mustachio, but then Sachiko appears, and a showdown between Sachiko's ninjutsu and Drome's magic begins.

180592.description:
Based on the erotic game by Bishop.

Although Souichi is an average student, his father sent him to an elite school. Treated coldly by those around him, he finds comfort in his interactions with Ayana, the only person who treats him equally, but he soon learns that she is only being kind to him out of pity. His trust turns to resentment, and this is the trigger for Souichi to realize that he has the power to control others. Using that power - the ability to take control of human bodies - he sets out to make Ayana his own, body and mind!

(Source: parabook, translated)

180593.description:
Takara's got high school life made. He has a cute girlfriend, and he's got his nerdy but good friend, Saku. Unfortunately, there's just one tiny problem... He can't get it up when he and his girlfriend try to do it!!!!! All his other friends aren't helpful at all. Takara feels like he has no one to turn to for advice...until he realizes that Saku may know more than he seems to... At first, it was just the two of them "practicing," but then, one thing leads to another...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Shouldn't Have Come To You For Help!
title.native: お前に相談するんじゃなかった
title.romaji: Omae ni Soudan Surun ja Nakatta

180594.description:
Based on the erotic game by Bishop.

Yuugo, a physical education teacher at a girls' school, is teased by the students, and is especially bullied by Rikka, a young lady from a wealthy family. The only person who treats him naturally is Sayuki, a transfer student. However, as they become closer, Yuugo begins to have dreams about abusing her. He then remembers that he has the ability to control human bodies, and that Sayuki is the younger sister of a girl he raped in the past. He uses his ability to make the unsuspecting Sayuki kneel, and as the first step in his training and domination, he orders her to serve him in an impossible manner.

(Source: parabook, translated)

180595.description:
Based on the erotic game by Bishop.

Yuuji, a second-year member of the school's art club, is obsessed with the female body and strives to portray its eroticism on canvas. He is a genuine pervert. To hide his peculiarities, he hides his eyes with his bangs and behaves as inconspicuously as possible, but this is not the case within the art club, and he is looked down upon by Tsugumi, a cool, busty beauty and junior member. After school, he is engrossed in sketching and ends up staying alone in the art room when Suzune, a classmate, comes to visit him. Suzune, a former popular child actress and a lively, busty beauty, is friendly to Yuuji and, as the conversation progresses, she agrees to be his model for his sketches. However, the moment Yuuji becomes excited by Suzune and contemplates the desire to see her underwear, Suzune lifts up her skirt. Realizing his mysterious power, Yuuji decides to dominate Suzune and Tsugumi. Yuuji pulls his bangs up, which he usually wears down, and disguises himself in a delinquent-like outfit, making full use of a power he calls the ability to control the human body. Though the two resist at first, they soon succumb to Yuuji's relentless sexual techniques...

(Source: parabook, translated)

Note: The special edition includes additional scenes from the original game, including the capture of Miyako-sensei and the student council president, which were not included in the regular version, as well as a harem situation in which four busty beauties serve you.

180601.description:
A collection of unique SF stories compiled and edited by Shio Satou

1. The Brilliant Trees [Toto Akeru]
2. Adwoa no Michi (アジョワの道) [Tooru Shouda]
3. Egypt no Netsu (エジプト熱) [Yasuko Sakata]
4. Eros no Ago (エロスの顎)　[BELNE]
5. Wakusei Uni no Binan Bijo (惑星ウニの美男美女) [Toto Akeru]
6. Sagumi Ohno Neko Gurashi (相模大野猫暮し) [Aiko Ito]
7. Yoru no Atsui Te (夜の熱い手) [Mei Tokunaga]
8. Suito Monogatari (水都物語) [Yoshirou Hamada]
9. Yume no Hayate (夢疾風)　[Takako Hashimoto]
10. Emerald Garden (緑柱庭園) [Shio Satou]
synonyms: ラクシュミー吉祥花人

180602.description:
A story of healing and revolution around poverty, discrimination, and inequality.

In 1945, after a major war left the country in ruins and filled with homeless people, Japan implemented two policies to promote welfare and maintain public order. One was to rebuild Tokyo and create a new city called "New Capital Tokyo" [Shinto Tokyo]. The other was establishing "Special Zones for Public Assistance" (commonly known as Mantra Arya) where the government would guarantee food, clothing, shelter, and a livelihood to those who have difficulty living independently due to incapacity, illness, or disability.

In 2018, Fuka, a high school student who grew up in an ordinary middle-class family in the new capital of Tokyo. After she was deemed "of poor capabilities" by a national test, she received a "Special Zone Notice". This special zone only has a squat toilet and when using it, water must be filled into the tank with a bucket. No shower either. Water needs to be fetched outside the house and boiled in a boiler which occasionally runs out of kerosene. No tea either, the only drink available are beer and highballs. For her, who had somehow assumed that she would somehow be able to live and be somehow happy in this country, it was a bolt from the blue...

Notes:
- Rannked 11th in Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023.

180603.description: Anyone who approached Seungjeong, a ‘bitch born by eating her mother’ and a ‘cursed bitch’, became injured or seriously ill, regardless of whether they were humans or animals. Is this the work of an evil spirit or not? Seungjeong's last remaining hope lies in Youndang, an herbalist shop rumored to be haunted by monsters. Would it be possible to lift the curse there?
synonyms: The Moon that Rises in the Day

180604.description:
Having finally fled her troubled past, Hae-Joo enrolled late into the Film & Theater Department, hoping for a fresh start in college. She envisioned a future brimming with promise, but soon realizes she can't outrun her past forever. Caught between her childhood friend and her rekindled first love, Hae-Joo wrestles with conflicting emotions. Eun-Seok, her longtime friend, proposes a fake dating scheme to mask his own feelings and shield her from Jay's advances.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

180605.description:
"I'll do whatever you want, Mikami."

Kiri Mikami is a high school girl who's known as "little miss perfect" by everyone else at school. However, she actually has an obsession with innocent and inexperienced boys. She really is a normal (?) high school girl, even if she fantasizes about shy boys!

One day, Kasugai, the biggest playboy in school, directly asks Kiri out. Although uninterested, Kiri is very interested in Kasugai's stories of his first dating experiences. In exchange for hearing his stories... she has to kiss him. From that day on, the two of them begin a less-than-innocent relationship trying to recreate the scenarios from the books she reads about shy boys...?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Kasugai's XX With The Fantasy Obsessed Girl
title.native: 春日井くんは、妄想JKと××したい
title.romaji: Kasugai-kun wa, Mousou JK to XX Shitai

180607.description:
The Lowreis family was wrongly sentenced to execution for attempting to murder the royal family. As Linali Lowreis, the daughter of the family, is on the brink of death, she fervently prays for a second chance. Miraculously, she wakes up three years in the past, reuniting with her deceased family members. However, tragedy looms as her brother, Liam, is poised to attend the School of Poltis, the reason for the family's tragedy. She begs her father to send her instead of her brother, as she is better at sword fighting. Now, faced with a new identity and unexpected challenges, Linali must attend the School of Poltis in her brother's place.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Reason Why the Twin Lady Crossdresses
คุณหนูย้อนเวลามาเป็นอัศวิน

title.english: The Reason for the Twin Lady’s Disguise
title.native: かたわれ令嬢が男装する理由
title.romaji: Kataware Reijou ga Dansou suru Riyuu

180608.description: The boss, who lost his organization to the gangster Kang Tae-Poong called Black Ark, approaches his sister to destroy him.

180609.description:
Seven-year-old Rika Midou is sent to Sunny Bell Academy, a children's foster home. Neglected in single-parent household, Rika seems innocent at first glance, but the staff notices signs of dark shadows in her past. Various troublesome incidents start occurring. The director, Tokugawa, quietly observes the situation...! This is a shocking work that reveals the problems related to the care and education of abused children!

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

title.native: それでも、親を愛する子供たち

180610.description:
How far would you go for revenge? For the mermaid Sul-Yeon, the answer is simple: to the end of her world and into the land above. But in order to achieve her goals, she’s going to need legs. Striking a deal with a sorcerer, Sul-Yeon gets the transformation she desires…kind of. You see, magic is a fickle thing, and so once night falls she must return to her true form. Not one to let something like that get in her way, Sul-Yeon sets out on her journey. But as time passes, it becomes ever more clear that things aren’t as clear cut as they once seemed… Will she be able to go ahead with her original plan? Or will the tides of love pull her under…?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

180611.description:
So-ye is said to have married without love, but from the first night, she is ignored at home due to the attitude of her husband.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Baedeong Danpyeonseon (배덕 단편선) Collection. Chapter count includes a prologue.
synonyms: [Immoral Anthology] Please Leave the Door Open, Sister-in-Law
[A Selection of Short Stories from Betrayal] Leave the Door Open, Sister-in-Law
[เรื่องสั้นรักสุดฉาว] หัวใจของท่านพี่ เปิดรับผมทีนะขอรับ

180612.description:
The story is about Astor, who attends "Bagner's Adventurer Prep School", an institution that is established with the purpose of training the best adventurers. He is a hard worker with superior academic accomplishments, and also possesses innate ability. He is thought to definitely be selected as a prospective member of "Bagner's Official Investigators", but at the Arcana Judgment Ceremony, it is revealed that he has the lowest rank, 1☆, and so he is expelled from the school. Join a genius adventurer on his rising journey from rock bottom!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: The Dropout 1☆ Magician Unconsciously Uses Cheats Today As Well
title.native: 落ちこぼれ[☆1]魔法使いは、今日も無意識にチートを使う
title.romaji: Ochikobore [☆1] Mahoutsukai wa, Kyou mo Muishiki ni Cheat wo Tsukau

180613.description: Keita Amano, game live-streamer? Additional content from the Gamers! gang!

180614.description: The story of three street children, Chamcham, Stella and Ozaki, seeking to change the world tied to adult rules.

180615.description:
No cheats or special abilities!! A boy who reincarnated into another world aims to rise to the top with just effort and determination, starting with a single axe!! Reincarnated into another world, Kitori was a boy shunned in his hometown village as being possessed by a demon. With only an axe he received when leaving his hometown, he makes his way to Niergen, a shield city at the front line of adventurers' battles against monsters. Despite his lack of experience and skill, Kitori decides to live a harsh life as an adventurer to earn money for survival. While barely escaping death in battles with monsters, he is supported by his first companions and, through sheer effort and determination, charges forward to becoming the (physically) strongest adventurer!!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: キコリの異世界譚～転生した少年は、斧1本で成り上がる～
title.romaji: Kikori no Isekaitan: Tensei shita Shounen wa, Ono Ippon de Nariagaru

180616.description:
I, Luo Yinyou, am a three-year-old cutie-pie who has just descended from heaven. I've already lived two ridiculous lives (the second one barely even counts). In this third life, I've been hit with a vicious curse that won't let me live past the age of three. Luckily I have the help of a System, and I also have a “dad” who seems to be very powerful. Surely this will be the start of a happy (chaotic) life for me!

(Souce: Fanqie Manhua, translated)
synonyms: I’ll Pay for your Life, Let’s Both Go Crazy Together!

title.native: 我出钱你出命，我俩一起神经病
title.romaji: Wo Chu Qian Ni Chu Ming, Wo Liang Yiqi Shenjingbing

180617.description:
Hotaru Suzuhara is 34 years old. After her divorce and her father's illness, she started a new hobby of motorcycles. Until then, Hotaru had lived her life in a state of hesitation and uncertainty. However, riding her beloved Hunter Cub, she encounters new landscapes that she had never seen before. Her map is expanding rapidly.

When one woman takes off with a renewed mind, the world changes. This is a series of moving stories about the life of a motorcycle girl who also encounters various spectacular sights!

180619.description:
A high school girl Yoo-Young transfers to a new school. But, something is a bit strange about this school..? A mysterious sound is heard from the seat next to her and objects are floating alone.. "But this.. I think only I can see it... Could it be a ghost?!!" Yoo-Young, who was running away in fear, accidentally grabs the hand of the ghost(?), and at that moment, something slowly reveals itself. What could it be?! Or, a handsome male student??? His identity is an invisible man? But if I hold hands with him, I can see him? I want to live my school life like an invisible man, but how can I not? A school romance where the inevitable skinship between a man and a woman blossoms!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 15 side story chapters.

180620.description:
Eileen Hamilton’s brother, Stephan, is at a loss to find her a match. No suitor can overcome her love of reading or insistence on marrying for love. But Eileen has a secret—she’s an author of erotic romances, and finding a cure for her inexperience and chronic writer’s block is far more pressing than her prospects. Certain everything is ruined when her secret is revealed to her brother's friend Alexander, she’s shocked when he offers to help. How could she refuse her crush?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Les plaisirs secrets de Lady Hamilton
งานอดิเรกสุดวาบหวามของเลดี้

180621.description:
College students Han Ye-ji and Kang In-gyu, who can't study, one day become Superman and Wonder Woman. Their adventures take them to the planet Krypton.

Note: This story has no connection with the Marvel or DC Comics universes.

title.native: 真ゲッターロボ!! 異聞 Try to Remember
title.romaji: Shin Getter Robo!! Ibun: Try to Remember

title.native: 南くんのネコはじめました

180624.description:
“Sleep with me. Just this once?”

Se-In had an impulsive one-night stand with Shin Tae-heon, the department chief who's been her boss for the last three years.

He went away for an overseas work trip afterwards, but he started acting strangely when he got back.

"Am I the only one who can't forget that night?"

Just once isn't enough.

"Yun Se-In is the one I want."

(Source: Naver, translated)

180625.description:
Ha-Kyung, heir to the Joowon Hotel, is about to enter into an arranged marriage.

Three weeks before the engagement ceremony, I receive a marriage proposal. From a man other than the one I was to marry. He was my fiancé's younger brother.

“You can't marry my brother! ”

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 私の描くセカイは壊れている。
title.romaji: Watashi no Kaku Sekai wa Kowareteiru.

title.native: 神さまになりまして、ヒトの名前を捨てました。
title.romaji: Kamisama ni Narimashite, Hito no Namae wo Sutemashita.

title.native: 神さまになりまして、ヒトの名前を捨てました。
title.romaji: Kamisama ni Narimashite, Hito no Namae wo Sutemashita.

180629.description:
The "Forest of Death" divides the country into East and West and is feared by the people. There lives the eccentric witch Licorice, who succeeded her late grandmother, who was called the legendary witch. One day, the king's brother of the kingdom comes to visit her living in seclusion...?

This is a story of wishes and encounters between a witch who does not know love and those who visit her in search of medicine!
synonyms: The Witch of the Forest of the Death does not know the Love

title.native: 死の森の魔女は愛を知らない
title.romaji: Shi no Mori no Majo wa Ai wo Shiranai

180630.description:
A few years have passed since Gaoh became the new emperor of the Hakushu Nation. Bad rumors have gone around about Gaoh getting rid of government officials, and spending loads of money on lavish banquets, so he is feared as the "Mad Emperor". Gaoh is currently recruiting courtesans for his harem, and our protagonists Shushu has her reasons to become one. One day the palace, a government official tries to make a move on Shushu, but Gaoh comes to her rescue?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: An Apprentice Courtesan Escapes from the Lowest Class to Become the Bride of the Tiger Emperor
title.native: 最下層から逃れてきた宮女見習いは虎皇帝の花嫁となる
title.romaji: Saikasou kara Nogarete Kita Kyuujo Minarai wa Tora Koutei no Hanayome to Naru

180631.description:
Ryuji Mizuta, who works as a detective, is told by his former boss and father-in-law Ryutaro Yagura that he wants to become a detective after he retires. Mizuta tries to solve the mystery of a certain incident, but Ryutaro's deductions are always off the mark. However, when Ryutaro takes him to the sauna, Ryutaro begins to demonstrate his detective skills...

The story depicts Ryutaro as he warms up in a sauna, cools down in a cold bath, and takes a break on a bench as he resolves his health and mysteries.

title.native: 探偵はサウナで謎をととのえる
title.romaji: Tantei wa Sauna de Nazo wo Totonoeru

synonyms: Hello From My Home Where Cats Live

180633.description:
"I saw the killer... He was wearing the school uniform..."

A world where everyone has an identical face... ls it possible to find the killer among us?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

180635.description:
Yuma and Taku, who have been good friends since childhood, are lovers. Taku loves Yuma, who is always cheerful and energetic, but he has one problem: Yuma does not touch him when they are alone.

"Is it just because he is shy? Or am I not good enough?"

Taku is about to explode with dissatisfaction and anxiety when he learns a shocking truth! Yuuma is such a pervert that the more other people look at him, the hornier he gets!

"Even though it's wrong to do it in public, it feels so good..."

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

180636.description:
An everyday tale of drugs, cross-species sex, murder and cannibalism in an over-populated and famine-ridden future.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

Note: This work was published in English as part of the anthology "Secret Comics Japan: Underground Comics Now".

180637.description:
Taro is a dog lover who is overworked at a black company. One day, Taro got hit by a truck while trying to save a wolf-like creature that was about to get run over, and loses his life in the process. Taro wakes up in another world, and the Goddess gives him the right to be reborn as Fenrir, the strongest spiritual beast, with the power of a god. However, due to the whims of the Goddess, Taro is transformed into a cute (but powerful) creature that is "Fenrir" on the inside but "Shiba Inu" on the outside. He is sent to a humble princess who prayed to Fenrir, the divine wolf, believing him to be the messenger of salvation.

"Am I really that strong?" Unconvinced, Taro (Shiba Inu) sets off on an adventure with the princess.
But as they travel, his true strength is revealed.

The strongest doggy can steal away the skills of the opponents he bites, on his way to becoming unrivaled! A relaxed, fluffy fantasy!

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)
synonyms: I Was Supposed to Be Reincarnated as Fenrir, but No Matter How You Look at It I'm a Shiba Inu: I Became (The Strongest) Shiba Inu, and I'm Rising to Godhood While Getting Fluffed

title.native: フェンリルに転生したはずがどう見ても柴犬　柴犬（最強）になった俺、もふもふされながら神へと成り上がる
title.romaji: Fenrir ni Tensei Shita Hazuga Doumitemo Shiba Inu: Shiba Inu (Saikyou) ni Natta Ore, Mofumofu Sare Nagara Kami e to Nariagaru

title.native: 女神の加護を受けしママのサーガ
title.romaji: Megami no Kago wo Ukeshi Mama no Saga

180642.description:
Who is the fairest goddess of them all…?

This dispute eventually leads to a great war in the human world. Ithaca, a young, spoiled prince who had a sheltered upbringing, gets caught up in the great war between the gods and the scheming of nations. When his beloved mother is kidnapped, the boy must face the prospect of death and set out on a journey of revenge with the help of a goddess.

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

title.native: 天羽あまねは甘くない

180644.description:
Rumor has it that if you drop a letter into a certain Suggestion Box hidden somewhere in the Imperial City, a mysterious young man will come and help solve your problem.... This helpful young man is Roth, the butler of the Third Princess, who wields the most powerful magic as her protector. Together with Krell, his mistress, they will solve the case!

(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title.romaji: Dai San Koujo no Bannou Shitsuji

180645.description:
Roth is a genius magician who wields the world's strongest defensive magic. His job is to guard Krell, the world's cutest and most adorable little princess. One day, Roth receives a request to protect the “magic key,” a national treasure. The two set out on the job, but it soon develops into a major incident that shakes their and their country's fates...

"My butler will come save me, won't he?"

The master-servant tale between an ultra-kawaii princess and her sharp-tongued butler is about to begin!

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)
synonyms: The Third Imperial Princess's All-Purpose Butler

title.romaji: Dai San Koujo no Bannou Shitsuji

180646.description:
Today, the young ladies at Sosoritatsu Private Academy are holding a tea party. At first glance, they may seem pure and innocent, but the content of their conversation is nothing but outrageous dirty jokes...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
180646.hashtag: #このお茶会はお清楚ですわ

title.native: このお茶会はお清楚ですわ！～桃色お嬢様劇場～
title.romaji: Kono no Ochakai wa Oseiso desu wa! Momoiro Ojou-sama Gekijou

180647.description:
Uichi, once a happy and popular boy, is now the victim of cruel bullying. Then suddenly Yotsuba, his childhood friend and first love, shows up. How will this cute and kind-hearted girl try to help him...?

(Source: Weekly Shonen Champion, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter
180647.hashtag: #きみは四葉のクローバー #きみクロ
synonyms: You Are A Four Leaf Clover

title.english: You are a Four Leaf Clover
title.native: きみは四葉のクローバー
意味がわかると怖いモノ語り
title.romaji: Imi ga Wakaru to Kowai Monogatari

180650.description:
Mameda Wakatsu was a manager of Japan’s strongest “Ohka Basketball Club.” One day, he was recognized for his talent by a genius player named Aguro Hajime, and the two formed a partnership. To defeat Wakatsu's father, who is the coach of Ohka, the two of them raise their battle cry!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

180652.description:
A story about a boy with a really scary face who discovers boxing.

Note: Published in Shounen Sunday S 2022-09.

180653.description:
Darling is a carefree, cheerful, romantic, and flirtatious gentleman. The moment he appears, the fate of the underworld is set into rapid motion...! A fact its residents know, fear, and dread! Get captivated by this brilliant action-drama starring the underworld's top escape artist!

(Source: Manga Plus)

180654.description:
Fellas, is it normal for a girl to ask for baby twins on their 18th birthday? How about surprising you with a marriage certificate when your big day comes around? These are questions university freshman Yamada Junichi ponders after entering a relationship with a girl who shows her obsession—uh, "affection"—in questionable ways…

(Source: MangaUP!)

title.english: See Only Me Me Me Me Me…
title.native: メメメメメメメメメメンヘラぁ…

180655.description:
A certain girl genius with more power than knowledge accidentally summoned dozens of students and teachers into a dangerous world filled with beasts and magic, but the protagonist isn’t a student or the homeroom teacher… it’s the janitor.

At the time of their summoning, the students and teachers each gained a power formed from their soul, but not the janitor. As the janitor was about to be bestowed with a power that would protect him, his power was forcibly taken from him by an arrogant student. Having gone three years without a contract extension, he failed to get a job after having graduated from a third-rate university. Somehow he is still a contractor at 25 years old and was a janitor for 2 years, with a take-home monthly salary of less than ¥120,000. From a society that rejected him, he was thrust into a world that rejected him. And what janitor-san wished from the Goddess who took pity on him was…

title.native: 用務員さんは勇者じゃありませんので
title.romaji: Youmuin-san wa Yuusha ja Arimasen no de

180656.description:
The people of Genevu always pay their debts. So when peasant girl Claire throws herself under Marquess Balt Morenheitz's favorite horse, forcing him to kill the animal to save her life, she must repay him by spending a night in his bed. But Balt isn't satisfied with just one night and moves Claire and her family to live at his palace so that she can "service" him whenever he pleases. However, Claire may end up paying Balt back more than he could've imagined... because Claire isn't quite the simple peasant girl she appears to be. As Balt becomes increasingly embroiled in the empire's political mayhem, Claire's true identity will become a deciding factor in his success, or else a catalyst for his downfall. Whichever it may be, Claire will be sure to repay her debt before she leaves!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Korean.
- Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: The East Wind Of Atlas - The Marchioness' Scandal

title.english: The East Wind of the Altas

180657.description:
Party Gal x Serious Honors Student
A yuri love comedy. Limited time only!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

180658.description:
It's love at first sight when Estella, princess of the kingdom, meets Isaac, the margrave's heir. She pines and pines after him only to learn that he's already engaged!

Devastated by the wedding, she hears a voice calling to her, when she suddenly falls into a pond and loses consciousness. She wakes to find out seven years have passed and she's... married to Isaac?! Now, she has a collapsing marriage, two children, and a host of strange decisions to unravel and figure out why she ended up here!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Quand l'amnésie se mêle aux sentiments

title.native: 目覚めたら愛する夫と離婚協議中でした
title.romaji: Mezametara Aisuru Otto to Kyougichuu Deshita

180659.description: Doraemon explains how his gadgets work in detail!

title.native: ドラえもんのひみつ道具使い方事典
title.romaji: Doraemon no Himitsu Dougu Tsukaikata Jiten

title.native: 心が芽生えたアンドロイドさんと
私、社畜辞めて動画で食べていきます
title.romaji: Watashi, Shachiku Yamete Douga de Tabeteikimasu

180663.description: A school comedy featuring all the popular characters from the Wandering Witch series!

title.native: 魔女の旅々 学園物語

180664.description:
Born powerless in a family of water awakeners, Riarte Elheim was sacrificed for her twin brother and met an untimely death. Reborn three years before her tragic end, she vows to abandon the family that betrayed her. With Mikhail Virche, the cunning heir of the Virche family, by her side, Riarte begins a new life—but will her second chance lead to freedom or ruin?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: I Was the Real Owner of Elheim

title.english: I Was the Real Head of the House

180665.description:
Su Chengcheng, a broke girl, worked so hard to make a living, but life didn't treat her well. She got bullied by her classmates and cheated by her boyfriend, even her boss tried to harass her... When she hit bottom, a mysterious man showed up and claimed to be her personal butler. He told her that she was actually the heiress of the Su family, the richest family in the world?! In that case, she vows to get back at those who once humiliated her!

(Source: WebComics)

180666.description:
Lee Jeonghyo, daughter of a legendary S-rank hunter, despises dungeons. After quitting her job, she plans to open a cafe in a beach town to honor her late father. But stepping into the old motel she bought, she unexpectedly awakens as a hotelier-class hunter! Now, she’s juggling hotel management with aiding stranded hunters in her dungeon hotel. Things get even trickier when her old classmate and S-rank hunter, Han Wuhyeon, checks in. Can she handle the chaos while reconnecting with her past?

(Source: Tapas)

180667.description:
Jin Daim has no friends but likes drawing. Iljina is the most popular girl in school, even though she rejects every confession. Daim thinks she and her friends are an annoyance and disturb his drawing time before class, but all he ever draws is her. Things get complicated when his secret sketchbooks gets discovered by one of Iljina's friends.

Note: Originally self-published in Korean as "일찐로맨스" on Novelpia.

180668.description: A story about the twisted entanglement between a depressed, shut-in, has-been comic author, and another best-seller, Super Darling comic author.
synonyms: The Popular Mangaka and the Depressed Mangaka

title.native: 売れっ子漫画家×うつ病漫画家

180669.description:
Gods have descended upon the world, and Da-il's ready to drag them all to hell. After the lives of his loved ones were taken by the gods, Da-il offers his soul in exchange for the powers of the very killer of gods, the Void.

(Source: WEBTOON)

180670.description:
Achoo! Love is in the air - and it’s causing Ki Je-Yeon a real headache. As a dominant omega, she has the power to help alphas heal through a process known as “guiding.” The only problem is, she’s allergic to others’ pheromones. Luckily for her, she has her childhood best friend and recessive alpha, Cha Jae-Heon, to help her through all her symptoms! But wait, why is she starting to sneeze every time Jae-Heon’s around her now? That would mean he’s releasing pheromones, which would mean… Oh… Oh no…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.
synonyms: หอมกรุ่นรักจั๊กจี้หัวใจ

180671.description:
Back when tigers still smoked, a bear crawled into a cave and crawled out a woman, becoming the mother of the great ancestor known as Dangun. That is the story everyone knows, but no one remembers the others who left the cave too soon and scattered into the world, learning to hide their fangs behind human smiles. Seventeen-year-old Narae Lee is about to meet the animals that walk among us, quietly waging war on the spirits and creatures that everyone else believes were only myths.

(Source: WEBTOON)

180672.description:
A girl with glasses has her first sex that she cums many times.

(Source: DLsite)

Note: Released at Comiket 95.
synonyms: Studying Ecchi with a Literary Girl
Study♥Sex That Will Make an Intellectual Bookish Beauty Come Again and Again

title.native: 知的文学美少女とイキまくりお勉強♥えっち
title.romaji: Chiteki Bungaku Bishoujo to Ikimakuri Obenkyou♥Ecchi

180673.description:
Seula has endured a long-standing crush, thinking that being friends would be enough. But when she learns Areum has accepted her boyfriend’s proposal, she breaks down. To soothe her torn heart, she gets drunk and calls her, confessing her feelings. The next day, she wakes up naked next to Areum’s sister, Daun! When Seula begins to piece the pieces of what happened together, she begs Daum to keep this a secret from Areum, to which Daum agrees under one condition…

“Want to keep having a good time together?”

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
synonyms: Other Than My Friend's Sister, Something Else

180674.description:
Lady Solea's family can't figure out how she lost her memories or why she keeps raving about her "jackpot." They don't realize she's actually Yoon Jiyoon, a lottery winner who was suddenly brought into their world! Determined to return to her reality and claim her riches, Jiyoon sets off a series of shenanigans to send herself home. Yet when Solea's family proves more fun than expected and distracts her from the mission to leave, Jiyoon begins to wonder if family is worth more than a fortune...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Screw the Noble Life, I’m Going Home
Noble Lady or Whatever, I'm Going Home
公女とかどうでもいいので家に帰ります

title.english: Lady Solea Just Wants to Go Home

title.native: 地獄の釜が炊けました

180679.description:
When the Anglo Empire invades, a woman from the defeated country has two choices. Become the wife of an imperial citizen, or be killed! Beautiful women are gathered in the imperial palace to engage in a sexy and violent battle for the position of the prince's consort!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 妻か死か～敗戦国の女たち～
title.romaji: Tsuma ka Shi ka: Haisen Koku no Onnatachi

180680.description: In the 15th year of the Genroku era in the Edo period (1603-1868), Oran, a courtesan, and Shinzaburo, the young master of a money changer's shop, vowed to become man and wife if they were ever born again, and end up committing suicide. Three hundred years have passed since then. Harukawa Ran, a beautiful 18-year-old girl who is the reincarnation of Oran and has memories of her previous life, comes to visit Shintaro, the reincarnation of Shinzaburo. However, Shintaro is a lazy and extremely lecherous man who thinks Ran is a dispatched prostitute and steals her virginity. Having no memory of his previous life, Shintaro is puzzled, but the pushy Ran pushes him away, and a strange life together begins.... Can Shintaro regain his memories of his previous life and make Ran happy?　A heartwarming romantic comedy with a bit of naughtiness!

180684.description:
Ryouhei’s a simply country boy moving to Tokyo to begin his college education. Though he can’t find a place to stay in the dorms, an old childhood friend offers up a spare room of the apartment she shares with her boyfriend. It’s been a long time since they’ve seen each other. He was her first crush and he had his own feelings for her at some point. What happens when they meet once more?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Moving in With My Friend and Her Lover

180685.description:
The four sisters of the Wakaba family are all in the midst of their “first love” right now. The eldest sister, Kokoharu, is in love with a senior at her part-time job. The second sister, Manatsu, likes a guy in the Archery Club. The third sister, Akira, is interested in a club-mate the same age as her. The youngest, Chifuyu, likes a boy in her class. The four sisters, who are close friends, obsess over their love problems day and night. How do you tell someone you love him!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Wakaba-san Chi no Aoi Koi Bangai-hen"
- Includes sive extra chapters.

180686.description:
Chihaya Sakurazaka’s got one thing that sets her apart—her legs are as fast as the wind!

When Mio Koshimizu introduced her to track and field in middle school, a whole new world opened for Chihaya. Before she and Mio went to different high schools, they swore to be rivals for life and meet again in an inter-high tournament. But when the time finally comes, something unexpected brings Chihaya’s ambitions to a screeching halt…

(Source: Yen Press)

180687.description:
Authored by the up-and-coming RED Newcomer Manga Award winner, Hazama Chisato! Don't miss this thrilling battle between the unique characters who find themselves lost in the Cretaceous Period amidst fearsome dinosaurs!

(Source: Monthly Champion RED, translated)

180689.description:
Hiro is broke, jobless, and unfaithful—and Mi is absolutely smitten with him! After all, he didn’t dump her within a week, doesn't stand her up on dates, and even remembers her name. With the bar on the floor, Hiro can’t bring himself to be full-on scum like he usually is, much to his own confusion. A romcom about a guy who flip-flops between being sweet and scummy, and the girlfriend who adores him anyway!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

Note: The manga got licensed by Square Enix on August 17, 2024. Its first volume was published on October 22, 2024 under the Gangan Pixiv label.

title.native: 彼女がクズを愛するワケは。
title.romaji: Kanojo ga Kuzu wo Aisuru Wake wa.

180690.description: Mochizuki Mikoto, 21 years old, sales office worker! Her happiness as a gentle and soft-spoken girl is... binge eating!?!? She eats hearty, thick, mountainous portions of food without stopping. It's a devilish pleasure that can only be obtained by skyrocketing her blood sugar levels.

title.native: ドカ食いダイスキ！ もちづきさん

180691.description: Hisashi is a penniless young writer who relies on the kindness of shop owners in his area to eat. He keeps his bleak writings with daring scenes away from the eyes of his benefactors and his two friends, Gunma, the butcher’s son, and Shizuru, the fishmonger’s son. One day, the latter finds out, and Hisashi must buy his silence.

title.native: 貧乏作家の愛し方～今日はうまく笑えない～
title.romaji: Bimbo Sakka no Aishi Kata: Kyou wa Umaku Waraenai

180692.description: Note: The manga got licensed by Kadokawa on August 26, 2024. Its first volume was published on October 17, 2024.
synonyms: High school girl VTuber who clearly lies about her age

title.native: あきらかに年齢を詐称している女子高生VTuber
title.romaji: Akiraka ni Nenrei wo Sashou Shiteiru Mesukousei VTuber

180695.description:
Every few years, a human appears out of nowhere in the world of demons and monsters! You have to be careful with them—their stomachs can barely handle demon food, their bodies are fragile enough to break from a little fall, and even turning up the heat by a few dozen degrees will make them wither away...But they're also cute, loyal, and clever in a way une (dogs), nosa (cats), and eshig (rabbits) just can't compare! How could you not want to keep a human?

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: The manga got licensed by Kadokawa on February 19, 2024. Its first volume was published on April 19, 2024.

180696.description: Note:The manga got licensed by Square Enix on May 2024. Its first volume was published on July 22, 2024 under the Gangan Pixiv label.

180697.description:
Rokuriku Gakuen may seem like an ordinary private school. But for me, it is a very strange and mysterious place. The reason for this is because of “Strange.” Those who come into contact with it awaken to strange abilities. The main character of this story, Kouri Kamishiro, was one of them. Her Strange daily life is...

Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Takahiro Oikawa. I was best friends with Kouri. The reason I say “was” in the past tense is because I have already been killed by “Strange”....

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated) Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

180698.description:
In search of higher powers, first-year high school girl Shizuku Kazamatsuri joins the "Occult Science Mahjong Club," which uses supernatural arts to help their play! Will Shizuku be able to obtain the power she desires? Shizuku's "mahjong research" begins!

(Source: Kinma, translated)

title.native: エロゲと？？とワガママ彼女

180700.description:
This housewife is getting more than she bargained for with her new house remodel. She's getting hammered by the handsome young contractor free of charge! And just like most remodels, this one is going to require some long follow-up sessions and lots of hard decisions.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: ゆうきちゃん犬ごっこ

180702.description: Special chapter to commemorate the series' live-action drama.

title.native: シュガードッグライフ 特別読切

180703.description:
Based on the erotic game by POISON.

One day, the protagonist is suddenly hit by a car and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself sleeping in a beautiful woman's house. She - Mao Segasaki - tells him that her younger sister Mio hit him, but brought him to her house to cover up the accident, and asks him not to tell anyone, as she will make amends. The protagonist is enraged by her selfish excuse, but after threatening the sisters into submission, he decides to stay in the house, play with their incredibly beautiful bodies as he pleases, and live a life of bliss!

(Source: Parabook, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter in the digital limited edition.

title.native: 姉妹X調教～絶対服従、セレブ姉妹と毎日中出し性活～
title.romaji: Shimai x Choukyou: Zettai Fukujuu, Celeb Shimai to Mainichi Nakadashi Seikatsu

180705.description:
When a rift opened to another world, monster rushed through the portal, overwhelming cities as humanity faced apocalyptic ruin! Humanity was forced to take up cultivation, as every nation sought to cultivate powerful heroes to conquer the other-world for fame and fortune! The most powerful warrior of the Dragon Realm, who had slept for a million years, has reawakened with a million years' worth of XP and other resources that had accumulated during his slumber. Now even the most powerful other-world Boss will tremble in fear, and all the Tier 0 heroes from across the world will kneel in respect…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: I Awoke as a God After Auto Battling For a Million Years
Idle Player Returns as a God
After Millions of Year’s I Woke Up To Be A God!

title.native: 网游：挂机百万年，我醒来成神
title.romaji: Wang You: Gua Ji Baiwan Nian, Wo Xinglai Cheng Shen

180706.description: A novel based on the fairy environment simulation game Pixy Garden. The protagonist, Li Chao, a fairy hunter, meets the fairy Parparash and became entranced, and they end up fleeing pursuers together.

synonyms: Cherry Hero and the Holy Sword

title.native: チェリー勇者と"せい"なる剣

180708.description:
In the city of Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, the "Mibu Roshigumi," a group of samurai from Mito, was charged with maintaining public order amidst the conflict between the Kinno (royalist) and the Sabaku (shogunate) factions. When the Mito-born Serizawa Kamo and his subordinates behaved badly, Isamu Kondo and his followers from Bushu are ordered to kill Serizawa.

The Mibu Roshigumi, after killing Serizawa, was granted an official name by the Imperial Court, and the legendary "Shinsengumi" was born!

The lives of the men who devoted their lives to the bushido, as portrayed by the master mangaka, Takao Saito, depicted in the realistic jidaigeki style!

(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)

Note: Originally published as two single-volume supplementals in the Ran Twins magazine.

180709.description:
In a world where same-sex marriage is legal, 28-year-old bachelor Mashiro Kotobuki has built a reputation as a top-notch matchmaker at Mari's, a leading marriage agency. Despite his knack for helping others find love, Mashiro actually has no romantic experience of his own! The CEO, his mother, is constantly on his case about settling down. One day, Kaede Narita, his average Joe coworker, walks in during a nagging session and—out of desperation—Mashiro blurts out that they're dating! Mashiro is then left on the fence when he is offered the chance to head a new same-sex marriage agency if he can actually tie the knot. From there, the two pretend to be in a chaotic "fake marriage," but it appears that Kaede is hiding something...

(Source: Gentosha, translated and edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: これは嘘の結婚だから
title.romaji: Kore wa Uso no Kekkon Dakara

180711.description: Based on the erotic game by POISON.

title.native: 姉姉W催眠～催眠装置で巨乳姉どもに強制中出し、鬼畜寝取りで孕ませてやる！～
title.romaji: Ane Ane W Saimin: Saimin Souchi de Kyonyuu Anedomo ni Kyousei Nakadashi, Kichiku Netori de Haramasete yaru!

180712.description:
Rick, a member of the "Yarisa" (Spear Club), an adventurer group for spear users, awakens to a perverse skill called "Lust," which increases his combat abilities when he engages in erotic activities. As a result of becoming the only one who becomes incredibly popular, the club is on the verge of collapse, and Rick is expelled by the leader! Rick's solo adventure life begins...!?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)
synonyms: Shikiyoku Musou: Hentai Skill ga Bousou Shite Yari Circle kara Tsuihou Sareta Ore wa, Hakarazumo Inbi na Chikara de Saikyou ni Naru

title.native: 色欲無双～変態スキルが暴走してヤリサーから追放された俺は、はからずも淫靡な力で最強になる～
title.romaji: Shikiyoku Musou: Hentai Skill ga Bousou Shite Yarisaa kara Tsuihou Sareta Ore wa, Hakarazumo Inbi na Chikara de Saikyou ni Naru

180713.description:
Eat Or Die!

The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he’s searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, “You have promise. Become my apprentice.” How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there’s a secret that only she knows, and that he’s stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn’t end things; no, it’s only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: How I Became King by Eating Monsters
title.native: モンスターの肉を食っていたら王位に就いた件
title.romaji: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken

180717.description:
Childhood friends Kurashiki Yori and Tsukimizato Yayoi reunite after 10 years. Yayoi is an obsessive boy who never forgot a promise they made as children, and gets jealous when Yori supports her favorite idol.

(Source: LaLaDX, translated)

180718.description: One of America's top generals has been kidnapped by a terrorist group in Saudi Arabia. In order to rescue him, "Cannonball" Nanjo and four other mercenaries must find the "Parrot House" where he is being held. There are only two days left before the deadline to pay the terrorist group's ransom of 50-million dollars. Nanjo and his team must hurry, but there is a traitor in their midst!

title.native: キャノンボール奴らの戦場

180719.description:
Based on the erotic game by POISON.

Ken, who studies psychology at university, lives his life being despised like dirt by his older sister Sayaka and younger sister Reika. One day, he brings home some "hypnosis cards" that he has been researching. When he combines the "symbols" depicted on the cards and show them to someone, they will enter a trance state, allowing him to control their subconscious. When he uses them on his sisters, they fall for Ken's nonsense and open their bodies to him!! Grinning, he begins to play with the busty bodies of the two girls as he pleases...

(Source: Parabook, translated)

title.native: 姉妹X催眠～絶対服従、俺がずっと王様～
title.romaji: Shimai x Saimin: Zettai Fukujuu, Ore ga Zutto Ou-sama
