title.native: ハイブルク家三男は小悪魔ショタです
title.romaji: Heiburg-ke Sannan wa Koakuma Shota desu

synonyms: Kaburagi Senpai in the Second Lap of Life

title.native: 人生二周目の鏑木先輩
結・「美人でお金持ちの彼女が欲しい」と言ったら、ワケあり女子がやってきた件。
title.romaji: Ketsu "Bijin de wo Kanemochi no Kanojo ga Hoshii" to Ittara, Wake Ari Joshi ga Yattekita Ken.

180723.description:
After years of crushing taxes and rampant corruption among the nobility, the people rise up in revolution—and Arthur Pendragon, the second prince of Britain, is sent straight to the guillotine. But when Arthur opens his eyes, he finds himself five years in the past! Desperate to avoid the execution awaiting him, Arthur racks his brain for a way to change his fate. Then, after casually showing a little kindness to a maid, a mysterious voice echoes inside his head:

“Good Deed Points have been awarded. The future has shifted slightly.”

Realizing that this mysterious voice may be his only hope for survival, Arthur resolves to start treating everyone with kindness. Not because he has suddenly become a better person, of course—but because he desperately wants to stay alive! And so begins the do-over of a cowardly, petty, slightly overconfident, and utterly hopeless prince. To save his own neck, he’ll do everything he can to win over the people—and even the entire world! His only goal is survival—so how does everyone mistake him for history’s wisest king?!
synonyms: Redoing the Hater Prince of the Execution Flag
The Rebirth of a Hated Prince With Many Execution Flags

title.english: The Hated Prince’s Do-Over: Can Good Deeds Save Me from All These Execution Flags?!
title.native: 処刑フラグ満載の嫌われ皇子のやり直し
title.romaji: Shokei Flag Mansai no Kiraware Ouji no Yarinaoshi

180724.description:
At 28, Seo Yeon-Ho reunites with Ju Geon-U, his childhood first love, with only one thing on his mind: revenge. Determined to expose Geon-U's weaknesses, Yeon-Ho dives back into his life, only to find that his former crush has become a famous actor. But instead of gaining the upper hand, Yeon-Ho ends up being endlessly teased and outplayed by the very man he swore to take down…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ชำระแค้นรักแรก
いじめて抱きしめて初恋リベンジ

180725.description:
Junya is a third-year junior high boy who is good at sports, but not so good at studying. Recently, he's got a new problem. Mayaka-san, the older sister of his childhood friend, has been picking on him and teasing him a lot! Does that mean...... she likes me!? The start of a deceptive romantic comedy where the protagonist is constantly being bamboozled by a tricky girl!

(Source: Magapoke, translated)

title.native: まやか姉さんは噓がつけない

180726.description:
A “nosy” high school boy, Suzufumi Mamori, helps out his apartment neighbor who had collapsed due to hunger. It turns out to be Yuzuki Arisu, a high school girl who's an up-and-coming idol! In order to become the her ideal idol, Yuzuki has been on an excessive diet. However, Suzufumi, worried about her health, treats her to a home-cooked meal,

“Ahhhhh… I can't take it anymore!"

She eats it up with a face full of happiness! Seeing how much she enjoys it, Suzufumi decides to tempt Yuuki with her favorite foods and make her “fall in love with food" again. This is a romantic comedy about capturing the heart and stomach of a special neighbor!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title.native: 俺の背徳メシをおねだりせずにいられない、お隣のトップアイドルさま
title.romaji: Ore no Haitoku Meshi wo Onedarisezu ni Irarenai, Otonari no Top Idol-sama

180727.description:
Based on the erotic game by POISON.

While recuperating from an injury sustained at work, the protagonist Shougo is astonished to see a young wife move in next door to his apartment. She - Minami - was his senior in school and a notorious delinquent. However, her looks, which were already outstanding back then, have only become more sexy, and Shougo, who has always wanted to embrace her despite being his underling, cannot stop having sexual fantasies. So he comes up with a plan to exploit Minami's weakness, who does not want her husband to know about her past misdeeds!!

(Source: Parabook, translated)
synonyms: Kanochi x Motoyan Zuma: Gomennasai. Watashi, Mukatsuku Kouhai ni Niku Onaho ni Sarechatta no

title.native: 完堕ちＸ元ヤン妻～ごめんなさい。私、ムカつく後輩に肉オナホにされちゃったの～
title.romaji: Kan'ochi x Motoyanzuma: Gomennasai. Watashi, Mukatsuku Kouhai ni Niku Onaho ni Sarechatta no

180728.description:
Beautiful Ramses is held captive by the tyrant crown prince Naphria and forced to live as a sex toy. Ramses only has eyes for Naphria's younger brother, Thutmose...
A most tragic (and erotic) forbidden love story set in ancient Egypt!

(Source: HarperCollins Japan, translated)

Note: Originally self-published, later licensed and digitally released by HarperCollins Japan.
synonyms: 秘本・矢萩貴子コレクション ～ナイルを遡って

180729.description: Note: Published in COMIC Gekiga Jump 1980-01(劇画ジャンプ 1980年1月号)

title.native: お姉様僕は淋しかった

180732.description:
There is no better time than the present moment to fall in love... And enjoy it!

The end of the world is approaching for Monobe, Minami and Kitahara... But how will they spend their last days? The answer could well be as simple as it is hot! For his part, Ryugasaki cannot resist Kashima's culinary talents, and he will have to take responsibility for that! Mitani, for his part, is in awe of the kindness hidden in the harsh words of his neighbor at the table, Murayama... But do they really hide the slightest affection? In any case, what we can say is that romanticism can always hide where you least expect it!

title.native: 花のようなわたしたち

180734.description:
From the author of "Hyperinflation," Kyu Sumiyoshi, comes a baseball story unlike anything you've ever read before!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 巨獣戦記~遺跡発掘公社録~

180736.description: Note: Originally self-published by the mangaka on the website Rookie Shounen Jump on September 14, 2022. This work got licensed by Shueisha as a one-shot and published on Shounen Jump + on October 21, 2022.

title.native: 飯テロリスト米盛饗子

180739.description:
In a near-future where humanity stands on the edge of extinction, we turn our gaze to the stars. But in the depths of space, a new menace looms—the 'Star Beasts.' To combat these creatures, warriors donning mechanical armor emerge as humanity's last hope. Prepare yourself for a groundbreaking mecha action saga, where breathtaking visuals meet an expansive universe. The battle for survival starts now!

(Source: MANGA Plus)
synonyms: องค์กรวีรบุรุษ

180740.description:
Mirei, a diligent honor student, longs for the flashy, fashionable ‘gyaru’ lifestyle she admires in manga. With newfound courage, she decides to give herself a makeover and reinvent her image upon entering high school. There, she meets Yushin, a rough-around-the-edges boy, and… they hit it off?!

Shigure Tokita, the author of "Don’t Blush, Sekime-san!," presents a classroom comedy that unfolds around this fateful encounter!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note:
- Originally published as a one-shot, was later picked up for serialization.
- Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: このクラスにギャルはいない
title.romaji: Kono Class ni Gal wa Inai

180748.description:
An "angel" suddenly appears in a park in a certain country. All living things that touch the angel die. A prisoner goes to the angel to kill it so he can be exempted from his sentence...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

180749.description:
The master swordsman Rix, who has grown well and truly tired of the bloodstained battlefield, fakes his death in battle and retires. He has decided to turn his life around and enroll in the Magic Institute, despite having zero magic aptitude. Nonetheless, Rix is able to overwhelm the sorcerers with his base skills as a swordsman! Unintentional as it may be, he continues to smash through all common sense within the institute. In doing so, he catches the Empress’s eye, drawn to that battle prowess of his— Wait, no! I'm telling you that I'm not aiming to be the strongest or anything like that! What I want is a "peaceful and happy life"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: This is the Sorcerer's Trump Card

title.native: これが魔法使いの切り札

180750.description:
Hiiragi, a high school student who works at a convenience store for a part time, was in trouble. When he is working alone at night, a monster-looking woman comes to the store. He can sense that she is not human...he was scared, so he decided to contact "THE GAP". He had heard that if you go on social media and post with the hashtag #THEGAP, someone will come and save you from monsters or ghosts. Hiiragi thought it might be one of those urban myths, but when he posted the hashtag, a beautiful woman visited him. Her name was Tsutsuji--the "Filler". She told him that there might be someone already dead in this case, but she'll help him out. Even Tsutsuji didn't know at that point...that Hiiragi would be the best partner for her job.

(Source: Kadokawa)

180751.description:
Ever since the day Seiji climbed down a creepy dark well as a kid to retrieve a wayward ball and picked up an odd-looking pomegranate, he’s had to dodge an unending stream of near-fatal “accidents” that push everyone around him away—except for his best friend Haru. But all that changes when their high school bus crashes, killing everybody on board but Seiji. Suddenly, rumors from his childhood about that fateful well reaching into the depths of the underworld take on a whole new light, and Seiji is launched into an epic adventure to save his friend—and his own soul.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

180752.description:
Magic is alive and well in the world, inside beings known as Majiks. By completing a Majik’s trial, a Witch can gain its power. However, only women can become Witches or use magical items. All that changes one day when a young man named Ichi turns the world on its head by defeating an infamous Majik and gaining its magical powers!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes:
- Winner of the 2025 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.
- Ranked 11th in Da Vinci's 2025 Book of the Year ranking.
- Ranked 4th in the Men's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2026 guidebook.
- Ranked 10th in the 19th Manga Taisho in 2026.
- Nominated for the 50th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2026.

180753.description:
Horus, the fifth prince of the Magref Empire, is considered useless because he can only use the magic of the sand attribute to manipulate the sand, and is banished from the empire.

Thrown into the scorching desert, Horus demonstrates his sand magic and builds a huge sand castle.

Realizing that what seemed to be hell for others was heaven for him, he decided to live here leisurely.

However, through the battle with the demons, friends of various races gather and gradually form a “kingdom” with Horus as the king.

title.native: 砂魔法で砂の王国を作ろう ～砂漠に追放されたから頑張って祖国以上の国家を建ててみた～
title.romaji: Suna Mahou de Suna no Oukoku wo Tsukurou: Sabaku ni Tsuihou Sareta kara Ganbatte Sokoku Ijou no Kokka wo Tatete Mita

title.native: 砂魔法で砂の王国を作ろう ～砂漠に追放されたから頑張って祖国以上の国家を建ててみた～
title.romaji: Suna Mahou de Suna no Oukoku wo Tsukurou: Sabaku ni Tsuihou Sareta kara Ganbatte Sokoku Ijou no Kokka wo Tatete Mita

180755.description:
Do you want eternal life?

Red eyes, white skin, golden hair... Luna, our protagonist, is an apprentice magician who was bought by Khan, a shabby old magician. Luna is a prideful girl who spends her days learning magic in order to impress Khan, who has no interest in anything other than the study of magic.

Then, the previous king dies of illness, and rebellions erupt in various parts of the country. The kingdom is on the brink of destruction, but an army of undead attacks the rebels and puts them down. Who in the world has used the forbidden necromancy?

synonyms: Kabe-yaku nado Fuyou to Tsuihou Sareta S-kyuu Boukensha, "Dorei Kaihou" Skill wo Kushi Shite Shijou Saikyou no Kunizukuri

title.romaji: Kabeyaku nado Fuyou to Tsuihou Sareta S-kyuu Boukensha, «Dorei Kaihou» Skill wo Kushi Shite Shijou Saikyou no Kunizukuri

title.romaji: Boukensha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta Kaifukushi no Shoujo wo Hirotte Ikusei Shitara

title.native: もしもチート小説の主人公がうっかり人を殺したら
title.romaji: Moshimo Cheat Shousetsu no Shujinkou ga Ukkari Hito wo Koroshitara

180760.description:
Ten years of relationship go down the drain when Haeru discovers that her loving boyfriend, Se-o, spent the night with another woman. What begins as a series of small misunderstandings snowballs into something much bigger as the college sweethearts wade through love, temptation, and workplace drama. Well, what better way to get back at her cheating boyfriend than to take the most rotten revenge ever?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I'll give you the most rotten one
แค้นนี้คืนสนอง

title.english: I'll Give You the Most Rotten One

180761.description:
After being reborn back to the time before the apocalypse, Su Chenren has become a man of few words. Having already experienced the downfall of doomsday and betrayal by his fiancee, he understand the importance of preparation. With his powers of teleportation and spatial manipulation, he will gather up all the materials needed to survive the apocalypse. This time will be different, he'll be ready for anything!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: The Doomsday Ruthless Man: Hoarding Trillions of Supplies at the Beginning
title.native: 末日狠人：开局囤积万亿物资
title.romaji: Mo Ri Hen Ren: Kai Ju Tun Ji Wanyi Wuzi

180762.description:
LGBTq... In a time when such a term didn't exist, a boy sought beauty and freedom according to his own heart.

In prewar Japan, there was a boy who had the heart of a woman. This is the story of their struggle for love, beauty, and the freedom to live honestly with themself!

(Source: Big Comic Original, translated)

180763.description:
When a mana stone is stolen from the powerful Red Dragon, it morphs into a noble lady to track down the thief. This lady is none other than Cecilia Marinella, who was proclaimed dead five years ago under suspicious circumstances. With no memory of Cecilia’s past, the dragon starts its search with the men closest to her. Could any of them lead it to the mana stone? And just what do they know about Cecilia’s “death”? Soon, the search for the stone and the search for the truth become entangled...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: あの日、私が死んだ理由
สรุปว่าฉันตายได้ยังไง

180764.description:
The terminally ill daughter of a poor family is given a new lease on life when she is granted the chance to be reborn as anyone she wants. But her plans go awry when she accidentally wishes to become the wrong character of the video game she likes—Raina Rubellite, the final evil boss that torments the righteous main character of the game “The Power of Love”. Now, our protagonist finds herself reborn as an evil devil queen with overpowered dark magic powers, but she won’t let the video game’s plot stop her from living the life of her dreams!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Became a Level 999 Mastermind Demon King
ราชินีจอมมารเลเวล 999

title.english: I Became a Level 999 Demon Queen
title.native: レベル999黒幕公女になりました

180765.description:
My name's Karina—or at least, it is now! I used to be a nondescript, run-of-the-mill Japanese salaryman until I was whisked away to a divine realm where the Goddess of Time and Space told me I'd be living a new life in a new world—and as a girl, since apparently she prefers it that way. First she wants me to beat some final boss she has a grudge against, then she takes control of my body to show me how to use my new spatial magic powers in a tutorial fight... Wait, isn't that the final boss I'm supposed to beat?! Less than in a minute into the tutorial and he's dead?! And now she says the world's my oyster. Seriously?!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Her kingdom is being attacked by the neighboring Heilbronn Empire. Serina is still confused by the situation when she is forced to take the place of the princess, and as the “princess” she is taken prisoner by Gilbert, the arrogant prince of the Heilbronn Empire. Now that Serina has fallen into the hands of the handsome but intimidating Gilbert, the fate that awaits her is whether she will become the prince's plaything, or......?

Cast out in disgrace after a humiliating defeat, young noble Tarte sees his destiny collapse before his eyes. Once praised for his talent and heritage, he now stands at the very bottom of the hierarchy, an underdog in a realm where strength, strategy and magical prowess rule all. But when the King Selection Exam begins, a brutal contest that crowns only the most extraordinary of contenders, Tarte seizes his one chance at reclaiming every thing he's lost.

As rivals sharpen their blades and factions clash for dominance, Tarte must confront the harsh truths of his sheltered past and decide what kind of man, and ruler, he wants to become. His journey from arrogance to resilience forges a hero driven not by privilege, but by grit, humility and an unshakable will to rise again.

(Source: Titan Manga)

The day started out pretty normally. Kei Nimori was just going to elementary school as usual, and although he thought it was weird that his name and some other random person’s were written on the chalkboard, he didn’t pay too much attention to it—until night fell. Stuck in an alternate dimension of his school, surrounded by horrific monsters and a pile of corpses, his battle for survival has only just begun! The only question is, can he keep fighting until flight becomes an option again…?!

(Source: Yen Press)

180778.description:
One winter day, Selim succumbed to the Devil’s Temptation and turned into a Demonic Transformation.

Before being killed by the Hero, he slaughtered the people of the Royal Capital and the nobles, and pulled the trigger for the devils to invade the Kingdom.

After Selim’s death, the devils overthrew the Royal Capital and destroyed the Kingdom.

Selim, who was trapped by the devil and watched the Kingdom fall, somehow found himself returning to his 14-year-old self.

A message written on a transparent panel floats in front of him.

《You have become a seeker. By doing the right things and accumulating virtues, your level will increase》

He had strength and power. But that wasn’t enough. By leveling up, he decided to change the fall waiting for him in the future.

She spends her days avoiding the feeble bullying of the ladies of the Academy while being worked to the bone at the viscount’s mansion—until just before graduation, when she gets tricked and her pay completely vanishes! Furious, she vows to get even, no matter what it takes, when out of nowhere, the second prince shows up and offers to help her? Toshikatsu Doi, a senior councilor who plans to strengthen the shogunate, dispatches a group of Yagyu swordsmen to various places under the pretext of teaching swordsmanship.
Tokugawa Tadanaga, who was ordered to commit seppuku on unfounded suspicions, ordered his close retainer Hyoma Otaki to eradicate the
group of Yagyu swordsmen who had become the running dogs of the roju.

180880.description:
The long-awaited series by the up-and-coming writer of the Jump+ one-shots O no Utsuwa (under the pen name Kyo Oribe) and Kuga Masamune no Junan. A mystical epic drawn with stunning penmanship is about to unfold...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

180881.description:
Even in modern Japan, ninja still hide in the shadows. Young ninja Yodaka has received his mission--protect high school student Aoi at all cost. But can a ninja survive the wild world of high school while also fulfilling his mission?

(Source: MANGA Plus)
synonyms: ภารกิจลับนินจาป่วน

180883.description:
Get off with a erotic futanari body featuring both female and male genitalia.

(Source: DLSite, transalted)

Note: Originally self-published, it was collected into a commercial volume by Sanwa Shuppan on 2023-04-01.
synonyms: I'm a Futanari Exhibitionist, So What?

title.native: ふたなり露出シコたま

180884.description:
In 1992 Bremerhaven, Germany, Dr. Heinz Gloger faces a psychological crisis linked to his troubled past. His son, Helmut, seeks the help of Golgo 13 to resolve this issue. As the story unfolds, themes of guilt, identity, and the lasting impact of historical events are explored, leading to a dramatic confrontation.

This is a magazine-only chapter of Golgo 13 that was published in Bessatsu Big Comic No.108's special Golgo 13 issue.
synonyms: Golgo 13: Indictment of the Iron Cross

title.native: ゴルゴ13 告発の鉄十字

180885.description:
Satoru sees his childhood friend Rin for the first time in years, but she looks aloof… like something is troubling her. Something big, hard, and veiny…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 104, 105, 106.

title.english: She's My Friend, She's His Slut
title.native: 文学少女は染められる
半見怜也はそこそこを望む
title.romaji: Hanmi Reiya wa Soko Soko wo Nozomu

synonyms: FAIRY TAIL: Jibun no Shinjiru Michi

title.english: Fairy Tail: The Path You Believe In

180890.description:
Yang-Cheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Best Childhood Friend in the World

180891.description:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ย้อนชะตาล่าข้ามภพ

180892.description:
I am the icon of absolute power, master of all, the ultimate necromancer king who controls death: Lord Karnak. But what’s the point of a life like this when I’m nothing but bones? Enjoying a gentle breeze, warm sunlight, human warmth, or even a decent meal are all out of the question! My loyal servant Baroth and I have tried vampirism and spiritual possession, but neither worked on ultimate transcendental beings like us. So perhaps being human again is the answer! Surely nothing will go wrong…

(Source: Tapas)

180893.description:
Yong-Ho Kang, chairman of Choi Sung Group, wakes up in the body of the company’s newest recruit. Now that the seat of power is suddenly empty, his entire family starts scrambling for the position, and the group’s future looks far from secure. But Yong-Ho isn’t about to sit back just because he’s now at the bottom of the corporate food chain. This is his company, and he’s going to save it himself. On this corporate battlefield, a newbie with a chairman’s mind is about to call the shots.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 入れ替わった財閥会長
พนักงานใหม่หัวใจบูมเมอร์

180895.description: A human drama about a successful and beautiful teenage girl who's a gold medalist in women's gymnastics at only 18 years old. However, a tragic event leads her to her seek out an anonymous partner to commit suicide together. When they go to meet up, she accidentally approaches the wrong guy and falls in love for the first time in her life. He's a mysterious and captivating man, but what will wait at the end of this fateful encounter? Hell? Success? Love?

title.native: 邦人奪還 自衛隊特殊部隊が動くとき
title.romaji: Houjin Dakkan: Jieitai Tokushu Butai ga Ugoku Toki

180897.description: Welcome to Adultland is an one off manga chapter with 101 pages that was first prepublished in Futabasha's Action Deluxe No.2 magazine in July 31, 1979. Despite originally not being part of the series (it was advertised as Super Action Shin Lupin III), it was collected into New Lupin III (Manga) volumes by Futabasha in Power Comics, Action Comics and recent releases.
synonyms: Super Action Shin Lupin III: Welcome to Adultland

title.native: ようこそ!! アダルトランドへ!!
銀装騎攻オーディアンORO

180899.description:
Seiichi Gotsune works for Tsuruya supermarket, and the company president has high hopes for his future. Seiichi lives with his father and sister.

Seiichi makes fun of his father, a sewing machine craftsman who spares no time for meals and keeps on stamping on his sewing machine. The president's only son raped his friend's girlfriend.

The president gives his tacit approval to the incident on the condition that he promises to post the incident to the company.

Note: Includes the action jidaigekiga "Suteishi no Tetsu" and "The Spirit of Hatred Descends".

title.native: 青きイバラのトンネル

180901.description:
At a party of "The Apple Society," also known as the Entertainment Mafia, all the members were killed by a single man! The crime was committed by a Japanese man called "Fang J", a man who is said to be able to do anything if he is asked to.

The identity of this man, who is said to be able to do whatever is asked of him, is...

Volume 1: Deep in the Middle of the Night in Japan
Volume 2: Faceless Target
Volume 3: Execution Force
Volume 4: The Man from Texas

title.native: 暗号名で呼ばれる男 ファング・J
title.romaji: Angoumei de Yobareru Otoko: Fang J

180903.description:
Why can't people stop eating when they know it makes them fat?
Why do delicious foods have to be accompanied by calories?

I'm a gravure idol and I need to lose weight...
I can't resist the temptation of delicious food!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)
synonyms: We will never give in to delicious meals!

title.native: 飯テロ系グラドルは我慢できない！？
title.romaji: Meshi Terokei Gradol wa Gaman Dekinai!?

180904.description:
"Unique Ability: Resurrection"
“What is this? This damn sweet Munchkin skill?”
But Kang Hyun didn’t know.
What does it mean to not die, even if you die, even if you want to die…
A man who became the most notorious hunter on Earth with an immortal body!
For the sake of humanity, no, for the sake of humanity’s survival, Today, I alone will be resurrected!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

180905.description:
Drinking with her grown-up son is a mother's pleasure! Or so she thought... But then she got drunk and her son got excited by her breasts. When she tried to tease him, he lost control and got serious. She was excited by the sight of a strong man's body after a long time, and the relationship between mother and son became irreparable. She was surprised at how well her body matched with her son's, and her son's monkey-like sexual appetite made her want to have sex with him again and again, and she was engulfed in pleasure she had never experienced before.

(Source: FANZA, translated)
synonyms: The Story of a Mother who becomes a SEX ADDICT when Drunk

title.native: お酒の勢いで母さんにHなことをしてもらったらガチになっちゃった話し
title.romaji: Osake no Ikioi de Kaa-san ni H na Koto o Shite morattara Gachi ni Nacchatta Hanashi

180906.description:
The Onin War brought on a storm of turmoil that engulfed Japan. It was the Warring States period, a time in which no shogun was able to predict what the next day would bring.

One young soldier of Kai stands tall. His eyes are set on the world.

180907.description:
Maki, an exhausted office lady, after a random act of kindness, begins a life with Kitsunemi, a messenger of God. As the two sleep and eat together, they become attracted to each other. And the number of people living with them increases one after another...!? Full of snuggles and laughs, the excitement of daily life continues!

(Source: DLsite, translate)

180908.description:
Stripped of her life for reasons unknown, Aoi Konominato wakes up as a child in an unfamiliar world, still haunted by regret and goals left unfulfilled. After twelve years of learning under the tutelage of an elven sage named Owain, she's mastered the art of sorcery and is sent by her wise—if eccentric—mentor to the renowned Fiddich Academy to serve as an instructor and further her studies.

Bitter memories of her past life as a fledgling teacher still nip at her heels, yet despite her initial reluctance, Aoi knows that this is her chance to do things better. Determination won't be enough, though. Between misbehaving students of noble birth and elitist instructors, Aoi may have bitten off more than she can chew...or she might just be the missing ingredient the academy needs to become a paragon of educational equality and discipline.

Class is in session, and the fearsome witch of Fiddich Academy has come prepared to teach them all a lesson they won't soon forget.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: I Was Transferred To Another World And Became A Teacher, But I'm Feared As A Witch: Aoi-sensei's Academy Struggle Log

title.english: The Fearsome Witch Teaches in Another World: Ms. Aoi's Lesson Plans
title.native: 異世界転移して教師になったが、魔女と恐れられている件　～アオイ先生の学園奮闘日誌～
title.romaji: Isekai Tenishite Kyoushi ni Natta ga, Majo to Osorerareteiru Ken: Aoi-sensei no Gakuen Funtou Nisshi

180909.description:
A mother and son who became physically involved under the influence of alcohol. They try to forget about it as a mistake of the day, but the son, who has too much sexual desire, seeks excessive skinship. The mother tries to somehow reprimand her son and treat him rationally, but her son's words lead her to do even more perverted acts. The unusual atmosphere and the sense of immorality gradually lead to the mother being unable to turn back. She gives in to him in body and mind and falls deeper and deeper into the relationship. Things gradually escalate and, sneaking away from her husband's eyes, the two of them cross a line that should never be crossed.

(Source: FANZA, translated)
synonyms: 身体の関係持っちゃったお母さんとなし崩し的に子作り始めちゃった話し
Having a Physical Relationship with My Mother I Gradually Try to Make a Baby

title.native: 身体の関係持っちゃったお母さんとなし崩し的に子作り始めっちゃった話し
title.romaji: Karada no Kankei Mocchata Okaa-san to Nashikuzushi-teki ni Kozukuri Hajimecchata Hanashi

180910.description:
After her death on Earth, teacher Aoi Konominato awakens as a child in an unfamiliar world, filled with regret about her lackluster life and unfinished goals. An elven sage named Owain takes her in, mentors her, and instructs her in the art of sorcery. Twelve years later, Aoi has mastered everything he's thrown at her, and Owain deems her ready to further her studies of sorcery by becoming an instructor at the illustrious Fiddich Academy, the finest sorcery school in the world.

Though she's hesitant at first, Aoi sees this as a second chance to become her ideal vision of a teacher, albeit in a fantasy world. However, this magical school is brimming with problems—and misbehaving students. The children of nobles and royalty are used to doing whatever they want, but soon they'll learn to pay attention in this fearsome witch's class!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Fearsome Witch Teaches in Another World: Pay Attention in Class!
title.native: 異世界転移して教師になったが、魔女と恐れられている件
title.romaji: Isekai Tenishite Kyoushi ni Natta ga, Majo to Osorerareteiru Ken

180911.description:
The youngest girl ever to become a court alchemist, Seyi, was busy with hard work every day. One day, the royal city was suddenly attacked by a horde of monsters, and she woke up 500 years later. The city had already been destroyed, and Seyi, freed from her hard work, was determined to travel through a completely changed world. She was supposed to travel freely, but her potion-making skills quickly become the talk of the town?!

The genius alchemist's leisurely, slow-life journey begins!

title.native: 天才錬金術師は気ままに旅する ～５００年後の世界で目覚めた世界最高の元宮廷錬金術師、ポーション作りで聖女さま扱いされる～
title.romaji: Tensai Renkinjutsushi wa Kimama ni Tabi Suru: 500-nengo no Sekai de Mezameta Sekai Saikou no Moto Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi, Potion Zukuri de Seijo-sama Atsukai Sareru

180912.description:
After the editor of an occult magazine goes missing while researching the spooky stories surrounding a certain area in the Kinki Region, his friend sets out to follow his footsteps and discover what happened. In the scraps of the old articles, strange fan mail, and far- fetched forum posts he gathers, a disturbing narrative begins to emerge—something really is wrong about a place in the Kinki Region...

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: About a Place in the Kinki Region

title.english: About a Place in the Kinki Region
title.native: 近畿地方のある場所について
title.romaji: Kinki Chihou no Aru Basho ni Tsuite

title.native: キレてるふたりの出張めし
カノジョをキャラメイク！

180915.description:
Tori, a low-ranking noble, longs to be manly—but with a delicate appearance and strong “girl power,” everyone mistakes him for a girl. One day, he’s scouted to serve as a dorm supervisor at an elite academy, home to the prestigious “Four Noble Clans,” warriors admired for their unmatched strength.

Assigned to the very dorm where his ideals of manliness shine the brightest, Tori’s heart races with excitement… until the arrogant Eliza greets him with a shocking declaration:

“Welcome! We’re counting on you to take care of us girls in this dorm!”

Wait—what!? The legendary “Four Noble Clans” aren’t men at all, but beautiful young women!?

title.romaji: Ouji na Hime to Hime na Boku

title.native: 訳あり伯爵様と契約結婚したら、義娘（六歳）の契約母になってしまいました。
title.romaji: Wakeari Hakushaku-sama to Keiyaku Kekkon Shitara, Musume (Roku-sai) no Keiyaku Haha ni Natte Shimaimashita.

title.native: 訳あり伯爵様と契約結婚したら、義娘（六歳）の契約母になってしまいました。
title.romaji: Wakeari Hakushaku-sama to Keiyaku Kekkon Shitara, Musume (Roku-sai) no Keiyaku Haha ni Natte Shimaimashita.

title.native: グラン＆グルメ～器用貧乏な転生勇者が始める辺境スローライフ～
title.romaji: Gran & Gourmet: Kiyou Binbou na Tensei Yuusha ga Hajimeru Henkyou Slow Life

title.native: グラン＆グルメ～器用貧乏な転生勇者が始める辺境スローライフ～

title.romaji: Akuyaku Kizoku to Shite Hitsuyou na Sore

180921.description:
This is the story of a man who exudes evil charisma. A young man living in modern Japan suddenly finds himself reincarnated in the fantasy novel he loves to read, "The Tale of Rainana." He then discovers that he is Absolute Ark, famous as the "villainous marquis" in the story. At first, he is happy to be reincarnated into his favorite work, but when he remembers that he is destined to be defeated by a hero, he takes action to change the predetermined scenario by becoming the strongest "evil" and carving out his own future.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: That is needed for a villainous aristocrat

title.native: 悪役貴族として必要なそれ
title.romaji: Akuyaku Kizoku to Shite Hitsuyou na Sore

180922.description:
On a dark hillside in Kamakura lies Shindo Hospital. It was only three years ago that the hospital was forced to close due to circumstances beyond its control. But what about the devastation, as if that undeniable fact were a lie? A garden covered with weeds. The windows clouded with dust and desolation. What is the true horror that lives with the remaining family who smile benevolently from their haunted inner sanctum, at the end of a labyrinthine corridor where the spirit of their dead daughter walks! The shocking second installment of this well-received dark fantasy series!

(Source: White Heart, translated)

180925.description:
Is drinking after work really necessary? If people around me suddenly start wearing make-up… do I have to, too? It bothers me when my boyfriend makes dirty jokes…

"I don't want people to dislike me."
"I don't want to ruin the mood."

Tsubasa, a high school girl who is willing to say “no,” gradually changes the thoughts and actions of those who have a hard time because of such feelings…

A story about the power of saying NO, a power that is within all of us.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 彼女はNOの翼を持っている
title.romaji: Kanojo wa NO no Tsubasa wo Motteiru

180926.description:
I dreamed of a wonderful romance, but my first boyfriend seems to be the complete opposite of my ideals…⁉︎

(Source: Margaret, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2024 No. 6.

180927.description:
Reina Matsumoto is a high school girl who loves fashion. However, her extravagant appearance tends to violate her school's dress code, and her teacher warns her about it. One day, as punishment, she is assigned to do chores under the supervision of Hashida, a senior boy who is rumored to be a very strict member of the Discipline Committee.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Note: Originally published in the 2024 September issue of Nakayoshi magazine.

title.native: 好きな気持ちは止められない！

180928.description:
Sucking up all the boys' nectar.♥
Miya-chan, a member of the track and field club, has been in poor condition for the last few days due to some unknown reason...
So she thought, but one day, she suddenly became able to see heart marks on top of the boys' heads...!?
Not only that, but she even saw a picture of herself being used for what looks like XXX!?
Just what will happen to Miya-chan!?

The shock-and-awe series, loaded up with fetishes and overflowing with libido, officially begins!

(Source: Monthly Big Gangan, translated)

title.native: 美夜ちゃんのきゅーいんライフ!
私は偽聖女らしいので、宮廷を出て隣国で暮らします
title.romaji: Watashi wa Nise Seijorashii node, Kyuutei wo Dete Ringoku de Kurashimasu

180931.description:
The (real) saint found out her handsome friend, Alex, was the prince of the neighboring kingdom after she was exiled. He asks her to come with him and save his people. Of course she'll come!

Tiara, who has special power to heal people, had been working in the Imperial Court of Lerys since she was just a girl. As a "Saint," she healed wounded or sick people every day until she was exhausted. However, one day she was accused of pretending to be a saint--the second princess, Isabelle, who hated her, wanted to show how powerful she is. Tiara thought for a moment...she was never happy here. It would be better to be kicked out of here and live a life of her own! While she was trying to find a book to read before leaving, she met Alex. When he heard what happened, Alex suddenly said "Why don't you come to Ekwald, my land?" Tiara never knew that he was the prince and the strongest dragon knight of Ekwald! Tiara's journey begins.

(Source: KADOKAWA Global)

title.native: 私は偽聖女らしいので、宮廷を出て隣国で暮らします
title.romaji: Watashi wa Nise Seijorashii node, Kyuutei wo Dete Ringoku de Kurashimasu

童貞が家事代行サービスを依頼したら超爆乳人妻がやってきて童貞がバレたので落ち込んでいたら慰め筆おろししてくれた話し
title.romaji: Doutei ga Kaji Daikou Service wo Irai shitara Chou Bakunyuu Hitozuma ga Yattekite Doutei ga Bareta node Ochikonde itara Nagusame Fudeoroshi shite kureta Hanashi

synonyms: Are Physical Relationships Possible Between Childhood Friends of High School Students?

title.native: 幼なじみの高校生のあいだに肉体関係は成立するか。
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Koukousei no Aida ni Nikutai Kankei wa Seiritsu Suru ka.

180937.description:
I meet a delicate girl who can't go outside, and help her experience what it's like to cum for the first time with wholesome sex.

The girl may seem a lot younger than she actually is, but she's already at an appropriate age.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Released at Comiket 96.
synonyms: First-Time Sex with the Delicate Girl Next Door

title.native: 隣の儚げ少女とはじめてえっち
title.romaji: Tonari no Hakanage Shoujo to Hajimete Ecchi

180938.description:
A prequel story to the video game Tail Concerto, set 10 years before the original game. It establishes the story of how Waffle Ryebread and Alicia Pris first met.

Note: Originally published in Monthly Shonen Ace in the June 1998 issue.

180940.description: Akane Kuritani, a young live-in caregiver, arrives at a secluded mansion deep in the mountains hoping for a fresh start. Her patient, the bedridden Kiwako Miyazono, appears more like a corpse than a living person. As Akane begins her duties, she discovers that the care required is as unnatural and dangerous as it is disturbing. What starts as an ordinary job quickly spirals into a chilling psychological horror where the lines between life and death blur in an oppressively intimate and grotesque way.

180941.description:
The son and heir of Kuroda Kanpei, a military strategist who served Oda Nobunaga and Toyotomi Hideyoshi, was killed by Nobunaga and Hideyoshi while Kanpei was imprisoned by Araki Murakeshige.

Kanpei, bent on avenging his son's death, now plotted against the two men whom he had served.

Even though Nobunaga was eventually killed by Mitsuhide, Hideyoshi turned this misfortune into a blessing to succeed Nobunaga and conquer all of Japan!

(Source: LEEDS, translated)

180942.description:
Sol Song has a uniquely quirky taste in men: they absolutely must have long hair. Otherwise, she sees them as literal "stone heads," devoid of facial features. So, when her first love—and the only long-haired guy on campus—shows up with a buzz cut, she's devastated. But as they start to reconnect and emotions deepen, Sol must discover whether she likes Okseok for who he truly is or just for his hair.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ロン毛の先輩、名前なんだっけ？

title.native: 그 머리 긴 선배, 이름이 뭐더라?
title.romaji: Geu Meori Gin Seonbae, Ireumi Mwodeora?

180943.description:
Two people were arrested in Manila, Philippines, for attempting to use dynamite to break into a bank safe.

The president of the bank, who is planning to build a leisure resort on an uninhabited island, hires the two men for their knowledge of explosives. They were supposed to help dispose of the unexploded bombs from the war, but that is only on the surface.

180944.description:
There is a special zone which is the only place in the world where humans and vampires coexist. Mimiko works at the Order Coffin Company, an organization that maintains peace between humans and vampires. These are the stories of Mimiko and the vampire brothers who are her bodyguards!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: BLACK BLOOD BROTHERS(S) ―ブラック・ブラッド・ブラザーズ短編集―

180945.description:
If there was a closet inside a closet, Joohwan would hide there. He's that desperate to hide that he's gay. Still, he's doing a pretty good job at hiding his sexual orientation, on his way to a promotion at his job, and has everything going great...right until he crosses paths with Sihyun during a major presentation for work. Unfortunately, Sihyun is devastatingly attractive. Perhaps attractive enough to drag Joohwan out of the closet...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Suger Trap〜キケンな年下くんの甘い罠にご注意！〜

180946.description:
A 36-year-old single freelance lyricist, has decided to live alone without bothering anyone. But on his first trip to the local supermarket... he falls in love!? A story about a second chance at youth!

(Source: Gessan, translated)

180948.description:
The peace of the world collapses after a war between the gods and demons, leading to the downfall of humanity—except for one person. Sewoon, the sole survivor, is determined to rewrite the ending of this tragic tale. While searching for Kronos' hourglass to reverse time, he discovers the treasure trove of the Demon of Greed, filled with items that can aid him in achieving his goal. With these demonic treasures at his disposal, can Sewoon stop the war and secure lasting peace in the world?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Robbed The Storehouse Of The God

title.english: I Raided the Demon God's Treasure Trove

180951.description:
A young man, Habinoshin Fubuki, sets out from his home in a mountain village in Hida, with the goal to become the best swordsman in the world. Along the way, he meets various great martial artists such as Sogen Godo and Onishin Narukami, and his desire to become a swordsman deepens and burns even more. But then he meets Aoi Saumanosuke, a beautiful woman in dressed in a swordsman's clothes, and experiences the pains of adolescence....... Graphic depiction of the life of a swordsmen in the late Tokugawa period.

(Source: Saito-Pro, translated)

title.romaji: Kaze yo Kumo yo Ken yo

180952.description:
Seou's high school crush, Ha Jae-Yeong, has tragically passed away. In a poignant dream, Seou encounters the deceased Jae-Yeong and relives their past together, and she desperately tries to alter events to prevent his death. However, the other Ha Jae-Yeong's demise seems to be also affecting this timeline. As Seou navigates this surreal temporal landscape, they race against time to rewrite history and save both Ha Jae-Yeongs before the dream's profound journey ends.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

180953.description:
"You killed Chikage!"—is the last thing university student Ako expected to hear at her childhood friend's funeral. She's told that by sharing the accursed legend from her village about the “Demon,” she has brought about a curse. That must be a lie…but then why is Chikage's corpse all unnaturally mangled? And when one tragedy after another occurs, each more supernatural than the last, Ako is physically and mentally pushed to the brink. Is this truly an unfortunate series of events, or is there something else at play…?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Demon Bride: “I Love You” Are Frightening Words
title.native: 鬼妃～「愛してる」は、怖いこと～

180954.description:
When she loses her calm, she is unable to use magic. In order to become a great witch, Merrily has lived her life according to her mother's teachings, keeping her mind clear no matter what. Then one day, Merrily meets a boy named Danka. As she interacts with him, Merrily's heart changes...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

180955.description:
After a wild night at the club, Gyu-Ha wakes up to a surprise. He's tangled in the sheets with none other than his childhood friend, Cha-Young. The more Gyu-Ha thinks about it, the more he realizes that Cha-Young is actually his ideal type, maybe a tad too tall. Despite their rendezvous becoming a regular thing, and the chemistry between them getting steamier, Cha-Young is still dead set on marrying an omega. Too bad he doesn't know Gyu-Ha is not the beta he's pretending to be.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.
synonyms: オメガの発情コントロール～犬と鳥～

180956.description:
By the Reiwa era, delinquents have been completely eliminated even from schools of magic... or so everyone thought. Even the "Black Magic Dormitory", formerly a wild and out of control place where the dark magic ne'er-do-wells gathered, is now on the verge of being demolished due to no new students having been placed into it for ages. The dorm's poor environment, residents receiving scorn and disdain from teachers, and resulting low prospects of employment after graduation made the dorm's popularity sharply drop starting with Gen Z... until this year, when three female students were placed into it! So each one of them makes an oath to themselves that they'll escape from the dorm, no matter what happens to the other two!

However, those girls do not yet know the dreadful prophecy, which will affect the entire magical world, that is descending upon them.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

180957.description:
A gangster dies saving a bullied teen — and wakes up in the boy’s body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy’s suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he’s not who he says he is, things start to spiral...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I,A Gangster, Became a High School Student
A Gangster Became a High Schooler

title.english: High School Return of a Gangster

180958.description:
At the request of Togashi Jubei, a retainer of Yanagisawa Yoshiyasu, Higurashi Hankuro invades the castle to take the life of Mito Komon.

A year later, for some inexplicable reason, he sets out with Tadasu to exterminate the evils of the world on behalf of Mito Komon.

(Source: Leed, translated)

180959.description:
“If I can’t have you, no one can.”

Hestia killed her beloved brother Ian with her own two hands. Three months later, he reappears in front of her seemingly unharmed; however, he has seemingly lost all his memories and become an almost completely different person. Everyone in the kingdom welcomes him back with open arms, but only Hestia suspects some foul play at work. Has her brother really changed? Or Ian not who he seems?

(Source: Lehzin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Mon grand frère n'est plus le même
ถึงรักก็ต้องฆ่า!

180960.description:
A one-night stand turns into a messy love story.
Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: สะอาดแล้วครับคุณทนาย

180963.description:
Con artists, unsolved murders, and lonely housewives! A collection of short stories that you've never heard before.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

180964.description:
Blessed with dragon's blood, a royal is born every generation with the creature's legendary might. But with that might comes a dragon's cruelty. Thus, each royal is assigned a Regas, a dragon tamer capable of quelling the raging hearts of those with the dragon's blessing. Abel has been trained in the ways of a Regas, but can he withstand the lunacy of the latest blessed prince?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: レガス ～僕と呪われた王子～

180970.description:
Hino Akari, who grew up in an orphanage, wakes up in an unfamiliar forest. She can't connect to the internet and can't call for help. While trying to escape with her friends from the same facility, Akari gets caught up in the forest's abnormalities. "We just wanted to go home."

(Source: peep)

synonyms: 人妻愛好家 ～俺は年上の女性にしか惹かれない～

180972.description:
The teachers' struggle to send Si-Yun Min, the son of the chairman of the IR Group, to a prestigious university begins! With a $1 million performance bonus at stake, it's no easy task due to Si-Yun's indifference toward studying. In the end, the teachers dedicate themselves fully to the challenge.

"Si-Yun, are you curious to see what's underneath my panties...?"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)
synonyms: 頑張れ先生！ ～勉強は机の上とは限らない♥～

180976.description: Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2016 issue 8.

title.native: 暗号学園のいろは 特別番外編
title.romaji: Angou Gakuen no Iroha: Tokubetsu Bangai-hen

title.native: マリトッツォだっつってんだろ

180980.description:
In the corrupt demon world where money and greed swirl, the only school that aims to nurture true power, the Demon King, is the prestigious Iscariot Academy. The Student Council is the center of this school, made up of the strongest members. Freyalt-Fal and Shiramine Saya, who belong to the student council, are ordered by the student council president to go and correct the Demon King who wields power in the town of Makusha... Exhausted residents, an invisible Demon King, mysterious minerals, and magical powers... What will become of these two when faced with the most powerful evil they could ever imagine... And what is the secret hidden by Saya and Frey?

This long-awaited novelization of a love fantasy based on the original work by the popular game maker Navel.

(Source: NEOWING, translated)

title.native: ジャッジメントちゃいむ～レムナ＝レムナの魔法石～
title.romaji: Judgement Chime: Remuna = Remuna no Mahouseki

180981.description:
After graduating from art school, 36-year-old Takaharu has been living a quiet life, alone with his paintings. Until one day, when Kyou, his ex-girlfriend from 17 years ago, suddenly shows up with her daughter Minori, begging him for a place to stay. Just like their college days, Kyou loves his delicious cooking, as the three of them begin a new life under the same roof…?

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)
synonyms: A Hungry Mother and Daughter and Her Ex-Boyfriend Landlord

title.native: はらぺこ母娘と元カレ家主

180982.description:
Do-Hyeon thinks the girl he matched with might be the same one who used to torment him. But this time, he's the one holding the power, and with it, he plans to bring down his old bully, her friend... and even her family.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)
synonyms: Disciplining the Top Delinquent Bitch Through a Random Chatting App
調教中∼いじめっ子とマッチングした件∼

title.english: Matched with My Bully on Random Chat

180983.description:
The warrior Kang Na-Ru, who became a NEET after his divorce, decides to become an academy professor to change. However, the students keep on pushing themselves onto him, even with the memories of divorce still fresh in his head…!

“I keep having lewd thoughts whenever I see you, Professor!”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: The Warrior Became an Academy Professor After Divorce

title.native: 용사는 이혼 후 아카데미 조교수가 되었다
title.romaji: Yongsaneun Ihon Hu Academy Jogyosuga Doeeossda

180984.description:
The Magistus Arc is the second story of the Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG Stories manga.

It is centered around the card storyline of the "Magistus" cards.

title.native: 遊☆戯☆王OCG STORIES マギストス編

180985.description:
“This version allows you to take direct control of the team and train the players. Would you like to install it?”

A secret training session begins between the underdog professional women’s volleyball players and their junior staff.

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.native: かさねがさねの初恋ですが

180987.description:
Lee Min-Hyeok used to be a national Taekwondo fighter. However, he retired after suffering an injury. On a particular day, a young girl, named Na-Rae, appears in front of him. Compared to her younger self, she has transformed into a grown woman and happens to dorm with Min-Hyeok. However, on the first dorm night, he was caught having sex by the auntie, and…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

180989.description:
Cha Yiseul is rich, reckless, and completely unapologetic about it. With her looks, money, and an endless roster of casual flings, life is one big party—until her mother cuts her off and kicks her out. Just as she hits rock bottom, a mysterious woman named Kang Sori appears, offering her a lifeline…and stirring up blurry memories of a drunken night they may—or may not—have shared. Who exactly is Sori, and why does Yiseul keep thinking about her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 異世界看護師は修行中!! ～女子率90％の聖職者学園に入学してしまった僕～
title.romaji: Isekai Kangoshi wa Shugyou-chuu!!: Joshiritsu 90% no Seishoku Gakuen ni Nyuugaku Shiteshimatta Boku

180991.description:
After painstaking effort, fashion model Ars has achieved immense popularity. However, a genius named Meiko appears next to her.

Her overwhelming natural talent captures the world's attention. She doesn't want to lose. Ars is eager to compete, but Meiko's body has a certain problem...

Aiming for the top, she walks down the shining runway. To grasp glory. To leave proof that she lived. The girls' fiery radiance pierces their hearts, hot and cold!

180992.description:
After humanity triumphs over the dangerous gates, a fragile peace is restored, yet the immense powers of espers become a dangerous double-edged sword. At the heart of this turmoil is Esper Zero, Michael, teetering on the edge of destruction. Enter Adam, a retired soldier haunted by the fractured bonds between espers and their guides. In a bold act of redemption, Adam offers Michael a second chance and a new identity: "Eve," symbolizing a fresh start and a spark of hope. But is peace truly possible for a person created for war…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: A Boy More Beautiful Than Me

title.native: わたしより綺麗な男の子

180995.description:
Jang Ho-Yoon picks up a mirror on the street. When he is almost raped by a mysterious man who emerges from the mirror that night, he covers the mirror with a cloth in repulsion... But he feels that his luck has strangely improved since that night.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

180996.description:
When Hae-Il drowns saving a boy at sea, his final thought is of Pa-Do, the childhood crush he could never forget. Instead of sinking into darkness, however, Hae-Il wakes up with an impossible second chance. But this new life is far from perfect—Pa-Do is cold and distant, and Hae-Il's body dissolves into seafoam with every sting of rejection.

(Source: Manta, edited)

180997.description:
The Song family's true biological daughter appears, shaking Ju-Ha's world. Seeking an escape from an unwelcoming home, Ju-Ha embarks on a series of blind dates until she meets Sa-Hyeon, who boldly suggests setting a wedding date within minutes of their first date. Just as Ju-Ha starts to develop feelings for him, her cunning younger sister—who has already taken everything else from her—declares her intention to marry him instead.

(Source: WEBTOON)

180998.description:
The protagonist is being followed around by a girl who appears to be just a hallucination.

Note: The original web comic titled Genkaku Shoujo ga Tsukimatou Hanashi (幻覚少女がつきまとう話) that was released in 9 parts on Twitter and Pixiv has been compiled on Amazon into an e-book volume titled Genkaku Shoujo ga Tsukimatou (幻覚少女がつきまとう) and released on March 25, 2024.
synonyms: 幻覚少女がつきまとう話
A Story About A Hallucinatory Girl Following Me Around

title.native: 幻覚少女がつきまとう

synonyms: High Spec Kemo High Spec na Juujin to Kazoku ni Narimashita

title.native: ハイスペケモ ハイスペックな獣人と家族になりました
title.romaji: High-Spekemo: High Spec na Kemonohito to Kazoku ni Narimashita
